Todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com base nesse princípio. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Business Development Engineer
vagas.description: Holtec International, a growing and diverse company with its primary focus in the energy industry, is seeking applicants for an experienced Business Development Engineer position in its Brazilian’s division located in Rio de Janeiro, RJ, Brazil. The Business Development Engineer must be a self‑motivated team player who is eager to help the company’s core business in the energy industry. Specific business focus areas are engineering, capital equipment, and technical services for thermal storage, nuclear power plant and heat transfer equipment for nuclear and commercial power plants, decommissioning and waste management services for nuclear installations in the South American territory. The individual must have excellent written and oral communication skills, be able to meet deadlines, and work well under pressure. The Business Development Engineer will report directly to the Program Manager of Holtec do Brasil. The position will require regular travel to client offices and power plants within the assigned territory. The ideal candidate will be well‑rounded in technical and commercial aspects of thermal storage facilities and must be highly motivated, results‑oriented, and capable of interacting with business executives at all levels. Job Duties Assist the Business Development team by providing technical and commercial information to potential customers verbally and in written form. Interpret customer needs, assess requirements, and identify solutions. Develop relationships by communicating with current and potential customers. Manage the entire proposal development lifecycle. Navigate activities prior to Requests for Proposal or Quotations (RFP/RFQ) are released (i.e., engage technical disciplines, create templates, compile draft responses, etc.). Draft win‑themes, proposal strategy approaches, and review Q&A results. Generate proposal response calendars including milestone dates, review meetings, proposal development, and final proposal submission. Perform RFP reviews, breakdowns, analyses, and create specific internal assignments. Create writing outlines to ensure compliant and comprehensive proposal responses. Manage internal proposal section development with subject matter experts. Develop compliant, customized, comprehensive, and responsive technical proposals reflecting customer‑specific themes. Participate in strategy, status, and review meetings. Write original text/tables and proof, edit, and re‑write all sections and documents as needed to ensure accuracy, consistency of message, and RFP compliance. Prepare sales reports showing current sales volume and future sales projections. Assess competitors by analyzing and summarizing competitor information and trends; identify sales opportunities. Update job knowledge by studying new product descriptions; participating in educational opportunities. Additional Responsibilities Work with the project team to ensure that all requirements are met in the design, manufacturing and installation stages. Support review of contracts with Holtec’s legal team and add value with regards to risk identification and mitigation strategies. Minimum Requirements Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical or related Engineering or Scientific discipline. Master’s Degree or PhD in a field related to his activities is desired. Minimum of 5 years’ experience in the energy industry. Minimum of 5 years’ experience as a Project Engineer or Business Development Engineer. Strong understanding of thermal energy storage, power cycles, etc. Fluent in English language. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Avaliador/a Freelancer de Marcas de Luxo - São Paulo, BR
vagas.description: Junte-se à comunidade global que aprimora e eleva a experiência das marcas de luxo mais prestigiadas do mundo! A CXG, uma agência líder em experiência do cliente que atende marcas premium e de luxo, está em busca de Avaliadores de Experiência do Cliente com base em missões e que sejam clientes existentes de marcas de luxo. Como Avaliador Freelancer de Marcas de Luxo, você pode realizar várias avaliações por mês e fornecer seu valioso feedback através de um questionário. Suas atribuições serão tão diversas quanto nossos clientes de luxo e indústrias, abrangendo desde moda e joias de alta qualidade até cosméticos, relógios de luxo, automóveis e muito mais. Suas avaliações podem envolver visitar uma loja, devolver uma compra, comprar um produto online ou marcar um agendamento com uma loja. Por favor, note: os candidatos não devem ter trabalhado em marcas de varejo de luxo para garantir a integridade e objetividade das avaliações. Seu feedback pode influenciar as estratégias de marca e ajudar a moldar a estratégia de uma marca, tornando esta uma oportunidade para você ter um impacto significativo no mercado de luxo. Responsabilidades: Conduzir avaliações discretas das suas marcas de luxo favoritas na loja, online, ou às vezes, em ambos os ambientes. Fornecer feedback objetivo sobre as suas experiências. Escolher missões que estejam alinhadas com seu perfil e interesses. Completar questionários após cada avaliação. Cumprir todos os objetivos do projeto e requisitos especiais da marca de luxo que representamos. Como se candidatar: Cadastre-se no site live.cxg.com e receba um e-mail com suas credenciais. Faça login na nossa plataforma e nos conte mais sobre você. Assim que isso for feito, nossa equipe verificará seu perfil e entrará em contato com você. Verifique o "pacote de boas-vindas" e passe na Certificação Geral. Agora você está pronto! Você está disponível para as missões e pode pesquisar e se candidatar a oportunidades que lhe interessarem. Sobre a CXG: A CXG é uma agência global de experiência do cliente que atende marcas premium e de luxo. Nossos 12 escritórios ao redor do mundo podem atender 70 países. Somos uma equipe de mais de 220 especialistas em experiência do cliente e uma rede de mais de 80.000 avaliadores em todo o mundo. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY RESULT AREAS As a Senior Network Engineer, you will be a valuable team member on our Enterprise Network Operations team supporting SES’s Corporate and Commercial Aviation Networks and Security infrastructure. This individual will be part of a team responsible for the implementation and troubleshooting of SES’s growing network and datacenter presence around the world. This position will work with and manage vendor relations and could have a voice in the purchase/quote process, as our business continues to expand. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, possesses deep troubleshooting skills, and understands the delicate balance between network uptime and security compliance. Troubleshoot and resolve network issues involving Intelsat switches, routers, circuits, etc. Troubleshoot issues with our Palo Alto and Juniper firewall platform as well as implement policy rule changes to facilitate new services and connectivity. Document changes to all SES infrastructure to include Visio diagrams, spreadsheets, and cloud-based tracking and documentation software. Collaborate with Network Engineering on the implementation, buildout, decommissioning, and refresh of SES teleports, datacenters, and sales offices. Coordinate with system design and network operations for existing data expansion, consolidation, and relocation. Manage vendor relationships to get their equipment specs, list prices and other vendor information. Collaborate with Network Engineering on the development of floor plan layouts for datacenters and corporate offices. Develop equipment purchase orders, track orders, and arrange implementation with remote hands if not traveling for datacenter and corporate office related equipment. QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 5-7 years’ hands‑on experience working in large complex network / datacenter environments specifically managing Cisco, Palo Alto, Juniper and F5 hardware. Strong command of Cisco IOS, IOS‑XE, and NX‑OS, PAN‑OS, JUNOS, F5 and Linux command‑line interfaces. Advanced knowledge of Switching technologies to include, Spanning Tree (RPVST+, MST), LACP, VLANs, and Trunking. Proficient with routing protocols (OSPF, BGP, RIPv2, MPLS, HSRP, VRRP, GLBP, SD‑WAN) Working knowledge of F5 load balancing to include monitoring and troubleshooting load balancing VIPs, pools, and health monitors to minimize downtime and ensure seamless failover across multi‑data center environments Working knowledge of Linux Operating system to include monitoring, automation of operational tasks, and troubleshooting Linux parameters, file systems, and network stacks to maximize performance for high‑throughput applications. Working knowledge with dual homing service providers and ISP redundancy Extensive experience working with Cisco hardware including switches, routers, ASRs, ASA, FWSM, IPS, load balancers, Nexus Hands‑on troubleshooting skills to include Wireshark packet capture debugging and analysis. In depth knowledge of security protocols, TACACS, RADIUS, different flavors of VPN and remote access. Experience with Telco services, T1, DS3, SONET, OC3 – 192. Datacenter design, redundancy and failover experience a plus Racking various types of networks and server equipment. Documentation skills for datacenter, corporate office, and remote sales offices. Advanced troubleshooting skills of datacenter and office network environments. vagas.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer | Investments
vagas.description: Senior Staff Software Engineer | Investments This position is for an Senior Staff Software Engineerto join theInvestments Business Unit. Investments Platforms is responsible for the core platforms that model Nubank’s investments business: custody, offer, order management, accounts, settlement and related domains. These platforms are the long‑term home for our investments capabilities and the main path to move away from legacy Invest systems that still handle a large portion of critical flows today. Your mandate is to help design, evolve and execute this environment and comply with regulatory requirements. About Nubank's Engineering Culture: We believe in small, empowered teams, a process‑light environment and a culture of ownership, learning and collaboration. Our architecture is platform‑oriented: we build extensible, agnostic business platforms (e.g., payments, banking, investments) that can be reused across products, markets and asset classes. You will be expected to think in terms of platforms first, translating complex investment domains into clean boundaries, contracts and abstractions that product teams can safely build on. Nubank is also on a company‑wide journey to become an AI‑first company. We expect our senior engineers to be hands‑on with AI tools in their own work, and to help define how AI is used safely and productively in engineering and in products. What we have to offer: Own the technical direction of Investments Platforms – the systems that implement Nubank’s investments business model in software (custody, offer, orders, account, settlement and more) and power how we scale investments in Brazil and future markets. Lead the migration off legacy Invest systems : design and execute strategies to move critical flows into modern Nubank platforms, while we continue operating at scale and meeting regulatory commitments. Work on a disruptive investments architecture – rethinking how investments should be modeled and operated end‑to‑end, rather than just lifting and shifting existing broker or custodian patterns. Drive AI usage in a high‑impact domain : help define how we use AI in investments – both in the products we ship and in how we design, build and operate platforms. Collaborate across the platform ecosystem – working closely with other business and technical platforms such as Payments and Banking, and with product squads that consume Investments Platforms. Global scope with hybrid flexibility : roles are based in Brazil, in a hybrid‑first model (office presence during the week plus periodic on‑site collaboration with other locations). Core Qualifications (What We're Looking For) 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years working on large‑scale platforms or core systems in highly available, transactional environments (finance, payments, core banking, trading, etc.). Proven track record building and operating business platforms that are extensible, multi‑tenant and domain‑agnostic – e.g., custody, payments, banking, risk or similar – with clear contracts for consuming teams. Experience leading strategic migrations from legacy to new architectures: co‑existence patterns, strangler approaches, staged rollouts and data migration strategies that keep systems up while flows move off legacy. Strong foundation in distributed systems and event‑driven architectures: domain modeling, consistency and resiliency strategies, backpressure, observability, SLIs/SLOs and incident learning loops. Demonstrated platform engineering leadership at scale: defining reference architectures and RFCs, building reusable libraries and tools, setting platform SLAs, and making adoption low‑friction and high‑quality for internal customers. Comfortable working as a horizontal leader across stakeholders: aligning GMs, PMs, EMs and Staff/Principals on trade‑offs between speed, risk, platform consistency and product goals. Deep experience mentoring and multiplying senior engineers – raising the bar on architecture, design reviews, documentation and post‑incident retrospectives. Investments expertise: hands‑on experience with investments platforms (brokerage, custody, order management, funds, fixed income, equities, settlement, risk) and understanding of the Brazilian capital markets landscape. Platform background: prior work on other platforms (payments, core banking, investments) that shows you can design high‑abstraction, agnostic, extensible platforms and translate complex domains into clean boundaries and APIs. AI fluency: you are already experimenting with AI in your engineering practice (design exploration, code generation/review, analysis, automation) and are excited to help Nubank push its AI‑first agenda in a pragmatic, safe way. Language: Portuguese fluency is important; English is a plus rather than a hard requirement. We are open to strong IC8 candidates who can ramp up their English over time, and will trade off language in favor of outstanding technical and leadership fit where it makes sense. Resilience and ownership mindset: you are energized by ambiguous, high‑stakes scenarios, keep a constructive and optimistic stance, and actively pull teams toward positive cultural change instead of getting stuck in pessimism or only in the micro level. If you feel interested in these challenges and want to work on a highly engaged and talented team transforming how investments work in Brazil and beyond, this is the place for you! #J-18808-Ljbffr

Experience in designing, implementing, and supporting Genesys Cloud solutions in enterprise settings. Proven expertise in building routing strategies and IVR workflows using Genesys Architect. Familiarity with online teaching platforms and a passion for innovative education methods. Knowledge of the Cambridge, Edexcel or A-Levels curricula and examinations. If you’re passionate about delivering personalized, impactful education in a flexible, one-on-one environment, Crimson Global Academy is the perfect fit for you. Join us in our mission to shape the future of learning, apply now! To learn more about our innovative approach, check out our newsletters and inspiring student success stories. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Somos a JDE Peet’s. Nós produzimos um café para cada xícara e desenvolvemos marcas para cada coração. A JDE Peet’s é a principal empresa global dedicada exclusivamente ao café, servindo aproximadamente 4.400 xícaras de café por segundo em mais de 100 mercados. Guiados pela nossa estratégia “Reviver o Incrível”, focamos em um crescimento liderado por marcas com três grandes apostas: Peet’s, L’OR e Jacobs, além de um portfólio de 9 ícones locais, como Douwe Egberts, Kenco, Pilão, Old Town, Moccona, Super, Gevalia, Friele e Marcilla. Em 2024, a JDE Peet’s gerou 8,8 bilhões de euros em vendas e contava com mais de 21 mil colaboradores no mundo todo. No Brasil, somos uma das maiores empresas de café e temos atuação nacional através de nossas marcas Pilão, L’OR, Café do Ponto, Damasco, Café Maratá, Caboclo, Café Pelé, Café Puro, Chá Maratá e Chá Castelari. Buscamos Fisioterapeutas Visitadores apaixonados pela transformação do cuidado à saúde no ambiente domiciliar, seguindo os princípios do modelo Buurtzorg, que prioriza o autocuidado e a manutenção das funcionalidades das pessoas em suas próprias comunidades. Proatividade na busca de soluções que promovam a qualidade de vida e a funcionalidade dos pacientes. Sobre Nós Na Laços Saúde, a diversidade é o coração do nosso trabalho. Acreditamos que cuidar é um ato de amor e acolhimento, e isso se reflete em nossa equipe, que é composta por profissionais de diversas origens e experiências. O modelo Buurtzorg que adotamos é mais do que um método: é uma filosofia que prioriza o cuidado comunitário, respeitando a individualidade e as necessidades de cada pessoa. Se você é um Fisioterapeuta que acredita na transformação do cuidado à saúde, venha fazer parte da nossa equipe e ajude a moldar o futuro da saúde no Brasil. Capacidade de tomada de decisão baseada em dados. Comunicação assertiva e influência técnica. Confira o que você pode esperar: Um ambiente integrado, leve e acolhedor, onde a colaboração, o respeito e a parceria fazem parte da nossa rotina. Horário flexível , promovendo mais autonomia para você organizar sua rotina e ganhar qualidade de vida. Vale-Refeição , para você aproveitar suas pausas com tranquilidade e bons momentos. Plano de saúde, plano odontológico e seguro de vida, porque cuidar de você e de quem você ama é prioridade. TotalPass , incentivando o movimento, a energia e o equilíbrio entre corpo e mente. Descontos exclusivos nas nossas marcas: Granado, Phebo e Care Natural Beauty — porque quem faz parte também merece aproveitar. Um ambiente que estimula a criatividade, a inovação e o aprendizado contínuo, com apoio ao seu desenvolvimento por meio do Programa de Educação Continuada , que inclui subsídios para cursos de aprimoramento, graduação, pós-graduação e idiomas. Parcerias educacionais com instituições como Estácio e Open English , facilitando ainda mais sua jornada de desenvolvimento. Soube evoluir, modernizar processos e ampliar sua presença no Brasil e no exterior — sempre mantendo sua essência: tradição, excelência e responsabilidade. vagas.description: Overview Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução. No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR). No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo. Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia. Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a EkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável. A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento. A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG. Vem acelerar a sua carreira com o Grupo WLM! Confira as atribuições e vantagens da vaga de MECÂNICO DIESEL abaixo e venha fazer parte desse time de sucesso: Sua missão Elabora desempenho de chassis, planos de manutenção; realiza manutenções de motores, sistemas e partes de veículos automotores. Substitui peças, repara e testa desempenho de componentes e sistemas de veículos. Efetua diagnóstico e reparo em conjuntos mecânicos, pneumáticos, hidráulicos e elétricos, socorre veículos, atuando como motorista até o local do socorro. Realiza serviços de lubrificação dos veículos utilizando bomba de lubrificação em eixos, quinta roda, sistema direcional, embuchamento e suspensão de acordo com a demanda especifica de cada veículo (preventiva e corretiva). Faz orçamento de mão de obra e peças a serem aplicadas. Realização habitual e intermitente de solda elétrica por eletrodos. Quando necessário, sendo habilitado e autorizado, dirige veículos de propriedade da empresa para atendimento externos aos clientes. Requisitos Ensino Médio completo Informática Básica. Noção/experiência em mecânica de autos ou pesados. Desejável curso técnico em mecânica. Imprescindivel disponibilidade de viagens! Local de Trabalho: Jacarepaguá/RJ Carga Horária: 30H (diurno e noturno) e 40H (diarista) A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970. A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão. A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação. Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. vagas.title: Over the Counter (OTC) Sales Specialist – Rio - Accounting
vagas.description: Overview Over the Counter (OTC) Sales Specialist – Rio Mackay Marine is a global marine electronics service company with more than 500 employees across 60 service depots in twenty-two (22) countries, including the America’s, Africa, Asia, and Europe. Mackay offers competitive salaries plus overtime, and benefits such as health/dental insurance, holiday leave, meal and transportation vouchers are available as well. Mackay is currently seeking a fulltime and experienced Marine Over the Counter (OTC) Specialist who is proficient in English, to work onsite at our Rio location. Individuals with the skills and qualifications outlined below are encouraged to apply. Otc Specialist Job Summary The OTC Specialist is an onsite, non-managerial position which reports to the Managing Director for Brazil. The responsibilities of the OTC Specialist include but are not limited to communicating directly with our customers to answer questions concerning the availability, price, and use of merchandise as well as providing technical guidance, timely quotations, and comprehensive proposals. Will process over-the-counter transactions, special orders, phone-in and internet sales orders as well as inter-company transfers. Will support other team members, customers and company accounts with parts ordering and fulfillment to support our business. Responsibilities Materials handling and shipping/receiving of goods which includes physical lifting, handling of boxes, pallet jacks and may include activities on ladders, lifts, forklift, power tools, hand tools, carrying and moving of parts and equipment. Acts as the point of contact for customer sales, service, and information requests to ensure that customer needs are fulfilled with speed and professionalism. Assist in the research of basic technical issues on products and service. Collect symptoms of customer problems and facilitate repairs. Assist with incoming sales prospects or customer calls when outside sales staff are out of the office. Provide customer quotes, proposals, and will follow up in a timely manner. Build the business by identifying revenue opportunities within the marine industry. Assist with the shipping and receiving functions to help facilitate the trafficking and accountability for all materials received and delivered for customer orders, inventory, repairs, or for internal use. Direct service requests to the appropriate team member. Maintain work area and stockroom in a clean and orderly fashion. Read customer orders, work orders, shipping orders, or requisitions to determine items to be moved, gathered, or distributed and/or shipped using Mackay’s ERP system. Otc Sales Specialist Skills Needed Prior knowledge of Marine electronic equipment is a plus. Ability to read and interpret documents such as product brochures, operating and maintenance instructions, procedure manuals, etc. Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percentage. Attention to detail and ability to organize materials effectively and efficiently. Excellent customer service, communication (both oral and written), organizational, planning, and prioritization skills. Otc Sales Specialist Qualifications Two years of post-secondary education. Electronics and/or marine background preferred. Three years of inside or counter sales experience. Good computer and Internet skills Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation. Applicants must be authorized to work in Brazil without sponsorship. Successful completion of a thorough background check will be required upon acceptance of an employment offer. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Engenheiro de Análise Oceânica I ou II
vagas.description: Quem somos A Longitude Engineering, parte do ABL Group, é uma consultoria internacional independente de design e engenharia especializada nos setores marítimo, naval, energia, offshore e renováveis. Atuamos globalmente apoiando clientes ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida de ativos complexos, com foco em segurança, excelência técnica, inovação e sustentabilidade. No Brasil, nossa equipe trabalha de forma integrada com times internacionais, conectando expertise local ao know-how global do grupo. Nossa missão, visão e valores Missão Entregar soluções de engenharia confiáveis e eficientes, apoiando nossos clientes na execução de projetos complexos com alto padrão técnico e segurança. Visão Ser referência global em engenharia marítima e offshore, reconhecida pela qualidade técnica, inovação e desenvolvimento de pessoas. Valores Safety First – Segurança sempre em primeiro lugar Technical Excellence – Qualidade e precisão técnica Collaboration – Trabalho em equipe e relações de confiança Innovation – Melhoria contínua e soluções inteligentes Integrity & Transparency – Ética, clareza e responsabilidade Sobre a vaga Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Análise Oceânica Sênior para atuar no desenvolvimento de análises técnicas e modelagens numéricas no departamento de Engenharia Oceânica da Longitude. Este profissional participará de estudos de engenharia relacionados a hidrodinâmica, sistemas de ancoragem, instalações submarinas e operações marítimas , contribuindo para a execução segura e eficiente de projetos offshore. A posição envolve a realização de simulações computacionais, análise de resultados, elaboração de relatórios técnicos e suporte técnico a operações offshore , com eventual participação em atividades embarcadas ou acompanhamento de operações quando necessário. O profissional atuará em um ambiente técnico e multidisciplinar, interagindo com diferentes disciplinas de engenharia e colaborando em projetos nacionais e internacionais. Principais responsabilidades Desenvolver análises de sistemas de ancoragem para unidades offshore (FPSO, plataformas e embarcações). Realizar modelagens e simulações numéricas utilizando softwares como OrcaFlex e OrcaWave . Avaliar condições ambientais, carregamentos e comportamento de sistemas submarinos com base em dados meteocean . Conduzir análises hidrodinâmicas relacionadas ao comportamento de embarcações e equipamentos offshore. Automatizar processos de análise e tratamento de dados utilizando Python quando aplicável. Elaborar relatórios técnicos e documentação de engenharia. Dar suporte técnico a operações marítimas e subsea quando necessário. Interagir com equipes multidisciplinares em projetos de engenharia offshore. Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de metodologias e ferramentas de análise. Requisitos ✔ Graduação em Engenharia Naval, Oceânica, Mecânica ou áreas correlatas . ✔ Experiência com modelagem e simulação no software OrcaFlex . ✔ Experiência em análises de sistemas de ancoragem, linhas ou instalação submarina . ✔ Capacidade de interpretação de resultados de simulações e elaboração de relatórios técnicos. ✔ Inglês intermediário para leitura técnica e comunicação profissional. ✔ Experiência prévia em projetos de engenharia offshore. Diferenciais ⭐ Experiência em hidrodinâmica aplicada ao movimento de embarcações . ⭐ Experiência com operações marítimas ou engenharia operacional offshore . ⭐ Conhecimento em análise de linhas, cabos, risers ou lançamento de equipamentos submarinos . ⭐ Conhecimento em normas e regulatórios como DNV, ABS, API 2SK ou CSS Code . ⭐ Experiência com softwares como Rhino, HydroD, OrcaWave, Lashcon, Inventor ou Optimoor . ⭐ Experiência com outros softwares de análise hidrodinâmica. Habilidades técnicas Modelagem e simulação offshore utilizando OrcaFlex . Análise de sistemas de ancoragem e linhas submarinas. Interpretação de resultados de simulações hidrodinâmicas. Avaliação de condições ambientais (meteocean). Elaboração de relatórios técnicos de engenharia. Programação em Python para automação de análises. Conhecimento em hidrodinâmica aplicada a operações offshore. Habilidades comportamentais Forte capacidade analítica e pensamento crítico . Autonomia para conduzir análises técnicas complexas. Boa comunicação técnica e trabalho em equipe. Proatividade na busca por soluções de engenharia. Organização e atenção a detalhes técnicos. Capacidade de orientar estagiários e engenheiros júnior. Como é trabalhar na Longitude Ambiente técnico, colaborativo e multicultural. Interação constante com equipes e projetos internacionais. Oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional e crescimento dentro do grupo. Participação em projetos relevantes nos setores marítimo, offshore e de energia. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Mais do que isso, se envolvem e se abrem para novos aprendizados: se expressar, colaborar e interagir com os outros, colocar suas ideias com confiança e respeito, improvisar e criar. Red Balloon - Inglês para voar alto! vagas.title: Operador de Equipamentos - TWM
vagas.description: OPERADOR DE EQUIPAMENTOS Local: Usina Ternium Cargo Operacional | (Rollon, Basculante e Poliguindaste) SOBRE A OPORTUNIDADE: Essa vaga é para profissional responsável por operar equipamentos de movimentação e transporte de resíduos e materiais dentro da usina, garantindo produtividade com foco total em segurança, conformidade ambiental e padrões operacionais da operação. O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ: Buscamos pessoas comprometidas, pontuais e atentas às normas de segurança. Valorizamos quem executa bem sua função, cuida do ambiente de trabalho e respeita os processos. RESPONSABILIDADES: Operar caminhão basculante, rollon/roll-off e poliguindaste, seguindo procedimento operacional e orientações do encarregado. Realizar checklist diário do equipamento, comunicar anomalias e abrir chamados de manutenção quando necessário. Cumprir rigorosamente regras de SSMA (EPI, sinalização, velocidade, rota, isolamento de área, comunicação via rádio e permissões aplicáveis). Atuar com atenção à segregação, acondicionamento e movimentação correta de resíduos, prevenindo derramamentos e contaminações. Apoiar o time na organização da área, 5S, controle de carga/descarga e alinhamento com as rotinas do ponto operacional. Manter boa comunicação com a equipe e registrar ocorrências/atividades conforme rotina do contrato. REQUISITOS: Experiência comprovada na operação de rollon, basculante e/ou poliguindaste (desejável em área industrial/usina). Forte cultura de segurança: atenção a riscos, direção defensiva, disciplina operacional e parada segura. Noções de meio ambiente: segregação de resíduos, prevenção de vazamentos, uso correto de bacias/forrações quando aplicável e reporte imediato de desvios. Perfil com visão operacional: entender prioridades do turno, manter ritmo de operação e evitar retrabalho. CNH D. DIFERENCIAL: Experiência em operação industrial, logística ou ambiental. Vivência com rotinas de turno ou escala. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Mecânicos do Futuro | RJ (Barra Mansa e Pavuna)
vagas.description: Overview Há quase 80 anos, a WLM atua estrategicamente nos setores automotivo, agronegócio, energia e soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução. Nosso foco principal é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus, peças genuínas e manutenção especializada. Estamos presentes em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados pelas operações: Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR). Dentro desse ecossistema de soluções, a Equipo Locadora é especialista em soluções personalizadas para empresas que precisam de transporte sem complicações, oferecendo tecnologia, gestão inteligente de frota e atendimento próximo aos clientes. Com o objetivo de oferecer transporte inteligente e eficiente para empresas de diferentes portes e segmentos, sempre com foco em qualidade, confiabilidade e inovação. No agronegócio , pelas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do MT, Sul de MG e região de Campinas/SP), atuamos na criação, recria e engorda de bovinos e na produção de café, soja e milho, sempre com foco em sustentabilidade e preservação ambiental. Em 2025, adquirimos 60% da CHP Brasil , referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética, ampliando nosso portfólio e reforçando nosso compromisso com inovação e sustentabilidade. Como parte dessa estratégia, nasceu a EkoTruck , startup voltada à reciclagem de caminhões, peças alternativas e componentes remanufaturados, reduzindo o TCO dos clientes e fortalecendo a economia circular. Com unidades estrategicamente localizadas, garantimos cobertura nacional, agilidade e excelência no atendimento. Nossa holding está no Rio de Janeiro e contamos com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG. Programa Mecânicos do Futuro O Programa Mecânicos do Futuro foi criado para formar novos talentos, combinando aprendizado prático com desenvolvimento real na carreira. Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de aprender com profissionais experientes, participar de uma trilha de treinamentos técnicos e vivenciar o dia a dia da mecânica em um ambiente colaborativo, inovador e cheio de desafios reais. Etapas O programa inclui processo seletivo, treinamento técnico inicial e treinamento presencial na Scania em São Paulo, garantindo que você desenvolva habilidades práticas e vivencie o trabalho real da manutenção de veículos. Ao final do programa, haverá uma avaliação, que permite identificar seu desempenho e potencial antes da contratação, garantindo que você esteja pronto para iniciar sua carreira como Auxiliar de Mecânico. Sobre a Vaga Como Auxiliar de Mecânico, você vai apoiar a equipe de manutenção em inspeções, manutenções preventivas e reparos básicos, contribuindo para que os veículos estejam sempre seguros, eficientes e prontos para rodar. Essa é uma oportunidade para aprender na prática, crescer tecnicamente e iniciar sua carreira em um time de referência na área, desenvolvendo habilidades essenciais para se tornar um profissional completo. Requisitos Ensino Médio Completo Pacote Office básico Disponibilidade para viagem Benefícios Durante o Programa: Os custos com mobilidade, alimentação e hospedagem serão custeados pela empresa. Após a contratação: Ticket Alimentação – pensado para garantia de praticidade no cuidado com a sua casa e família. Refeição no local – para garantir refeições mais práticas e tranquilas no seu dia a dia. Vale Transporte – para apoiar seu deslocamento no trajeto casa x trabalho x casa. Assistência Médica – cuidando da sua saúde e de quem você ama. Assistência Odontológica – cuidando do seu sorriso e de toda a sua família. Cartão Farmácia – facilidade e conveniência para cuidar da sua saúde e bem-estar. Seguro de Vida em Grupo e Assistência Funeral – proteção e segurança para você e sua família em momentos delicados. Wellhub(Gympass) – incentivo à prática de atividades físicas e ao bem-estar. Telemedicina: Dra. AON | Conexa Saúde – apoio à sua saúde com praticidade e rapidez, sempre que precisar. Parceria Open English – curso de idiomas com condições exclusivas para colaboradores. Petlove – plano de assistência médica para cães e gatos, cuidando da saúde do seu melhor amigo com carinho, segurança e tranquilidade. Horário de trabalho Segunda a sexta-feira, das 07h30 às 17h18. No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo. Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia. Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a EkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável. A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento. vagas.title: Ad Ops Onboarding Manager - Publishers (Remote)
vagas.description: About MonetizeMore MonetizeMore is a global leader in ad tech, seen by 300M+ people monthly. For 16 years, we’ve achieved double-digit growth by blending proprietary AI technology with manual optimization techniques to empower publishers. We are a culture-centric, location-independent organization that values Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen, and Collaboration. MonetizeMore offers location and schedule freedom to every one of its team members. That means that you would have the lifestyle autonomy to choose to work from anywhere in the world, during the time of day you prefer. This new-age work lifestyle would enable you to engineer your ideal lifestyle. Say goodbye to endless commutes, stuffy business attire, and the arbitrary 9 to 5 work-day. Take your life back into your hands by joining the MonetizeMore team! What You’ll Do As part of our Publisher Centric Team , At M2, we focus and emphasize proactive Publisher Services. As the Onboarding Manager, your role is a critical "first impression" of our organization and our ability to support our publishing partners in reaching their goals. You will spearhead the onboarding process for new publishers, ensuring they are equipped with the right tech, knowledge, and confidence to succeed. You are not just setting up accounts you are orchestrating a "White Glove" experience that reduces time-to-value and sets the stage for long-term retention. You also pay attention to improving our systems and processes along the way to continuously improve our service to publishers. Responsibilities Project Management & Implementation Lead the Lifecycle: Expertly manage the publisher journey from Sales endorsement to "Live" status. You are the project manager for the publisher’s first 30-90 days. Technical Coordination: Collaborate with Account Executives and Solutions Engineers to troubleshoot setup concerns (Header Bidding, GAM, wrappers) and ensure optimal configuration. Feature Activation: Ensure all applicable M2 Tech Features are activated at launch to maximize publisher revenue immediately (KPI: Uptake %). Client-Centric Communication & Education Kick-off & Strategy: Conduct kick-off calls to understand the publisher's specific business goals and align our implementation plan to meet them. Ambassadorship: Act as the primary champion for M2 tools and products. Provide comprehensive walkthroughs to ensure publishers are comfortable and proficient with our platform. Responsive Support: Serve as the primary point of contact for all questions during installation, providing guidance that is both technical and empathetic. Performance Analysis & Handoff Performance Reviews: Conduct thorough 7-day and 30-day post-live performance reviews. Use data to demonstrate value and identify early optimization wins. Seamless Transition: Manage a structured handoff to the Ad Optimizer and Customer Success Manager, ensuring no momentum is lost after the initial 30-day period. Day-today Activities You are the external face of MonetizeMore for our newest partners. You thrive on variety and high-energy interaction—no two days (or publishers) are exactly alike. External Engagement: You will constantly meet new partners, leading high-impact kickoff calls to align our tech with their specific business goals. Project Command: You project manage the entire implementation lifecycle, coordinating between the publisher and our technical teams to ensure an optimal, revenue-ready setup and accelerated scale. Performance Ownership: You don't just "set it and forget it." You conduct data-driven 7-day and 30-day etc. performance reviews to prove value immediately. Seamless Handoff: Once the foundation is solid, you orchestrate a smooth transfer to the account management team ensuring the relationship momentum continues uninterrupted. How this role fits into the organization This is a cornerstone role that is pivotal to our company’s success. Strategic Impact: Reporting to the Ad Ops Team Manager, you are the architect of the "First 30 Days." Since our publishers' growth is our growth, our long-term revenue goals effectively start on your desk. The "Wow" Factor: You are responsible for delivering the "White Glove" experience. You set the trajectory for retention by uncovering publisher goals early and proving that MonetizeMore is a partner, not just a vendor. Bridge Builder: You act as the vital link between Sales promises and long-term Operational success, ensuring that every new client enters our ecosystem with clarity, confidence, and a setup primed for revenue generation. Who You Are Must Haves Experience: 1+ years of experience in Programmatic sell-side advertising, Customer Onboarding, or Ad Operations. Technical Knowledge: Understanding of Google Ad Manager (GAM), AdSense, Header Bidding, and Google Analytics. Experience with WordPress and debugging ad calls is a strong plus. Analytical Skills: Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and data presentation tools. You can spot trends in numbers quickly. Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. You can command a room (virtually) and manage expectations clearly. Project Management: Demonstrated ability to manage multiple implementations simultaneously without dropping the ball. Nice to Have Has worked with AdSense, Google Analytics, and GAM and has extensive knowledge of Google policies and other platforms Understands coding and has a strong tech background Has worked with WordPress and is knowledgeable when it comes to implementing ads and debugging ad calls Bilingual - Portuguese and Spanish are an extra bonus What We Offer Competitive Salary : Our salary formula adjusts to your cost of living and experience. Work remotely : Live and work wherever you like! Flexible working hours : You have the autonomy to set your own schedule Retreats : We meet in person for company get-togethers. Career growth and learning opportunities If you think you are a good fit to join our Ad Optimization , please apply on this side bar and give specific reasons what sets you apart. We hire individuals, not robots so don’t be afraid to show a little personality. We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion. Please note that interviews are conducted virtually. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Senior Backend Engineer, MCP, RAG and Fine-Tuning (100% Remote)
vagas.description: About the job Did you know Hopper's technology powers some of the largest travel portals in the world? Our Hopper Technology Solutions (HTS) platform drives travel purchases for major global brands — from banks to airlines to fintech leaders. This platform is essentially a configurable, multi-tenant travel commerce engine, enabling partners to launch world-class hotel and travel booking experiences faster, with less custom engineering. We’re looking for a senior software engineer who has adopted the best practices in terms of AI-assisted coding. You are not using AI to auto-complete your code; you are using multiple agents to autonomously deliver features at a speed that was impossible a few months ago. You understand well the strengths and weaknesses of LLMs, and you know how to build a feedback loop and guardrails to get the best out of them. Tech stack Backend systems are written in Scala, and we use a suite of GCP services Frontends are web apps using react + typescript What your day-to-day would look like Identify and execute improvements to the code base to allow agents to go faster and safer. Work with a group of top-tier engineers in a low-process environment powered by trust and high autonomy. Drive decisions and consensus asynchronously by leveraging AI to author the thoughtful documentation and specifications that guide the team. Ship fast. Learn fast. Repeat. Orchestrate AI agents to build new features from top to bottom, from UX to database, with minimal oversight. Architect the scalable solutions and foundational patterns that allow us to efficiently launch new portals. Work directly with PMs and business partners to define and refine our roadmap; your voice and technical vision matter. Collaborate with a diverse group of people, giving and receiving the high-level feedback necessary for growth. An ideal candidate has A natural drive to fearlessly deep dive into an unknown code base while keeping their eyes on the goal to deliver results fast. Proven ability to direct AI agents and automated workflows to architect, implement, and maintain complex software systems with minimal human intervention. Expertise in designing the technical guardrails and automated feedback loops that maximize the productivity and reliability of AI agents operating within the codebase. Strong product thinking where your conception of quality and architecture is inherently anchored in the customer experience. Experience with, or a mastery-level willingness to learn, distributed system development in Scala. Perks and benefits of working with us: Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre-IPO equity packages. Carrot Cash travel stipend. Hopper will cover 100% of the employee premiums for EOR‑offered health, dental, life and short term disability insurances with SulAmerica. Hopper offers employees in Brazil monthly meal vouchers Very generous parental leave Flexdesk All Access Pass & Work-from-home stipend. Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business. Open communication with management and company leadership. Small, dynamic teams = massive impact. More about Hopper At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world‑class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips. The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. the Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials. While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands. Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more. Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth: Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year. Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no‑questions‑asked resolutions. Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel. Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business. Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co‑develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more. Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen‑Z and millennials travelers. Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials. Come take off with us! #LI-REMOTE #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.description: Voldex is a leading gaming company focused on Roblox, the most exciting ecosystem in gaming today. With over 160 million monthly active players across our games, we are the #1 Roblox developer by audience size. Founded in 2015, we have since grown to 85+ full-time remote team members across the globe. Our strategy is to acquire and sustainably grow games on Roblox. Our acquisition strategy is backed with significant capital from firms including The Raine Group, Makers Fund, Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), QIA, Dune Ventures, and MIT. Our top games include: Brookhaven, #1 Roleplay game on Roblox and the most popular game on the Roblox platform Driving Empire, the #1 Driving game on Roblox where we’ve brought real cars into the game in partnership with automakers NFL Universe Football, the #1 American football game and top grossing sports game on Roblox. vagas.title: Senior Associate - Global Mobility - Immigration
vagas.description: Introduction Vialto Partners is a market leader in global mobility services. Our purpose is to ‘Connect the world’. We are unique and the only stand‑alone global mobility business. This presents a rare opportunity for our clients, stakeholders and colleagues. Our teams help companies streamline and effectively manage their global mobility programs in a cost‑efficient and compliant manner. Our services focus on providing cross‑border compliance and risk assessment for tax, immigration, business travel, rewards and compensation, and remote work. Working at Vialto Partners is about getting the chance to be part of a global and dynamic team. Globally, Vialto Partners has over 6,500 staff in over 50 countries around the world, and continues to grow. You will work with clients from a range of industries and different geographical locations. We believe in connecting the world and supporting our colleagues to do the same in their careers by undertaking assignments and opportunities globally that broaden their skills and ultimately benefit our clients. Vialto is unstoppable when we work together in a culture of belonging, where everyone can thrive. We encourage employees to bring their true selves and share their unique talents and expertise to positively impact the communities we serve. To learn more about what we do, tune in to our podcast On the Move to hear expert insights on issues affecting global mobility, and read about the latest news in the industry. You can also follow us on Linkedin and Instagram. Job Description This role is responsible for supporting the immigration requirements of client employees, ensuring compliance with applicable immigration laws and regulations while delivering a high level of client service. The Senior Associate plays a key role in managing immigration matters, whether aligned to a global account or a specific geographic region. This position requires close collaboration with corporate clients, employees, legal teams, government entities, and other stakeholders to facilitate efficient, compliant, and well‑coordinated immigration processes. The role is critical in navigating complex immigration procedures and driving successful outcomes for all parties involved. Responsibilities Serve as the primary point of contact for corporate clients requiring immigration support. Understand each client’s specific immigration needs and help develop tailored immigration solutions. Manage the end-to-end immigration process for employees, including visa applications, work permits, and related case matters. Prepare, review, and submit immigration forms, petitions, and supporting documentation, ensuring accuracy and compliance. Interpret and apply immigration laws, regulations, and policies to support client compliance and mitigate risk. Advise clients on immigration processes, timelines, requirements, and potential risks. Maintain accurate and well‑organized case files, ensuring all relevant documentation is securely stored and easily accessible. Support commercial awareness by recording time accurately and in a timely manner, assisting with billing activities, and identifying scope creep where applicable. Communicate effectively with clients, government authorities, and internal stakeholders to ensure a seamless exchange of information. Liaise with network offices, third‑party providers, consulates, embassies, and immigration authorities to obtain updated immigration rules, monitor case progress, and resolve issues. Handle unexpected issues arising during the immigration or implementation process with professionalism and efficiency. Provide clients with regular updates regarding case status and changes to immigration rules or procedures. Use a broad range of tools and techniques to identify and extract insights from trends within the business area. Respond to client inquiries, concerns, and feedback in a timely, professional, and courteous manner. Support the onboarding and training of new or junior team members on case management processes, immigration forms, and applications. Stay current on relevant immigration laws, regulations, policies, and industry developments. Depending on the service line, support the implementation and use of relevant technology platforms and tools. Preferred Skills / Experience Experience managing immigration casework in a corporate, consulting, or professional services environment. Strong knowledge of immigration processes, documentation, and compliance requirements. Ability to manage multiple cases and deadlines in a fast‑paced environment. Strong written and verbal communication skills. High attention to detail and strong organizational skills. Client‑service mindset with the ability to build strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders. Experience training or mentoring junior team members is an asset. Commercial awareness, including time recording and billing support, is preferred. Education / Qualifications Bachelor’s degree preferred. Relevant immigration, mobility, legal, or client‑service experience preferred. Location Rio de Janeiro and surrounding areas. Equal Opportunity Employer We are an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected status. Additional Information Please note, AI is used as part of the application process. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Salesforce Sales Cloud Developer
vagas.description: About The Role At Riveron, a nationally recognized business advisory firm, we combine deep industry knowledge with innovative technology to drive meaningful business outcomes. We’re seeking an experienced Salesforce Developer with a strong focus on Salesforce Sales Cloud to join our Technology & Innovation team. In this role, you will design, build, and optimize scalable Salesforce solutions that support sales operations, revenue growth, and go-to-market strategies across the enterprise. You’ll work closely with business stakeholders to translate sales processes into high-performing, secure, and maintainable Salesforce applications. Who You Are You have 5+ years of hands‑on Salesforce development experience, with deep expertise in Sales Cloud. You are highly proficient in Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, and SOQL. You have designed and implemented Sales Cloud data models, including Accounts, Contacts, Leads, Opportunities, Products, Price Books, Quotes, and Forecasting. You have experience building integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, and middleware tools such as MuleSoft. You have a strong understanding of Salesforce security architecture, including profiles, permission sets, role hierarchy, sharing rules, and field‑level security. You are skilled in Salesforce declarative automation tools, including Flows, Validation Rules, Approval Processes, and (where applicable) Process Builder. You actively contribute in Agile development environments, participating in sprint planning, estimations, code reviews, and technical discussions. You are familiar with CI/CD practices and tools such as Git, Copado, Gearset, and Salesforce DX. You hold a Salesforce Platform Developer I certification (required). You collaborate effectively with both technical and business teams, acting as a trusted advisor for sales‑related solutions. You write clean, scalable, and well‑documented code aligned with Salesforce best practices and long‑term maintainability. What You’ll Do Develop, customize, and maintain Sales Cloud solutions that support lead‑to‑cash and opportunity management processes. Design and enhance custom objects, Apex classes, triggers, and Lightning Web Components (LWC) to meet sales and revenue requirements. Build and optimize functionality related to Leads, Opportunities, Products, Pricing, Quotes, Sales Forecasting, and Pipelines. Design and implement secure, scalable integrations between Salesforce Sales Cloud and external systems (CRM, ERP, finance, and marketing platforms). Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate sales strategies into effective technical solutions. Automate and streamline sales workflows using Flows and Apex, ensuring performance and governor limit compliance. Participate in technical design reviews, ensuring scalability, security, and alignment with Salesforce best practices. Support DevOps and deployment activities, including version control, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and release management. Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, ensuring minimal disruption to sales users. Contribute to technical documentation, solution design artifacts, and knowledge sharing within the development team. Preferred Qualifications Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer II, Salesforce Administrator, or App Builder. Experience with Salesforce CPQ or advanced pricing and quoting solutions. Familiarity with Salesforce reporting and dashboards to support sales performance insights. Experience working with multi‑region or global sales organizations. Exposure to Salesforce integration patterns and enterprise‑scale implementations. Prior experience mentoring junior developers or leading technical initiatives. Background in professional services, consulting, or enterprise transformation projects. About Riveron At Riveron, we partner with clients—from global multinationals to high‑growth private entities—to solve complex finance challenges, guided by our DELTA values: Drive, Excellence, Leadership, Teamwork, and Accountability. Our entrepreneurial culture thrives on collaboration, diverse perspectives, and delivering exceptional outcomes. We are committed to fostering growth, both for our clients and our people, through mentorship, integrity, and a client‑centric approach. This inclusive environment offers flexibility, progressive benefits, and meaningful opportunities for impactful work that supports well‑being in and out of the office. Check Us Out On Social Media LinkedIn Glassdoor Instagram Facebook Full time roles are eligible for a full range of benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, and PTO. O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada. Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia. Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a EkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável. A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento. A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG. Vem acelerar a sua carreira com o Grupo WLM! vagas.title: Sr Software Engineer, Frontend (Web)
vagas.description: About The Role Please note: this hybrid position is based in São Paulo or Rio de Janeiro, Brazil - welcoming both local professionals and those open to relocating. At Uber, Frontend Engineers build web experiences that power the way people move and receive things around the world. As part of our engineering team, you'll work on large-scale applications that impact millions of users. You'll collaborate with cross-functional partners (design, backend, data science, product). About The Teams Delivery: The Delivery team is focused on innovating and streamlining how products and services reach our customers. In this role, you'll contribute to building efficient and robust systems that support order processing, logistics, and real-time tracking. Your contributions will help optimize the end-to-end delivery experience, making it more reliable and seamless for both drivers and customers. ADS: The Ads team builds and scales the advertising platform and its features that power sponsored experiences across Uber's apps, connecting riders, eaters, and advertisers in relevant and measurable ways. The team owns end-to-end ad delivery (from ad creation, rendering, and experimentation to tracking, measurement, and performance optimization) across mobile and web surfaces. The work sits at the intersection of product, platform, and data, ensuring ads are high-quality for users while driving impact for advertisers and Uber's business. Mobility (Rider Core): Millions of people depend on Uber's web application to make ride reservations and get on-demand Uber rides. The Rider Core Team at Uber is redefining what it means to Uber and expanding our products beyond on-demand rides. In this role, you'll work with many distributed teams, ranging from designers, engineers, and data scientists, to provide market-defining products and trip planning experiences over the web. What You'll Do Design and implement user-facing features for critical web properties at scale, making engineering trade-offs between speed, maintainability, and user experience. Own the technical design and execution of features, from initial architecture discussions to debugging production issues. Collaborate across disciplines, Product, Design, Data Science, and Backend Engineering, to turn ambiguous business needs into clear, scalable front-end systems. Champion front-end engineering excellence, defining and leading the adoption of code health, testing, and design standards within your project area. Improve core application performance, efficiency, and system reliability, proactively identifying and tackling areas of technical debt in software and processes within your team. Mentor junior and mid-level engineers on best practices, system design philosophy, and navigating cross-functional project dynamics. What You'll Need 7 years of professional software engineering experience, with a focus on large-scale, high-traffic web applications. Hands-on experience and proficiency in a modern web framework such as JavaScript, React, VueJS, or Angular, plus HTML and CSS. Proficiency in fundamental algorithms and data structures, including hash tables, trees, stacks, queues, linked lists, DFS, and BFS. Demonstrated understanding of modern web application architecture and design patterns, and their implications for performance and scalability. Advanced English communication skills, written and verbal, to effectively collaborate with globally distributed cross-functional teams. Bonus Points If Experience leading the technical direction of complex, cross-functional projects with multiple dependencies. Familiarity with back-end systems (e.g., Go, Python, TypeScript) to facilitate collaboration and diagnose full-stack issues. Experience with the full project lifecycle, from idea inception and stakeholder engagement to monitoring in production. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Staff Software Engineer | Credit Cards
vagas.description: About Us Nubank was founded in 2013 to free people from a bureaucratic, slow and inefficient financial system. Since then, through innovative technology and outstanding customer service, the company has been redefining people's relationships with money across Latin America. With operations in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, Nubank is today one of the largest digital banking platforms and technology‑leading companies in the world. Nubank was listed on the NYSE in 2021 and was recently named one of Time Magazine's 100 Most Influential Companies. For more information, visit About The Role At Nubank, our Credit Card platform is the core of our global expansion. We are looking for a Staff Engineer to join our platform team as a technical anchor, ensuring our systems remain scalable and flexible as we maintain sustainable growth and innovation in the countries where we currently operate, while also launching into new international markets. You will play a vital role in evolving the architecture of one of our most complex and strategic products. You will operate within a high‑impact triad alongside Product and Management, focusing on long‑term technical strategy and system health. As a hands‑on technical leader, you will challenge the status quo, propose innovation and solve deep architectural problems, mentor and become a technical reference for our engineering team. Your work will directly enable millions of customers to access financial products via credit card worldwide. Responsibilities Define and drive the long‑term vision and strategy for the global architecture of the core credit card platform, ensuring exponential scalability and continuous evolution capability. Lead the strategic partnership with Product and Business leadership (C‑level and VPs) to shape the medium and long‑term technical roadmap and define the strategic OKRs and global impact KPIs. Act as a technical and cultural reference, defining the highest standards of engineering excellence, mentoring other Architects and Principal/Staff Engineers, and fostering a culture of innovation and accountability. Lead and resolve the most ambitious and high‑risk technical challenges, intervening in critical performance or resilience bottlenecks and driving technical execution for solutions with multi‑system and multi‑country impact. Design and oversee the execution of complex system transformations (e.g., core banking migrations, replacement of legacy platforms) ensuring regulatory compliance in multiple jurisdictions and fiscal regimes, proactively mitigating risks. Communicate and defend the technical strategy eloquently and convincingly to the executive board and non‑technical audiences, translating architecture decisions into business value and competitive advantage. Required Qualifications Principal/Staff Engineer level experience or equivalent with an extensive and demonstrable history in architecting and scaling mission‑critical, high‑volume, and low‑latency systems in global fintech or e‑commerce environments. Expert proficiency (demonstrated in code and design) in multiple programming paradigms, with significant hands‑on experience in functional programming (e.g., Clojure, Scala, Haskell) and reactive/event‑based architectures. Proven ability to establish and lead the long‑term technical strategy for entire platform ecosystems (not just isolated components), influencing the direction of multiple engineering groups. Deep and successful experience in navigating and defining the architecture in highly regulated financial environments (e.g., BACEN, FCA, SOX) and designing systems to meet data residency requirements and complex cross‑border transactions. History of successfully leading and completing large‑scale platform transformations (e.g., transition from monoliths to microservices mesh, migration of data centers or clouds), managing risks and operational impact. In‑depth knowledge of credit card/payment systems design is a significant differential. Nice to Have Experience with Clojure or similar functional languages. Proven interest or experience in leveraging AI to optimize engineering workflows. Deep domain knowledge of credit card processing or financial ledgers. Location & Work Model This role is based on a hybrid model at one of our Nubank offices in Brazil (São Paulo, Campinas, Rio de Janeiro, or Belo Horizonte), the United States (Palo Alto, Durham, Washington D.C. or Miami), or Canada (Toronto) . Diversity & Inclusion / Equal Opportunity At Nubank, we believe that diversity is essential to building the best products and services. We are committed to creating a welcoming work environment that respects and values diversity in all its forms, and we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. If you need accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know. This offer is conditional on meeting all applicable regulatory eligibility requirements and successful completion of background checks. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Miratech has coverage across 5 continents and operates in over 25 countries around the world. Miratech retains nearly 1000 full‑time professionals, and our annual growth rate exceeds 25%. Job Description We are looking for a Principal Genesys Cloud Professional Services Consultant to join our team and drive the delivery of innovative, enterprise‑grade contact center solutions. In this role, you will lead the design and implementation of advanced multi‑channel customer experience platforms, leveraging deep expertise in Genesys Cloud and modern contact center technologies. The ideal candidate combines strong technical leadership, hands‑on delivery experience, and the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable, high‑quality solutions. Responsibilities Serve as the primary technical point of contact for customers and internal stakeholders, providing expert consultancy on Genesys Cloud solutions. Lead the design and delivery of end‑to‑end technical solutions, including facilitating workshops, gathering requirements, and producing technical design documentation with stakeholder sign‑off. Analyze complex business and technical challenges to define scalable and effective solution architectures. Own and evolve the technical architecture of Genesys solutions, introducing new technologies and best practices where appropriate. Configure and optimize Genesys Cloud environments to align with changing business and operational needs. Lead the planning and execution of contact center deployments, migrations, and system upgrades. Act as the main escalation and coordination point for Genesys‑related matters, collaborating with internal teams and external vendors. Support production readiness activities and ensure smooth transition of contact center solutions into live environments. Qualifications 5+ years of hands‑on experience supporting and optimizing large, multi‑site, complex contact center environments. Experience in designing, implementing, and supporting Genesys Cloud solutions in enterprise settings. Proven expertise in building routing strategies and IVR workflows using Genesys Architect. Experience with CRM integration (e.g., Salesforce, MS Dynamics) with the Genesys Cloud environment. Strong background in infrastructure planning, solution design, deployment, and lifecycle management to ensure high availability and performance. Deep knowledge of SIP infrastructure, including SIP protocol, Session Border Controllers (SBC), and load balancing approaches. Experience with CX Cloud from Genesys and Salesforce.
