vagas.title: Senior Manager, Ceremonies
vagas.description: Senior Manager, Ceremonies Department: Events & Entertainment Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC27”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. THE POSITION The Ceremonies Senior Manager leads the end‑to‑end planning, creative development, and operational delivery of all official ceremonies for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, including the Opening and Closing Ceremonies, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Pre‑Match Ceremonies (PMC), the Final Match Half‑Time Show (if applicable), and all additional ceremonial moments. Reporting to the Head of Entertainment, this role is responsible for overseeing the full lifecycle of each ceremony—from planning and preparation through to live execution—ensuring full alignment with FIFA’s vision and brand standards. The role also manages the implementation of the operational delivery across the entire FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, in accordance with the Ceremonies Concept developed by FIFA. Working closely with the Entertainment team and key Functional Areas, the Ceremonies Senior Manager acts as the senior operational lead for all ceremony delivery, ensuring creative and operational approvals are met and delivering iconic, culturally resonant moments that celebrate women’s football on its biggest global stage. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Ceremonies Project Leadership Lead the operational delivery and implementation of the Ceremonies Concept provided by FIFA. Manage the end-to-end planning and delivery of all official ceremonies across the FWWC27 tournament. Oversee ceremonies planning and delivery from concept development through preproduction, execution, dissolution, and legacy handover. Ensure full alignment with the Entertainment team in Zurich across all ceremonial workstreams. Manage the approval process for all ceremony related creative and operational deliverables. Provide senior decision-making support on creative direction, technical feasibility, and operational prioritisation. Lead the development of ceremony operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and show formats for all ceremonies, including PMC. Coordinate with Venue Management, Broadcast, Safety & Security, and other Functional Areas to integrate ceremonies seamlessly into matchday and event day operations. Act as the senior escalation authority for all ceremony related operational matters. Ensure all ceremonies reflect the approved creative vision, brand standards, cultural sensitivities, and tournament wide entertainment strategy. Team Leadership Manage and mentor the Ceremonies Team, providing clear direction, performance oversight, and accountability structures. Mentor and support all Ceremonies personnel, including fulltime staff, freelancers, and event time workforce, ensuring consistent standards, development pathways, and operational readiness. Support internal talent development through coaching, guidance, and structured feedback. Build team structures and optimize collaboration across creative, technical, and operational units. Foster strong coordination between venue based ceremonies teams to maintain consistency in delivery standards and operational execution. Foster strong teamwork, knowledge exchange, and operational alignment with the Stadium Entertainment Team to ensure unified delivery across all entertainment and ceremonial workstreams. Major Ceremonies Oversight Manage planning and delivery management for all major ceremonial events, including: Opening Ceremony, Closing Ceremony, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Final Match Half-Time Show (if applicable), Pre-Match Ceremonies throughout the tournament Ensure that each major ceremony reflects the ambition, brand standards, and cultural significance of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Creative & Concept Development / Creative Concept, Content Production & Management Collaborate with the Entertainment team to develop and refine the ceremonial concept and creative direction for each ceremony. Integrate host country cultural elements into ceremonial programming in a meaningful, authentic, and respectful way. Oversee creative brief development, content commissioning, and pre-production workflows with internal teams and external agencies. Ensure all creative content — including music, graphics, videos, scripts, translations, choreography and performances — is approved and locked in line with operational timelines. Manage stakeholder approval pathways to ensure content is delivered and archived in accordance with operational requirements. Manage IP and copyright compliance for all ceremony content. Planning Scheduling & Documentation Develop and maintain detailed project plans, WIP reports, and milestone trackers for all ceremony workstreams. Ensure all operational and creative decisions are fully documented and version controlled. Manage multiple suppliers, conduct regular update meetings, coordinate implementation processes, and supervise payments and reporting. Prepare written and oral presentations, high-level briefings, and reports for senior leadership and FIFA counterparts. Organize and participate in Review, Project Team, and Status Update meetings. Lead the creation, management, and archiving of project plans, workflows, venue documentation, and readiness tools across all ceremony workstreams. Manage the development of operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and rehearsal programmes for all ceremonies. Ensure readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and oversee execution on the day of each event. Act as the key operational decision-maker to maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies. Oversee rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals and stakeholder coordination for all ceremonies. Direct venue-level pre-production processes including technical surveys, staging assessments, and infrastructure planning. Supplier & Budget Management Lead early stage budget modelling, scenario planning, and resourcing strategies to support creative and operational planning. Develop and manage Scopes of Work, Procurement activities, supplier evaluations, contract negotiations, in line with FWWC27 management and procurement policies. Manage procurement activities for stadium entertainment suppliers, including RFP development, evaluation, and contract negotiation. Maintain full budget oversight including forecasting, cost control, variations, and invoicing. Manage budget oversight for the stadium entertainment workstream, including forecasting, cost control and invoicing. Ensure contractual deliverables and timelines are aligned with preproduction schedules and operational readiness requirements. Conduct regular supplier update meetings and coordinate implementation processes. Supervise payments, deliverables and performance reports from entertainment suppliers. Stakeholder & Functional Area Liaison Act as the senior liaison between the Ceremonies Team and all relevant Functional Areas, including Venue Operations, Broadcast, Safety & Security, Marketing, and FIFA SPE. Deliver concise briefings, alignment updates, and escalation management across all internal and external stakeholders. Build and maintain relationships with Host Country national bodies, cultural organizations, and local partners contributing to ceremonies. Ensure early phase cross functional integration to support seamless operational delivery. Venue Readiness & Execution Lead preparation of Site Operational Plans (SOPs), ceremony production schedules, and PMC rundowns. Direct venue level preproduction processes including technical surveys, staging assessments, performer logistics, and infrastructure planning. Ensure readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and oversee execution on the day of each event. Act as the key operational decision maker to maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies. Oversee rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals and stakeholder coordination. Ensure all creative and technical elements are validated during pre event testing and rehearsal phases. Other Duties Perform additional responsibilities as required by senior managership aligned with project delivery. Represent the Ceremonies function in cross-functional planning forums and senior managership briefings. Support the Head of Entertainment in strategic planning, operational readiness, and tournament wide entertainment integration. YOUR PROFILE Education Bachelor's degree or similar level of higher education or equivalent in industry experience. Experience 7+ years' experience in live event production and ceremonies management, ideally within major international sporting events or large-scale public events. Prior experience in a FIFA tournament or comparable major international sports event is highly desirable. Demonstrated experience managing complex, large-scale ceremonies including opening/closing ceremonies and awards presentations. Proven track record in team managership, creative development, supplier management, and cross-functional coordination. Significant experience managing RFP/procurement processes and overseeing multi-supplier contracts and budgets. Experience integrating cultural programming and working with national cultural bodies and creative agencies. Skills & Competencies ADMINISTRATIVE SKILLS: Ability to manage office and production documentation including, RFPs, presentations, show rundowns, rehearsal schedules, scripts, and permits accurately. ADAPTABILITY: Ability to adapt to evolving creative direction and operational challenges in high-pressure environments. FLEXIBILITY: Willingness to work irregular hours, including evenings and weekends, across the full tournament period. COMMUNICATION SKILLS: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; able to manage complex stakeholder relationships at a senior level. ORGANIZATIONAL SKILLS: Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent ceremony workstreams to tight deadlines. PROBLEM‑SOLVING SKILLS: Strategic and creative approach to problem‑solving; ability to make clear decisions under pressure. CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLABORATION: Proven ability to work collaboratively across internal teams and diverse functional areas, ensuring alignment and contributing to the successful achievement of delivery goals. INTERPERSONAL SKILLS: Builds effective working relationships across internal and cross‑functional teams, applying strong interpersonal skills to support smooth coordination and operational alignment CULTURAL SENSITIVITY: Deep awareness and respect for diverse cultures; committed to ensuring ceremonies are inclusive, authentic, and globally resonant. PASSION FOR ENTERTAINMENT: Genuine passion for live performance, ceremony production, and the power of sport to inspire. Certifications & Requirements Fluent in English and Brazilian Portuguese. Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning/collaboration tools. Experience of Monday.com an advantage. Knowledge of and previous event / tournament experience across the stadiums in Brazil a plus The right to work in Brazil. Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Mecânico Diesel
vagas.description: Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua nos segmentos automotivo e do agronegócio, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução. O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada. No segmento de concessionárias Scania, a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac(AM e RR). No segmento do agronegócio, por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP), a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo. Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil, empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia. Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkotruck, uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. vagas.description: Position Summary The Senior Finance Analyst – Clinical Solutions Portfolio is a strategic, business‑partnering role responsible for portfolio‑level financial analysis across Clinical Solutions departments. The primary focus is project and portfolio financial health, including forecasting, budget performance, and financial controls, with an expanding remit into trial operations KPIs and measures as they relate to budget integrity, scope control, and delivery efficiency. This role requires a strong background in Project Finance within a CRO environment , excellent analytical and presentation skills, and the ability to engage credibly with department heads and senior operational leaders. Main Duties & Responsibilities Own and deliver portfolio‑level financial analysis for Clinical Solutions departments, including budget health, forecast accuracy, margin performance, and risk identification. Lead project financial oversight across the full project lifecycle, from award through closeout, ensuring adherence to financial best practices and internal controls. Perform variance analysis (actuals vs. forecast vs. budget) to identify drivers of change, scope creep, and emerging risks. Partner with project finance teams to ensure consistency and integrity of project‑level data feeding portfolio reporting. Support and enhance departmental forecasting and planning processes using clear, supportable assumptions. Monitor budget consumption, earned value indicators, and change order impacts across portfolios. Provide forward‑looking insights to support proactive financial decision‑making by operational leadership. Contribute to the continuous improvement of financial processes, controls, and reporting standards. Develop and maintain trial operations KPIs and measures that link operational performance to financial outcomes (e.g., enrollment pace vs. burn, milestone progress vs. revenue, site activity vs. cost). Leverage Excel and Power BI to create scalable dashboards and analyses that support portfolio governance and executive review. Translate complex financial and operational data into clear, actionable insights for non‑finance stakeholders. Act as a trusted finance partner to Clinical Solutions department heads, supporting planning, performance reviews, and strategic initiatives. Prepare and deliver high‑quality presentations and executive‑ready materials summarizing portfolio performance, risks, and recommendations. Support ad‑hoc analyses and special projects requested by Finance leadership, Clinical Operations leadership, or executive management. Collaborate closely with Project Management, Clinical Operations, Data Management, and Finance teams to ensure alignment between operational execution and financial reporting. Minimum Education & Experience Bachelor’s degree (or its international equivalent) + 5 years of related experience. Preferred Education & Experience (optional) Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field (or its international equivalent). Approximately 5-8 years of relevant experience in project finance, FP&A, or operational finance, with a strong preference for CRO or clinical research industry experience. Demonstrated experience managing or analysing clinical trial portfolios and complex project financials. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (financial modelling, scenario analysis, large data sets). Working knowledge of Power BI or similar BI/visualization tools. Strong presentation and communication skills, with experience presenting to senior leaders and department heads. Solid understanding of clinical trial financial drivers, project lifecycles, and contract/budget mechanics. Knowledge, Skills & Competencies Strong financial and analytical acumen with the ability to connect operational activity to financial outcomes. Executive presence and confidence interacting with senior operational leaders. Ability to synthesize complex data into clear narratives and recommendations. High attention to detail balanced with a portfolio‑level, strategic mindset. Self‑motivated, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a fast‑paced, matrixed environment. Compensation Reasonable estimate of the current range: $76,400 CAD - $114,600 CAD. This role is also eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, health insurance, retirement savings benefits, life insurance and disability benefits, parental leave, and paid time off for sick leave and vacation, among other benefits. vagas.description: Sobre o hospital Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II. O Hospital possui dez andares com serviços de emergência, UTI adulta, pediátrica e neonatal, maternidade, clínica médica, cirurgia geral, bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem e laboratoriais são realizados na unidade. Responsabilidades e atribuições Executar e supervisionar manutenções preventivas e corretivas em sistemas de refrigeração e climatização. Diagnosticar falhas técnicas e atuar diretamente na solução de problemas críticos. Acompanhar a equipe técnica, distribuindo atividades e monitorando a execução dos serviços. Atuar de forma ativa em campo, sendo referência técnica para a equipe. Realizar intervenções em chillers, fancoils, splits, câmaras frigoríficas e sistemas de ventilação. Executar reparos em tubulações, incluindo brasagem (solda) e vedação. Acompanhar o desempenho dos equipamentos, prevenindo falhas e paradas. Elaborar relatórios técnicos e manter histórico de manutenção atualizado. Apoiar o controle de estoque de peças e insumos. Garantir o cumprimento das normas de segurança, qualidade e meio ambiente. Atender a todos os princípios e critérios de conduta contidos no Manual de Conformidade Administrativa – Políticas e Princípios de Integridade da SPDM. Executar as atribuições relativas à proteção de dados pessoais (LGPD). Realizar as atividades das áreas/setores, seguindo as determinações do gestor imediato e as padronizações da Instituição. Requisitos e qualificações Ensino médio completo. Curso técnico em Refrigeração, Mecânica, Eletromecânica ou áreas correlatas. Certificações na área de refrigeração e climatização serão consideradas diferenciais. Informações adicionais Bairro: Santa Cruz Escala: Diarista – Segunda a Sexta Horário: 08h00 às 17h00 #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Senior Forex Business Development Executive
vagas.description: Overview DB Investing is a fast‑growing, award‑winning global brokerage firm regulated by multiple international authorities. We offer a globally recognized online trading platform that provides clients access to financial markets with advanced technology, client‑centric services, and tailored investment solutions. With a solid presence in multiple jurisdictions and a strong commitment to transparency and innovation, we empower traders and partners alike to grow and succeed. Role Overview The Senior Business Development Executive will play a critical role in acquiring and managing key partnerships, driving revenue growth through a high‑value IB network, and expanding DB Investing’s footprint in the global market. Key Responsibilities Portfolio Management – Leverage and bring your existing IB portfolio to DB Investing to generate immediate and long‑term revenue. Business Acquisition – Identify and onboard new IBs, affiliates, and institutional partners in target markets. Relationship Building – Maintain strong, long‑term relationships with partners, providing ongoing support and engagement strategies. Revenue Growth – Work towards predefined sales targets and KPIs to drive consistent and scalable business growth. Market Analysis – Stay informed of market trends, competitor activity and regulatory changes to identify opportunities and threats. Cross‑functional Collaboration – Work closely with marketing, compliance, and operations teams to ensure smooth onboarding and service delivery. Reporting – Provide timely and accurate sales forecasts, pipeline updates and performance analysis to senior management. Candidate Requirements Experience – Minimum 3–5 years of proven experience in business development or sales within the Forex industry or financial services sector. IB Network – Must possess a transferable and active IB portfolio. Industry Knowledge – In‑depth understanding of FX, CFDs, trading platforms and global financial market dynamics. Sales Expertise – Strong track record of meeting or exceeding business development targets. Soft Skills – Exceptional interpersonal, communication and negotiation skills. Languages – Fluency in English is required; additional languages are an asset. Work Ethic – Self‑motivated, proactive and able to work both independently and within a team structure. What We Offer Competitive base salary Lucrative performance‑based commissions Bonus schemes and incentives Access to a leading trading platform with global reach Marketing and operational support to grow your network Dynamic, diverse, and supportive work environment Why Join DB Investing Reputable and compliant broker with a strong brand in global markets Advanced technology and tools tailored for high‑performing partners Transparent and fast onboarding process for IBs and partners Comprehensive partner portal and marketing kits to support your success #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Customs Brokerage Analyst
vagas.description: Carry out internal and/or external PO management and customs clearance activities; Monitor the customer's order with the supplier, in order to guarantee customs clearance of the cargo; Perform customs clearance of cargo, aiming to serve the customer within the expected deadline; Maintain relationships with partners and/or suppliers, aiming for customer satisfaction, quality and agility in customs operations; Ensure the opening of import and export processes, in all necessary computerized systems used by CRANE, rigorously analyzing the shipping documentation received, aiming to meet all legal requirements for customs clearance; Monitor the shipment of cargo coming from abroad so that customs clearance takes place quickly; Analyze and suggest tariff classifications for products to be imported or exported; Issue calculations regarding actual values and/or estimates of taxes, fees, fines, expenses involved in import and/or export processes; Actively exercise, autonomously, in the processes of issuing and checking DI, DSI, LI, LSI, DA, DTA, rectifications, petitions, Terms of Responsibility, RE, DE, SD, DSE, ACC, ACE, Certificate of Origin, Ata Carnet, contracting and settlement of exchange, aiming to quickly enable customs clearance; Monitor the approval of LI with the consenting bodies (Anvisa, Ibama, ANP and Ministry of the Army); Monitor the deadlines granted by Public Bodies for atypical import and export processes; Perform services relating to atypical import and export processes, such as: used material, special deposits, temporary admission, drawback, among others; Monitor processes through the systems: Federal Revenue: MANTRA/SISCOMEX/VICOMEX/ E-CAC and others, perhaps, used in Comex; Maintain standard deadlines and costs for carrying out customs clearances; Ensure the collection of taxes, merchant shipping and other mandatory fees and expenses for the release of cargo; Intense follow-up with the customer/suppliers used in the customs clearance processes; Perform services relating to the opening of Radar, powers of attorney and documentation required for customs clearance; Answer questions from customers and suppliers, including questions regarding billing; Collaborate so that billing takes place in a timely manner, in accordance with company policy; Archive all documentation of import and export processes in accordance with legal regulations and company policy; Completing all follow-up reports with accurate information, responding in real time; Prepare reports on critical processes. Other Skills & Abilities: Ability to perform research and make determinations in a fast-paced, quality-focused environment. Sense of urgency and attention to detail are critical; Perform data entry and draft opinion papers; Maintain an organized work environment; Effectively communicating import requirements to clients; Clock hours in time management software for consulting engagements; Provide support to consulting team members; Keep informed of latest news and developments impacting trade and regulatory compliance; Experienced in using MS Word, Excel, Outlook; Strong organizational and time management skills; Strong proficiency in classifying goods under the HTS; HTS classification strength with the oil and gas industry desirable; Be able to work in a fast-paced and dynamic work environment; #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: PESSOA TÉCNICO DE IMOBILIZAÇÃO ORTOPÉDICA - HOSPITAL CASA SANTA CRZ  - CLT/RJ - VAGA INCLUSIVA PCD
vagas.description: Técnico de Imobilização Ortopédica - Rede Hospital Casa - CLT Somos a Rede Hospital Casa, um dos maiores operadores médicos hospitalares independentes do estado do Rio de Janeiro. O ACOLHIMENTO COMO NOSSO JEITO DE CUIDAR está entre os nossos principais valores. Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar como Técnico de Imobilização Ortopédica que seja proativo, cuidadoso, dedicado e que tenha atenção e amor com seus processos de trabalho. Suas principais atividades serão: Assumir o posto de serviço conforme escala, devidamente identificado, uniformizado e com aparência pessoal adequada; Identificar corretamente o paciente antes de realizar o procedimento; Preparar paciente para procedimentos de imobilização ortopédica; Preparar material para confeccionar as imobilizações; Preparar sala para pequenos procedimentos fora do centro cirúrgico, como pequenas suturas e anestesia local para manobras de redução manual, punções e infiltrações; Observar o tipo de imobilização a confeccionar, as condições do paciente, seguindo orientações e prescrição médica; Confeccionar imobilizações e aparelhos gessados nas salas de gesso e cirurgia; Confeccionar imobilizações com material sintético, aparelhos gessados, goteiras gessadas, esparadrapagem, talas digitais (imobilização para os dedos), enfaixamento, tração cutânea, colar cervical, entre outros, conforme prescrição médica; Retirar aparelhos de imobilização ortopédica, conforme prescrição médica; Utilizar de forma adequada equipamentos como serra elétrica vibratória; Realizar procedimentos específicos em imobilizações ortopédicas, como a abertura de janelas no aparelho gessado; Manter sala de imobilização organizada; Zelar pela limpeza da sala, bem como organização e preservação e guarda de materiais e equipamentos de uso na sua especialidade; Auxiliar o médico ortopedista em procedimentos ortopédicos não cirúrgicos, como na instalação de trações esqueléticas e manobras de redução manual; Realizar lançamento e registro em prontuário dos procedimentos realizados e materiais utilizados; Promover orientações pertinentes e de conservação da imobilização aos pacientes; Auxiliar a equipe multidisciplinar em imobilizações de pacientes vítimas de trauma ou que necessitem de restrição total de movimento; Obedecer às normas técnicas da Sociedade Brasileira de Ortopedia e Traumatologia (SBOT), às normas internacionais para confecção de imobilização, normas regulamentadoras de Segurança do Trabalho e o Código de Ética Profissional; Notificar a equipe de enfermagem toda e qualquer ocorrência administrativa; Notificar a equipe de enfermagem toda ocorrência durante atendimento ao paciente; Participar de treinamentos institucional e setorial quando solicitado sua participação; Cumprir as normas e regulamentos da Instituição, bem como as rotinas operacionais da sua Unidade; Respeitar e conhecer os instrumentos normativos do setor como instruções de trabalho. Esperamos que você tenha: Ensino médio completo com curso técnico em imobilização ortopédica. Registro no conselho de Classe. Desejável experiência anterior de 06 meses. Noções básicas de Primeiros Socorros a pacientes vítimas de trauma, Higiene ocupacional, biossegurança e ergonomia, equipamentos e Materiais ortopédicos. Noções de Ortopedia e Traumatologia. Conheça os benefícios que oferecemos para você: Vale Transporte; Refeição no Local; Convênio Médico; Convênio Odontológico; Horário de trabalho Escala 12x36 Possui todos os requisitos e se identifica? Venha fazer parte da nossa casa! Get notified about new Orthopedic Technician jobs in Greater Rio de Janeiro . #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Promotor De Vendas
vagas.description: Overview O Promotor de Vendas é responsável por promover e impulsionar a comercialização de produtos em estabelecimentos do comércio varejista e atacadista, atuando diretamente no ponto de venda e junto aos clientes. Realiza a apresentação e demonstração dos produtos, esclarecendo dúvidas, destacando suas características, qualidades e vantagens, bem como oferecendo degustações ou distribuindo amostras quando aplicável. É responsável pela organização, exposição atrativa e reposição de mercadorias em gôndolas, balcões e pontos estratégicos de venda, garantindo a correta precificação e a boa apresentação dos produtos. Controla a entrada e saída de mercadorias, realiza inventários para reposição e acompanha o nível de estoque no ponto de venda. Planeja e executa atividades de vendas especializadas, incluindo visitas a clientes, acompanhamento do pós-venda e participação em ações promocionais, campanhas e eventos. Mantém contato com áreas internas da empresa, contribuindo com sugestões de políticas comerciais e promocionais. Elabora relatórios de vendas, promoções, demonstrações e pesquisas de preços, fornecendo informações relevantes para análise de desempenho e tomada de decisão. Principais Atividades Promover e demonstrar produtos no ponto de venda; Atender clientes, esclarecendo dúvidas e destacando características e benefícios dos produtos; Organizar, abastecer e repor mercadorias em gôndolas, balcões e pontos estratégicos; Garantir a correta precificação e boa apresentação dos produtos; Controlar entrada e saída de mercadorias e realizar inventários para reposição; Executar ações promocionais, degustações e distribuição de amostras, quando aplicável; Realizar visitas a clientes, acompanhar o pós-venda e participar de eventos; Elaborar relatórios de vendas, promoções e pesquisa de preços. Facilidade para trabalhar com metas e atendimento ao público. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.description: * Decline will set your Cookie preferences to "Required" and will prevent Kyndryl and its partners from collecting and using Cookie data to collect statistics and to provide you a personalized web experience and more relevant ads on third party websites.Project Manager page is loaded## Project Managerremote type: In Personlocations: Rio De Janeiro, Braziltime type: Full timeposted on: Posted Todayjob requisition id: R-60487**Who We Are**At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.**The Role**Kyndryl Project Managers oversee the delivery of major projects within scope, schedule, and budget. You’ll be the driving force for every aspect of a program’s success, and the “conductor” who orchestrates everyone’s efforts to make beautiful music together. As the single point of contact to the client, you’ll also be the living embodiment of Kyndryl’s reputation every day. As Project Manager, you have command of a very full and detail-oriented calendar. You’ll be constructing detailed project plans, managing teams, and leading meetings, status calls, and planning and cadence meetings. You will analyze and mitigate risks, manage finances, make sure the team has the right skills, then plan and delegate activity to hit deadlines, deliver on SLAs, and generally delight our clients. Of course, plans often evolve as a project unfolds, so you’ll need to practice continuous structural thinking and take ownership for value delivery, not just task scheduling. But as important as planning and organization are, communication is 90% of the job. You’re the single point of contact with the client, partners, and all stakeholders, supporting them and ensuring they get what they need. You’re also the bridge to every other team on the project, including both technical and account roles. The result is an exciting multicultural, often multilingual environment. Bottom line: You need to like interactions with other people and know how to be kind and empathetic but also assertive — and handle customer change requests with diplomacy. You’re going to be meeting a lot of people, networking, and forging relationships. Our “one team with the customer” concept means you’ll develop especially strong partnerships with the client and elsewhere. Some projects or clients even involve “embedding” with the client at their location. This puts more visibility on you personally, but it also gives you more opportunity to add value to the relationship. This is one of the things Kyndryls love about working here. It’s a great way to hone your service and people skills, and it lays the groundwork for career growth both laterally and vertically. Your future at Kyndryl Becoming a Project Manager at Kyndryl is an excellent gateway to many different paths. You’ll be creating a well-rounded skillset while gaining professional certifications and qualifications. You can evolve horizontally into other technical or non-technical areas such as Technical Service Architect, or you can move vertically to become a senior project manager or program manager. There are many different types and flavors of PM roles, so everyone can find the opportunity that suits them best.**Who You Are**You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required Technical and Professional Experience • SCRUM or Project Management skills • Basic TI knowledge (architectural) • Organization and planning skills • Teamwork with “one team” philosophy • Fluent in English (written and verbal – OR OTHER RELEVANT LANGUAGE, AS NEEDED) Preferred Technical and Professional Experience • MS Project or other Project Management software • Excellent written and verbal communication skills • Ability to interact confidently with stakeholders of all levels**Being You**The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.**What You Can Expect**Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.**Get Referred!**We’re glad you’re here. Take a look around at the many exciting career opportunities we have available and apply today! **Drop off your CV/Resume** and a Recruiter will reach out with related career information that match your experience and expertise. **Sign up for Job Alerts** Create your account and then . When new jobs become available that meet your criteria, you’ll be alerted right away!### Drive progress with purposeAt Kyndryl, we achieve progress the world depends on, with purpose.**Beginning with** **the purpose that matters to you**. Because here, you will be part of a culture designed with purpose. One that is restless, empathetic and devoted. Where we are committed to sustainable progress for our customers and supporting the communities where we work and live. All of you is what we want. And what we need. Join us, and together, we can advance the vital systems that power human progress. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Event Controller
vagas.description: Event Controller Department: Finance Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team. THE POSITION Under the responsibility of the FIFA27 Head of Finance and in collaboration with the FIFA Finance division in Zurich and the Senior Event Controller, the Event Controller will support in Brazil the budget and forecast process throughout the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ project lifecycle providing finance business partnering and support to the various budget owners and to FIFA27 senior management. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Implementation Phase Assist with the implementation of the FIFA budgeting and reporting tools and organize hands‑on training with the budget owners in Brazil. Prepare cash flow forecast requirements in connection with the Brazilian operational budget. Planning & Operational Phase Support in Brazil the financial planning and budget review processes working closely with the FIFA Senior Event Controller (based in Zurich) and with all budget owners (Zurich and Brazil based). Work closely with the FIFA27 Senior Event Controller, to implement FIFA Finance processes in Brazil and to support a smooth consolidation of the full tournament operational budgets. Assist the presentation of the quarterly forecast exercise as well as recommended corrective actions (when necessary) to the various stakeholders. Support the accrual process at year-end supporting the FIFA Zurich and FIFA27 accounting teams and the various budget owners. Assist the review of monthly cost allocations to various project codes and prepare re-allocation journals when required. Support the preparation monthly management reports providing insightful commentary for budget owners and senior management. Monitor and maintain monthly cash flow forecasts, reflecting the Brazilian operational budget, to ensure the liquidity needs of FIFA27 are met. Perform ad-hoc analysis and prepare additional financial reports as requested by the Head of Finance and senior management. YOUR PROFILE Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field. Minimum 5 years of experience in accounting and Financial Planning & Analysis. Experience with budgeting and reporting tools. Experience in preparing financial statements, preferably in a multi‑entity environment. Experience in an international environment. Experience in procurement of advantage. SAP experience preferred. Well‑developed organisational skills with an ability to prioritize your workload and meet strict deadlines. Excellent written and verbal communication skills to facilitate business partnering. Have a proactive hands‑on approach to problem solving – a ‘can do’ attitude. Strong attention to detail and a focus on quality and accuracy. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Excel, Power BI Word & PowerPoint presentation. Ability to work independently and with a team in a fast‑paced and high‑volume environment. Right to work in Brazil. Fluent in English (spoken and written). Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written). vagas.description: O que nos move? Claro, a paixão por esportes é indiscutível, mas também somos grandes amantes de inovação constante! Buscamos soluções digitais que conectem clubes, federações, ligas e marcas ao público de forma eficaz e inovadora. Nosso objetivo é construir um ecossistema que sustente o esporte nas próximas décadas, integrando o melhor do digital e da TV. É assim que estamos fazendo história e queremos encontrar mais pessoas que acreditem no potencial do que estamos construindo e queiram fazer parte disso. Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar como Desenvolvedor de Soluções com IA na equipe de Projetos em Rio de Janeiro . Como Desenvolvedor de Soluções com IA , sua missão será transformar oportunidades identificadas pelas áreas da empresa em soluções reais, construídas com inteligência artificial — do protótipo à produção, com qualidade e documentação , impulsionando não apenas nossa presença no mercado, mas também a forma como o esporte é vivenciado globalmente. Responsabilidades Desenvolver soluções baseadas em IA a partir de oportunidades identificadas pelas áreas da empresa; Construir agentes, fluxos automatizados e integrações com IA que evoluem de protótipos para soluções em produção, com qualidade e documentação; Implementar pipelines e automações garantindo facilidade de manutenção e legibilidade para outros membros do time; Contribuir com a evolução das soluções de IA corporativas seguindo os padrões técnicos definidos pelo time de engenharia; Identificar oportunidades de reaproveitamento de dados, bases e sistemas existentes, transformando-os em ativos úteis para múltiplas áreas; Acompanhar, corrigir e evoluir soluções em produção desenvolvidas pela área; Criar e manter documentação técnica que permita que as soluções sejam operadas e evoluídas por outros membros do time — inclusive por IA. Requisitos necessários Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas; Experiência prática com uso de LLMs em aplicações reais (automações, agentes, copilotos, etc.); Fluência em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação (Python ou JavaScript); Experiência com APIs REST e integração entre ferramentas e sistemas; Capacidade de transformar uma demanda pouco estruturada em solução funcional, com suporte do time quando necessário; Capacidade de operar a partir de backlog qualificado — recebendo oportunidades estruturadas e transformando-as em entregas técnicas sem precisar conduzir discovery completo; Boa comunicação para explicar soluções técnicas para pessoas não técnicas. vagas.title: Principal Product Manager, HTS API Marketplace
vagas.description: About the Role We are seeking an exceptional Principal Product Manager to build the HTS API Marketplace — the commercial and developer-facing layer through which enterprise partners access Hopper's lodging and cars capabilities. This is a true 0-to-1 role. You will be the person who defines what it is: how capabilities are packaged and priced, how partners discover and integrate them, and how the marketplace evolves as a platform business. The underlying technical capabilities — connectivity orchestration, pricing and sort, content mapping, the extranet — are owned by dedicated capability teams. Your job is to work closely with those PMs to understand, package, and commercially expose those capabilities as coherent, enterprise-grade API products. We expect this PM to move fast and build scrappily. You should be comfortable using AI tools and vibe coding to prototype workflows, mock APIs, and test partner experiences before handing off to engineering. The best candidate will reach for a prototype before a PRD. You will partner with Engineering, Data Science, Commercial, Finance, and Supply — and coordinate tightly with other PMs across the organization — to bring the marketplace from concept to a revenue-generating platform. This is a fully remote role. What Would Your Day-to-day Look Like Define what the HTS API Marketplace is: how capabilities are structured, packaged, and priced across a portfolio spanning HTS Connect, Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing, Extranet, Taxes, and Custom Deals Engine. Coordinate with capability PMs — who own the underlying technical systems — to understand each capability's roadmap, constraints, and customization surface, and translate that into externally-consumable API products. Own the commercial model for the marketplace: platform vs. variable fee decisions, take rate structure per capability, enterprise packaging, and the custom deals framework for large partners with differentiated customer segments. Build the developer and partner experience from scratch: API specifications, partner onboarding flows, documentation standards, sandbox environments, and integration tooling that minimizes time-to-first-value. Use AI tools and rapid prototyping to test ideas quickly — mock API responses, prototype partner portals, simulate pricing and ranking configurations — before committing engineering resources. Establish the go-to-market motion for the marketplace: work with Commercial to identify the right partners for each capability, sequence launches, and define what a successful commercial rollout looks like. Own the marketplace revenue P&L: model and track GBV, take rate, and per-capability unit economics in partnership with Finance. Set the sequencing and prioritization across all capabilities — from in-progress work (HTS Connect, Taxes) through scoping-stage products (Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing) to capabilities not yet started (Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Extranet, Custom Deals Engine). Qualifications 7+ years of Product Management experience, with at least one 0-to-1 product you built from concept to commercial launch. Demonstrated experience building developer-facing or B2B marketplace products, including ownership of API product design, developer experience, and commercial packaging for enterprise customers. AI-native working style: you use LLMs and vibe coding as first-line tools for prototyping, not as novelties. You have built working demos, mockups, or proof-of-concepts using AI before handing work to engineering. Strong understanding of marketplace economics: take rates, supply-side incentives, demand-side optimization, and the design of platform vs. variable commercial models. Ability to coordinate effectively across multiple product teams — you can synthesize roadmaps, surface dependencies, and drive cross-team alignment without owning the underlying engineering. Experience working with external enterprise partners: translating commercial needs into product requirements and managing partner expectations through multi-phase rollouts. Strong fluency with SQL and large-scale transactional or operational datasets. Exceptional written and verbal communication, including the ability to write crisp API and product documentation. Bonus Experience in travel commerce (lodging, cars, flights) or adjacent industries such as fintech, ads, or marketplace infrastructure. Background in connectivity, distribution, or supplier technology (GDS, channel managers, OTA APIs). Prior experience in Engineering, Data Science, or a technical role. Familiarity with auction or deduplication mechanics, dynamic pricing systems, or recommendation and ranking models. Hopper supplements Social Security coverage for liability benefits with Private insurance to cover you and your loved ones from Day 1. Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!. Unlimited PTO. Flexdesk coworking All Access Pass AND Work-from-home stipend. Carrot Cash travel stipend. Hopper offers a monthly subsidy to pay for teleworking utilities. An entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business. Open communication with management and company leadership. Small, dynamic teams = massive impact. More About Hopper At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips. The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials. While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands. Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions. Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel. Monitor well operational risks, implement risk responses, and execute change control per the project risk management plan and well operational programs. Ensure compliance with Schlumberger policies and Integration PL standards, including standing orders. Prepare detailed procedures for specific critical operations (running casing, cementing, etc.) and associated contingency plans. Prepare daily cost estimates based on goods consumed and services provided. Review and approve invoices and reports on services performed and materials used. Manage and monitor operations communications with the goal of ensuring that stakeholders are kept informed and service providers are lacking any information that they need to perform their services. Prepare technical and operational calculations relevant to the well‑or rig‑site operations (e.g., cement volume). Participate in operational performance improvements and program changes with the project team. Review operational problems and support job incidents, changes, incident response and recovery, including coordination with the individual PLs and key contractors. vagas.title: Pricing & Payments Manager, Partner Strategy & Experience
vagas.description: Pricing & Payments Manager, Partner Strategy & Experience Amazon is the most customer-centric company on Earth. We need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people who are passionate about doing the right thing. We are looking for a Pricing & Payments Manager to lead the Pricing, Incentives, Payments & Disputes function within Amazon's Last Mile Brazil organization. This role owns the end-to-end strategy and execution of partner pricing models, incentive programs, payment accuracy, and dispute resolution across our Amazon Partner Logistics programs — EDSP (External Delivery Service Provider), AMPL (Amazon Partner Logistics), and AMXL (Amazon Extra Large). As a People Manager, you will lead and develop a team of specialists, set the strategic direction for pricing and payment mechanisms, build scalable processes, and drive cross‑functional alignment with Finance, Operations, and Procurement to ensure partner economics are competitive, accurate, and sustainable. This position is based out of an Amazon corporate office and may require periodic travel. If you are passionate about partner economics, operational excellence, and building high‑performing teams, you should join our team. Key job responsibilities Lead, coach, and develop a team of Pricing, Incentives, Payments & Disputes specialists, fostering a culture of ownership, analytical rigor, and continuous improvement Own the end‑to‑end pricing strategy for logistics partners across EDSP, AMPL, and AMXL programs, ensuring competitive and sustainable rate structures Design, implement, and optimize incentive programs that drive partner performance, network efficiency, and cost effectiveness Oversee the payment lifecycle — from invoice validation and payment accuracy to dispute identification, root‑cause analysis, and resolution Build and maintain scalable mechanisms for pricing governance, incentive tracking, payment reconciliation, and dispute management Develop structured reporting and dashboards to monitor pricing competitiveness, incentive ROI, payment accuracy, and dispute aging/resolution rates Partner cross‑functionally with Finance, Operations, Procurement, and Legal to align pricing models with business objectives and contractual frameworks Identify and drive automation opportunities to reduce manual intervention in payment and dispute processes Conduct periodic pricing benchmarking and market analysis to ensure Amazon's partner economics remain competitive Manage escalations related to partner payments and disputes, ensuring timely resolution and stakeholder alignment Define and track KPIs for the team, establishing clear goals, performance standards, and development plans for direct reports A day in the life Your day starts with metrics review and the team's priorities. Your focus centers on strategic decisions that shape partner economics across EDSP, AMPL, and AMXL. You lead cross‑functional negotiations with Finance, Operations, and Procurement to align pricing models with business objectives. You assess incentive program ROI, recommending adjustments to optimize cost efficiency and partner performance. You review payment accuracy dashboards, identifying systemic gaps and designing scalable mechanisms to address them. Between meetings, you coach your team on stakeholder influence and data‑driven storytelling. Every day balances strategic thinking, cross‑functional alignment, and talent development to drive sustainable partner economics at scale. About the team The Pricing & Payments team is part of Amazon Logistics' Partner Strategy & Experience organization, supporting the EDSP, AMXL, and AMPL programs across Brazil — a network of +30 logistics partners and +300 operational nodes. Our mission is to ensure Amazon's logistics partners operate under competitive, transparent, and accurate pricing and payment frameworks, while driving performance through well‑designed incentive programs and efficient dispute resolution. We build scalable pricing models, payment governance mechanisms, and incentive strategies that balance cost efficiency with partner sustainability. The team sits within a broader strategic structure that also covers Compliance & Communications, Network Health & Performance, and VAS & DA Experience — working cross‑functionally to support Amazon's Last Mile growth in Brazil. Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent in business, operations, logistics, supply chain or engineering Speak, write, and read fluent in English Experience managing and developing high‑performance teams Experience conducting sophisticated and creative analysis of complex data and translating results into actionable deliverables, messages, and presentations Experience working with cross‑functional teams across business development, marketing, operations, product development, legal, etc. Experience implementing scalable compliance solutions (technology, procedures, processes, etc.) in a regulated environment Experience in communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal in Portuguese & English Experience in deal management and pricing strategy, or financial consulting Preferred Qualifications MBA, or Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting or related field Experience using SQL or other analytical tools for conducting data analysis Experience with Lean or Six Sigma analytical techniques Experience in logistics Knowledge of Six Sigma, Lean manufacturing efforts, transportation and logistics, or fulfillment and distribution centers Experience in financial modeling, P&L management or analysis, or experience in tax, finance or a related analytical field Experience designing incentive programs or performance‑based compensation structures Experience building payment reconciliation or dispute management mechanisms at scale Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. vagas.title: Especialista em Arquitetura Soluções | Infra e Telecom - Arquitetura de Tecnologia
vagas.description: Descrição da vaga Nossa área de Tecnologia é um pilar fundamental dos nossos negócios, sendo responsável pela nossa transformação digital. Aqui criamos soluções tecnológicas sempre idealizando e desenvolvendo técnicas e processos de automação, seja para aprimorar a experiência de trabalho das nossas equipes ou aumentar a capacidade de entrega dos nossos produtos e serviços. Nós somos responsáveis por uma infraestrutura gigantesca que atende aos principais produtos de vídeo da Globo, como o Globoplay, Premiere e os Canais Globo. Além disso, somos responsáveis pela transmissão ao vivo de grandes eventos - desde os campeonatos estaduais de futebol, a Copa do Mundo, Olimpíadas, Rock in Rio e até as câmeras ao vivo do Big Brother Brasil, que fica disponível 24x7 para todos os assinantes do Globoplay. Desafios estratégicos: O mercado de mídia e entretenimento vive numa constante transformação, com variadas formas, comportamentos, plataformas e monetização do consumo de conteúdo. Múltiplas empresas de diferentes segmentos competem pela atenção e pelo bolso do consumidor e dos anunciantes. Essa constante transformação vem muito da própria evolução da tecnologia no mundo. Nesse cenário, a Globo vem buscando diferentes segmentos de audiência, novos produtos, novas estratégias de distribuição, novas formas de operar e novos modelos de negócio. Para suportar tanta transformação, precisamos entender os movimentos da indústria, o mercado cliente, a nossa estratégia de negócio, as tendências de tecnologia, nossas alavancas e nossos gaps. Projetar novas capacidades de tecnologia, transformar algumas e, buscar inovação e parcerias, se faz absolutamente necessário. Atuação de Arquitetura: A Arquitetura de Tecnologia da Globo, busca profissionais que possam trabalhar na interseção entre estratégia de negócio, tecnologia e a execução. A área tem a missão de desenhar e propor estratégias, arquiteturas e roadmaps de evolução tecnológica para diversos domínios de negócio e foundations de tecnologia da empresa. Faz isso com uma abordagem focada nos principais desafios transformacionais da empresa, nos níveis estratégico e tático e de maneira muito colaborativa com outras áreas de tecnologia e do negócio. A área se estrutura nos papéis de arquitetura corporativa, arquitetura de soluções e arquitetura de dados & IA. Traga sua experiência em benchmarks da indústria, mapas de capacidades, arquiteturas de referência, análises de gaps e buy or build e, construção de visões de futuro e roadmaps de tecnologia. O que a área te oferece de oportunidade: Vai conduzir trabalhos de grande visibilidade que influenciam decisões estratégicas de tecnologia Você vai ter um conhecimento amplo da empresa e da indústria de mídia Vai desenvolver um olhar transversal e estratégico entre as capacidades de negócio e tecnológicas de toda a empresa Diversidade: Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação. Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido (RJ ou SP) Responsabilidades e atribuições Como será seu dia a dia: Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de Infraestrutura e Telecom, garantindo alinhamento com a estratégia tecnológica e de negócio da companhia; Construir e manter modelos arquiteturais, mapas de capacidades, princípios, padrões e roadmaps tecnológicos para orientar decisões executivas e estruturantes de I&T; Produzir desenhos arquiteturais de alto nível conectando domínios, plataformas e capacidades tecnológicas; Atuar de forma crítica e consultiva junto às áreas técnicas, questionando soluções, identificando lacunas e propondo direcionamentos estruturantes; Avaliar impactos arquiteturais de novas iniciativas, tecnologias e decisões estratégicas; Incorporar o conceito de AI-First Architecture nas decisões e modelos arquiteturais, promovendo automação, inteligência operacional e uso estratégico de dados; Comunicar e apresentar conceitos arquiteturais para públicos técnicos e executivos. Ponto de atenção: Os resultados imediatos do trabalho desta posição são decisões que vão influenciar a esteira de execução. Portanto, diferentemente de uma área de delivery de software ou operação, as mudanças são sentidas no médio e longo prazo. Requisitos e qualificações Do que você precisa: Formação superior em carreiras de tecnologia, como engenharias, ciência da computação, etc; Pós-graduação ou especialização em Arquitetura, Tecnologia, Telecom, Cloud ou áreas afins. Inglês Avançado/Nativo para leitura, escrita e comunicação; Experiência como arquiteto corporativo, arquiteto de domínio ou arquiteto de soluções; Experiência em ambientes tecnológicos complexos, distribuídos, híbridos ou multicloud; Vivência em Infraestrutura, Telecomunicações ou ambos, com capacidade de sustentar decisões arquiteturais nesses domínios; Experiência na definição de arquiteturas e direcionamentos técnicos em contextos de transformação tecnológica ou organizacional; Experiência em modelagem de capacidades (Capability Mapping) e construção de modelos arquiteturais; Capacidade de definir princípios, padrões e roadmaps tecnológicos; Domínio em infraestrutura on-premises, cloud ou ambientes híbridos; Entendimento de resiliência, disponibilidade, escalabilidade, automação e observabilidade em plataformas tecnológicas; Expertise em arquitetura de redes, conectividade e serviços de telecom; Entendimento conceitual de IA e suas relações com infraestrutura e telecom. Conhecimentos que te destacam: Experiência em ambientes multicloud ou arquiteturas híbridas complexas; Experiência com infraestrutura como código e automação de plataformas; Vivência em telecom definidos por software (SDN / NFV); Experiência em integração entre ambientes on-premises e cloud; Conhecimento em uso de IA em operações de tecnologia (AIOps ou Enterprise AI Solutions Architecture); Experiência anterior em arquitetura de soluções, engenharia ou operações, combinada com visão sistêmica; Os seus dados pessoais serão utilizados para fins de seleção de candidatos para preenchimento das vagas abertas na Globo. Todos os dados coletados serão tratados segundo rígidos padrões de segurança da informação e em total respeito às leis de privacidade aplicáveis, incluindo a Lei 13.709/18, e nos termos de nossa política de privacidade, disponível no link: Ao prosseguir você está ciente e de acordo para realização de sua candidatura nestes termos. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Manager, Ceremonies
vagas.description: Department: Events & Entertainment Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. THE POSITION The Ceremonies Manager supports the end to end planning, creative development, and operational delivery of all official ceremonies for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, including the Opening and Closing Ceremonies, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Pre Match Ceremonies (PMC), the Final Match Half Time Show (if applicable), and all additional ceremonial moments. Reporting to the Head of Entertainment, the Ceremonies Manager supports the planning and operational delivery of all official ceremonies, working closely with the Senior Manager and wider Entertainment team to ensure alignment with FIFA’s vision, brand standards. The role supports and coordinates the implementation of the operational delivery across the entire FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, ensuring that all ceremonies are executed in accordance with the Ceremonies Concept developed by FIFA. Working closely with the Entertainment Team and key Functional Areas, the Ceremonies Manager supports the Senior Manager in coordinating the operational delivery of ceremonies, contributing to creative and operational review processes and helping ensure the execution of iconic, culturally resonant moments that celebrate women’s football on its biggest global stage. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Ceremonies Project Leadership Support the operational delivery and implementation of the Ceremonies Concept provided by FIFA. Support the end-to-end planning and delivery of all official ceremonies across the FWWC27 tournament. Oversee ceremonies planning and delivery from concept development through pre-production, execution, dissolution, and legacy handover. Ensure full alignment with the Entertainment team in Zurich across all ceremonial workstreams. Manage the approval process for all ceremony related creative and operational deliverables. Provide senior decision making support on creative direction, technical feasibility, and operational prioritisation. Lead the development of ceremony operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and show formats for all ceremonies, including PMC. Coordinate with Venue Management, Broadcast, Safety & Security, and other Functional Areas to integrate ceremonies seamlessly into match day and event day operations. Escalate ceremony related operational matters. Ensure all ceremonies reflect the approved creative vision, brand standards, cultural sensitivities, and tournament wide entertainment strategy. Team Leadership Support the Ceremonies Team by contributing to day-to-day coordination, operational readiness, and delivery standards. Assist with the onboarding and support of Ceremonies personnel—suppliers, freelancers, and event-time workforce—helping ensure consistent standards and operational preparedness. Contribute to internal talent development through daily guidance, structured feedback, and knowledge sharing. Support effective collaboration across creative, technical, and operational units. Contribute to coordination between venue-based ceremonies teams to maintain consistency in delivery standards and operational execution. Foster strong teamwork, knowledge exchange, and operational alignment with the Stadium Entertainment Team to ensure unified delivery across all entertainment and ceremonies workstreams. Major Ceremonies Oversight Support the planning and delivery processes for all major ceremonial events, including Opening Ceremony, Closing Ceremony, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Final Match Half-Time Show (if applicable), Pre-Match Ceremonies throughout the tournament. Ensure that each major ceremony reflects the ambition, brand standards, and cultural significance of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™. Creative & Concept Development / Creative Concept, Content Production & Management Support the development and refinement of the ceremonial concept and creative direction for each ceremony in collaboration with the Entertainment Team. Contribute to the integration of host country cultural elements into ceremonial programming in a meaningful, authentic, and respectful manner. Assist in the creation of creative briefs, content commissioning, and pre-production workflows in coordination with internal teams and external agencies. Contribute to stakeholder approval processes to ensure all content is delivered, documented, and archived in line with operational requirements. Support IP and copyright compliance across all ceremony-related content. Planning Scheduling & Documentation Maintain detailed project plans, WIP reports, and milestone trackers for all ceremony workstreams. Ensure operational and creative decisions are fully documented and version controlled. Coordinate with multiple suppliers and conduct regular update meetings, coordinate implementation processes, and supervise payments and reporting. Prepare written and oral presentations, high-level briefings, and reports for senior leadership and FIFA counterparts. Organize and participate in Review, Project Team, and Status Update meetings. Support the creation, management, and archiving of project plans, workflows, venue documentation, and readiness tools across all ceremony workstreams. Contribute to ensuring readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and provide operational support on event days. Support operational decision-making to help maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies. Assist with rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals, and stakeholder coordination for all ceremonies. Support venue level preproduction activities, including technical surveys, staging assessments, and infrastructure planning. Supplier & Budget Management Support procurement processes as directed by the Ceremonies Senior Manager, including supplier briefing and evaluation. Manage day-to-day relationships with entertainment suppliers and contractors at assigned venue(s). Assist with budget management tasks, including forecasting inputs, cost tracking, variation documentation, and invoice processing, ensuring accuracy and timely follow-up. Help monitor contractual deliverables and timelines, ensuring they remain aligned with preproduction schedules and operational readiness requirements, and escalute risks to the Senior Manager as needed. Stakeholder & Functional Area Liaison Act as a liaison between the Ceremonies Team and all relevant Functional Areas, including Venue Operations, Broadcast, Safety & Security, Marketing, and FIFA SPE, in coordination with the Senior Manager. Deliver concise briefings and alignment updates across all internal and external stakeholders. Support the building and maintenance of relationships with Host Country national bodies, cultural organizations, and local partners contributing to ceremonies. Ensure early phase cross functional integration to support seamless operational delivery. Venue Readiness & Execution Support preparation of Site Operational Plans (SOPs), ceremony production schedules, and PMC rundowns. Direct venue level pre-production processes including technical surveys, staging assessments, performer logistics, and infrastructure planning. Contribute to ensuring readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and support execution on the day of each event. Act as the key operational decision maker to maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies. Assist in rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals, and stakeholder coordination. Ensure all creative and technical elements are validated during pre-event testing and rehearsal phases. Other Duties Perform additional responsibilities as required by management aligned with project delivery. Represent the Ceremonies function in cross-functional planning forums and management briefings. Support the Head of Entertainment in strategic planning, operational readiness, and tournament‑wide entertainment integration. YOUR PROFILE Education Bachelor's degree or similar level of higher education or equivalent in industry experience. Experience 5+ years' experience in live event production and ceremonies management, ideally within major international sporting events or large-scale public events. Prior experience in a FIFA tournament or comparable major international sports event is highly desirable. Demonstrated experience managing complex, large-scale ceremonies including opening/closing ceremonies and awards presentations. Proven track record in team managership, creative development, supplier management, and cross-functional coordination. Experience managing RFP/procurement processes and overseeing multi-supplier contracts and budgets. Experience integrating cultural programming and working with national cultural bodies and creative agencies. Skills & Competencies ADMINISTRATIVE SKILLS: Ability to manage office and production documentation including RFPs, presentations, show rundowns, rehearsal schedules, scripts, and permits accurately. ADAPTABILITY: Ability to adapt to evolving creative direction and operational challenges in high-pressure environments. FLEXIBILITY: Willingness to work irregular hours, including evenings and weekends, across the full tournament period. COMMUNICATION SKILLS: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; able to manage complex stakeholder relationships at a senior level. ORGANIZATIONAL SKILLS: Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent ceremony workstreams to tight deadlines. PROBLEM-SOLVING SKILLS: Strategic and creative approach to problem-solving; ability to make clear decisions under pressure. CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLABORATION: Proven ability to work collaboratively across internal teams and diverse functional areas, ensuring alignment and contributing to the successful achievement of delivery goals. INTERPERSONAL SKILLS: Builds effective working relationships across internal and cross-functional teams, applying strong interpersonal skills to support smooth coordination and operational alignment. CULTURAL SENSITIVITY: Deep awareness and respect for diverse cultures; committed to ensuring ceremonies are inclusive, authentic, and globally resonant. PASSION FOR ENTERTAINMENT: Genuine passion for live performance, ceremony production, and the power of sport to inspire. Certifications & Requirements Fluent in English and Brazilian Portuguese. Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning/collaboration tools. Experience of Monday.com an advantage. Knowledge of and previous event / tournament experience across the stadiums in Brazil a plus. The right to work in Brazil. Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr
