vagas.title: Especialista Lean
vagas.description: Descrição da vaga A Supergasbras é uma empresa do grupo holandês SHV Energy, líder mundial na distribuição de Gás liquefeito de Petróleo (GLP), com mais de 100 anos de experiência. Nosso negócio é levar energia limpa e eficiente para milhões de brasileiros, seja nas suas casas, comércios, indústrias ou agronegócio. Os mais de 76 anos de atuação no Brasil nos posiciona como uma das principais distribuidoras nacionais de GLP - comercializamos cerca de 1,5 milhão de toneladas do produto por ano com aproximadamente 20% de participação de mercado. Desenvolvemos uma série de projetos com foco em transformação digital, experiência do cliente, inovação e desenvolvimento sustentável do negócio. Nossa estratégia é conseguir através da confiança e integridade, ser a melhor empresa de Energia do Brasil para nossos clientes, parceiros, colaboradores e acionistas, com responsabilidade socioambiental. Diversidade e inclusão é uma prioridade de negócios para a Supergasbras. Valorizamos e acreditamos no desenvolvimento de pessoas, tanto no contexto profissional como pessoal, tendo como estratégia a equidade de gênero, inclusão de pessoas com deficiência, respeito a todas as orientações sexuais e luta contra a discriminação racial nas diferentes camadas da sociedade. Ser diverso é ser Super! Esta oportunidade também está publicada no portal global de vagas da SHV Energy e faz parte do nosso compromisso de atrair talentos que compartilham dos nossos valores, independente da localização. Responsabilidades e atribuições Objetivo Do Cargo Facilitar e promover mudança organizacional disseminando as práticas de Lean Manufacturing na matriz da Supergasbras. Responsabilidades Influenciar, engajar e desenvolver as lideranças em todos os níveis transferindo o conhecimento necessário para as áreas progredirem e liderarem a sua implementação no futuro; Prover conhecimento especializado na transformação cultural; Desenvolver e treinar os funcionários e a liderança na aplicação das ferramentas de Lean Manufacturing e Seis Sigma; Ajudar na identificação de projetos de melhoria, garantindo que estejam alinhados aos objetivos do negócio; Realizar avaliações para confirmar o progresso e estágio de maturidade e garantir que os times entendem os gaps para atingimento das metas estabelecidas Requisitos e qualificações Requisitos Obrigatórios Ensino Superior Completo em engenharia, administração ou área afins, além da certificação Lean Six Sigma Master Black Belt ou equivalente; Desejável certificação Master Black Belt; 5-7 anos de experiência em condução de transformações culturais usando Lean, 6 sigma, TPM ou WCM; Excelente habilidade de influenciar e motivar diferentes níveis organizacionais; Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas; Conhecimentos do Office 365; Inglês intermediário a avançado. Informações adicionais Ser Super tem muitas vantagens, veja o que oferecemos para você: Saúde e Bem-estar: Assistência Médica, Odontológica e Gympass Alimentação de Qualidade: Vale Alimentação e Ticket Refeição Planejar sonhos: Participação nos Resultados e Previdência Privada Família: Licença maternidade/ paternidade estendida Desenvolvimento: Universidade Corporativa e Convênios de Aprendizagem Curtir o Aniversário: Folga no mês do aniversário Outros: Benefícios exclusivos Ao confirmar a candidatura, você está automaticamente aceitando nossa Política de Privacidade, que encontra-se no link: O que faz a gente ser Super? Somos uma empresa que valoriza as pessoas e tudo o que elas representam: a energia das ideias, da contribuição, da parceria e da colaboração. Por isso, nos dedicamos a construir um ambiente de trabalho propício ao desenvolvimento humano e profissional dos nossos colaboradores, sempre incentivando a interação, a participação ativa e o crescimento. Gostamos de quem acrescenta, porque acreditamos que o sucesso vem da soma da energia com a colaboração. E o que nós fazemos exatamente? Somos uma empresa do Grupo SHV Energy, líder mundial na distribuição de GLP e uma das principais distribuidoras de gás LP no Brasil, com mais de 75 anos de atuação. Possuímos o mais moderno parque engarrafador da América Latina e contamos com mais de 20 unidades industriais distribuídas pelo país, de norte a sul. Nossos mais de 4 mil colaboradores nos enchem de orgulho pelo que somos e pelo que fazemos, levando energia para mais de 10 milhões de famílias brasileiras, alcançando locais onde nenhum outro tipo de energia consegue chegar. Além disso, atendemos mais de 60 mil clientes empresariais, desde pequenos comércios até grandes indústrias, incluindo o agronegócio. Vem ser Super com a gente! #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Lead Portfolio Manager - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package
vagas.description: This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package. Professional English skills are required. Job Overview We are seeking a Lead Portfolio Manager to join the Portfolio Management Department (PMD). Key Responsibilities Continuously assess portfolio company performance against original investment thesis. Identify thesis erosion risks and recommend strategic realignment where necessary. Provide structured shareholder-level perspective on long-term strategic positioning. Develop and implement structured Value Creation Plans (VCPs) following investment close. Establish measurable financial and operational targets (EBITDA growth, ROACE improvement, cash generation, working capital efficiency). Monitor implementation rigor and quantify value capture. Lead periodic value realization reviews. Review reinvestment proposals and capital allocation decisions at portfolio company level. Evaluate liquidity, leverage, covenant compliance, and refinancing risk. Assess capital efficiency relative to Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC) and shareholder return expectations. Recommend capital structure optimization initiatives. Assess governance effectiveness, including Board and sub-committee structure. Support Aramco-nominated Directors with analytical pre-briefs and recommendations in advance of meetings. Ensure reporting transparency and alignment with Aramco governance standards. Promote disciplined decision-making at Board level. Monitor variance against approved budgets and long-range plans. Identify emerging operational or financial risks. Recommend structured corrective actions and elevate material risks to the CIO where appropriate. Monitor industry trends, competitive positioning, and macroeconomic developments. Translate market developments into shareholder-level implications. Identify growth, consolidation, and restructuring opportunities within the portfolio. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management, Engineering, or related discipline from an accredited university. An Advanced degree is preferred. Minimum 10 years of experience in Private Equity, Sovereign Wealth Funds, Direct Industrial Investments, Consultants with experience of designing and implementing value creation plans and turnaround plans, and Investment Banking (restructuring / industrial sector coverage) Experience in the Middle East or in emerging markets more broadly is a plus. Analizar variações nos parâmetros de reservatório, poço e superfície, determinando seus impactos no desempenho do sistema de produção. Postura inquisitiva, explorando novas ideias e questionando. Habilidade para resolver problemas de complexidade intermediária, aplicando aptidões fundamentais e específicas da área técnica ou científica. Atuar com orientação geral e revisão periódica do trabalho, demonstrando adaptabilidade em contextos sujeitos a alterações imprevisíveis e de complexidade variável. Design the concept of operations, venue operating plan, and all relevant A&D policies and procedures. Integrate with other LFS Transport workstreams and event transport functions for airport pick‑ups and drop‑offs. Coordinate with meet and greet companies regarding VIP arrivals and departures services. Contribute to the slot allocation plan of host city airports, ensuring priority for FWWC2027‑related aircraft movements. Ensure successful integration of FWWC2027 air traffic into the overall international airline schedule. Participate in Airport/Mobility Working Groups, ensuring air traffic matches airport and terminal capacities. Plan, develop, and deliver the tournament operational plan for the airport (airside and landside operations), integrating it with transportation plans and other transport services. Achieve successful delivery of the final operational plan, ensuring smooth operations for all constituent groups. Implement project management within A&D and airport management, identifying key milestones and risks. Prepare content and reports for FWWC2027 management meetings and working group meetings. Recruit, hire, assign responsibilities, and manage the A&D team throughout planning and delivery, ensuring appropriate staffing levels. Develop and maintain training materials and coordinate operational workshops and briefings for all airport staff. Provide regular reports to the Transport Senior Manager, FIFA counterparts, and key stakeholders on progress, issues, and decisions. Support test events, rehearsals, and operational readiness exercises, overseeing signage, transport desk, wayfinding, etc. Maintain real‑time communication with the Transport Command and Control, providing updates on incidents, delays, and emerging issues, and ensuring rapid escalation. YOUR PROFILE Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree in Transport/Logistics/Civil Engineering/Project Management/Event Management or related combination; Master’s Degree is an additional asset. Experience Minimum ten (10) years of event Arrivals and Departures (airport operations) experience in international major events, including no fewer than three world‑class sport or football events (e.g., FIFA World Cup, Olympic Games). Minimum five (5) years of management experience in a similar role within an organizing committee, leading large teams for time‑critical projects. Proven experience delivering transport projects and airport operations projects of similar size and scale. Experience working with public and private sector partners, building strong partnerships. Skills Advanced knowledge of administration and management principles. Strong leadership, business process management, communication, interpersonal and negotiation skills. Ability to design, implement and operate a transport system in the Brazilian event environment. Advanced knowledge of transportation technical operating processes. Motivational skills to drive multidisciplinary teams through changing priorities. Corporate and project‑focused communication capabilities. Proven project management skills in complex projects. English language fluency, both written and spoken. Strong analytical and organisational skills. Solution‑oriented decision‑making capabilities. Capacity to work under pressure and meet immutable deadlines. Requirements Right to work in Brazil. Bilingual – Portuguese and English. Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Aqui, cada pessoa pode evoluir em sua jornada profissional. Valorizamos o desenvolvimento, com oportunidades de crescimento que vão de posições operacionais até cargos de liderança. Venha crescer com a gente e fazer parte dessa história! From Speech to Practice Garantir o atendimento de qualidade ao cliente na farmácia, prestando informações precisas sobre medicamentos e produtos, mantendo a organização, higiene e abastecimento das seções, e apoiando a equipe de gestão e o farmacêutico na operação diária da loja. vagas.title: Senior Process Optimization (RTO/ROMeo) & Digital Twin (PST) Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabi[...]
vagas.description: This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat position with an attractive relocation package. Please note only qualified candidates will be contacted. *** Candidates with Chemical Engineering degree and 17-25 years of experience in Refinery Only*** ***English proficiency (written and spoken) required. Submit CV in English for consideration*** Overview We are seeking an experienced Process Simulation Twin (PST) and Optimization Engineer to join our Reliability Solutions Department (RSD) within our Global Manufacturing Excellence Center. Global Manufacturing Excellence (GME) is the recognized Center of Excellence driving value across Saudi Aramco’s Downstream Global manufacturing portfolio. Your primary role is to deploy and sustain online process simulations (process digital twins), perform process optimization activities to identify opportunities, monitor process performance KPIs and develop advanced process optimization data-enabled solutions. This role sits at the boundary of process engineering and digitalization beyond traditional process simulation roles. You will be responsible for bridging the gap between rigorous thermodynamic models, process digital twins, real-time process data and hybrid analytics through AI. Key Responsibilities As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following: Lead the development, deployment, and sustainment of PST that integrate real-time process data with rigorous equation-oriented or sequential simulation engines in alignment with corporate objectives. Configure and troubleshoot the connectivity between plant historians, laboratory information systems, and simulation software to ensure seamless data ingestion and reconciliation. Utilize PST to perform automated monitoring of facility health, detecting deviations between ideal performance and actual plant operations to identify opportunity gaps. Develop and maintain thermodynamic models and mathematical equations that accurately represent the behavior of various processes ensuring the PST accurately reflects the current state of the facility (including heat exchanger fouling, catalyst decay, etc.). Perform offline engineering studies using PST to analyze complex operational problems, debottleneck constraints, and conduct "what-if" scenarios based on current operating conditions. Act as the technical liaison between data teams and Operations/Process Engineering teams, leading technical sessions on model architecture, data quality, and commissioning. Lead process optimization sessions to de-bottleneck key process units such as CDU/VDU, Hydrocrackers, Catalytic crackers, Diesel Hydrotreaters, Isomerization. Benchmark process optimization KPIs with 15+ operating facilities and provide development of programs, processes, guidelines and best practices. Provide subject matter expertise to operating facilities Operations, Maintenance, and Engineering teams by consulting, providing awareness sessions, and participating and leading technical exchanges and conferences. You must hold a Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering. You will have a minimum of 15 years of experience in Process Simulations, Online Modeling, or Real-Time Optimization (preferably ROMeo). 20 years of experience is preferred. You will be able to Demonstrate expertise in process engineering and flowsheet-based processes simulation. Preferred Equation Oriented simulation. You will have comprehensive understanding of refinery facilities, feedstock/product movements, margins, giveaways, process yields, and mass and energy balances. Demonstrated experience connecting simulations to live data sources (Data Historians, OPC, etc.). Strong understanding of data reconciliation, model tuning, and dealing with gross errors in industrial data is also required. Work Location and Work Schedule Work location: Within Saudi Arabia – To be specified in Job offer Work schedule: Full Time - To be specified in Job offer #J-18808-Ljbffr

Contributes to a community that is inclusive, culturally sensitive and equitable, and in which everyone experiences a strong sense of belonging. Responsabilidades e atribuições Payroll Processes Process all monthly payroll transactions and ensure compliance with the payroll calendar and deadlines. Perform calculations related to salaries, vacation pay, 13th-month salary, terminations, leaves of absence, allowances, deductions, taxes, and benefits. Ensure the accurate processing of hires, terminations, contractual changes, and employee status updates. Manage the submission, verification, and maintenance of all legal and statutory obligations, including eSocial, FGTS, INSS, income tax withholding (IRRF), and other labor requirements. Calculate payroll-related provisions, including vacation accruals, payroll taxes, and other labor liabilities, supporting financial controls and budgeting processes. Submit all required payroll information to eSocial. Independent Contractors and Vendors Administration Register independent contractors and vendors in the RM Labore and MXM systems. Assign and validate the appropriate accounting classifications in MXM. Import data from RM Labore to process payments through MXM. Employee Onboarding Manage the full onboarding process, including document collection and scheduling pre-employment medical examinations through the Gupy system. Coordinate and deliver onboarding materials to the Admissions area. Time and Attendance Management Register new employees in the Clockin system. Administer time and attendance records through the MY HR – Clockin portal and ensure proper integration with payroll processing. Accounting Support Process DARF tax payments. Prepare and provide payroll-related information for monthly accounting reconciliations. Support internal and external audits by providing documentation and compliance evidence. Occupational Health and Safety Register employees in the SOC system. Issue Work Accident Reports (CAT) when required. Support employees and service teams with questions related to INSS (Social Security) matters. Ensure confidentiality and security of payroll information and employees’ personal data. Innovation and Change Projects Support system improvement and implementation projects. Identify opportunities for process automation and system enhancements. School-Specific Responsibilities Support compliance with policies, regulations, and requirements applicable to the education sector. ---- Processos de folha de pagamento: Processar todas as movimentações da folha de pagamento mensal e garantir toda a rotina dentro do calendário de pagamento; Realizar cálculos de salários, férias, 13º salário, rescisões, afastamentos, adicionais, descontos, encargos e benefícios. Garantir o correto processamento de admissões, desligamentos, alterações contratuais e movimentações funcionais. Atuar no envio, conferência e manutenção das obrigações legais e acessórias, incluindo eSocial, FGTS, INSS, IRRF e demais exigências trabalhistas. Calcular provisões trabalhistas relacionadas à folha, férias e encargos, apoiando controles financeiros e orçamentários. Envio de todas as informações ao e-social Cadastro e pagamento de autônomos e fornecedores: Cadastrar autônomos e fornecedores no sistema de RM labore e no MXM. Homologar nas devidas contas contábeis no MXM; Importar informações do RM labore para realizar pagamentos através do MXM; Admissão de funcionários: Realizar todo o processo de admissão desde a coleta de documentos e solicitação para realização de exame admissional através do sistema Gupy; Entregar Kit admissional para área de admissão; Ponto de funcionários: Cadastro dos novos funcionários no sistema do Clockin Administrar controle de ponto através do portal MY HR - Clockin e devida importações para a folha de pagamento; Apoio contábil: Fazer pagamento dos DARFs; Emissões de informações para conferência contábil mensal. Segurança do trabalho Cadastro de funcionários no sistema SOC Emissão de CAT caso seja necessário Apoiar a área de atendimento em caso de dúvidas relacionadas ao INSS; Garantir confidencialidade e segurança das informações salariais e dados pessoais dos colaboradores. Projetos de inovação & mudanças: Apoiar os projetos de melhorias de sistemas; Identificar oportunidades de melhoria sistêmica e automação de processos; Responsabilidades Específicas do Contexto Escolar Apoiar o cumprimento de políticas e exigências regulatórias aplicáveis para a área de Educação. Basic English proficiency, with a strong interest in developing and improving language skills. Experience in a school or educational environment will be considered a plus. Experience with MXM and Gupy systems is also a plus, as well as experience in educational settings. Knowledge of labor, social security legislation, and eSocial. Technical Knowledge Payroll processing, social charges, and statutory obligations. Labor and social security legislation. Payroll and time and attendance systems. Google Workspace. Advanced Excel/spreadsheet skills. Data analysis and payroll calculation review. --- Ensino superior completo em Administração, Recursos Humanos, Contabilidade, Gestão de Pessoas ou áreas correlatas. vagas.description: Sobre a Vaga Na Laços Saúde, acreditamos que o cuidado deve ser um reflexo da individualidade de cada pessoa, promovendo a autonomia e a qualidade de vida dos nossos pacientes. Como parte do nosso compromisso com um modelo inovador de assistência, buscamos médicos geriátricos apaixonados pela transformação do cuidado à saúde no ambiente domiciliar, seguindo os princípios do modelo Buurtzorg, que prioriza o autocuidado e a manutenção das funcionalidades das pessoas em suas próprias comunidades. Qualificações Formação em Medicina com Residência em Geriatria, Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM). Experiência prévia em atenção domiciliar ou saúde comunitária será um diferencial. Paixão por promover o autocuidado e a autonomia dos pacientes, com abordagem centrada na pessoa. Habilidade em comunicação e empatia, fundamentais para estabelecimento de vínculos com pacientes e familiares. Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa e multidisciplinar, integrando ações que promovam a saúde do paciente no seu ambiente familiar. Proatividade na busca de soluções que promovam a qualidade de vida e a funcionalidade dos pacientes. Responsabilidades Atuar em consonância com os valores da organização, mantendo conduta focada em resultados do Cuidado, respeitando a individualidade de cada paciente e tornando a assistência personalizada. Registrar no Prontuário do Paciente as informações inerentes e indispensáveis ao processo de cuidado, mantendo-os atualizados. Ser representante da organização, zelando por suas premissas, prestando cuidado baseado em evidências científicas e melhores práticas. Realizar o Cuidado Integral ao Paciente, cuidando com empatia e carinho, estabelecendo vínculos e considerando as suas necessidades biopsicossociais. Garantir a continuidade da Assistência Médica por meio da execução do Plano de Cuidado estabelecido. Distribuir adequadamente a agenda de consultas, cumprindo a carga horária e número de atendimentos, conforme o contrato estabelecido. Sobre Nós Na Laços Saúde, a diversidade é o coração do nosso trabalho. Acreditamos que cuidar é um ato de amor e acolhimento, e isso se reflete em nossa equipe, que é composta por profissionais de diversas origens e experiências. O modelo Buurtzorg que adotamos é mais do que um método: é uma filosofia que prioriza o cuidado comunitário, respeitando a individualidade e as necessidades de cada pessoa. Aqui, cada dia é uma nova oportunidade de fazer a diferença na vida das pessoas. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Gerente de tributação
vagas.description: Estamos contratando Gerente Tributário para um de nossos clientes, gigante do setor de O&G, para atuar no Rio de Janeiro. Descrição do Cargo Liderar todas as atividades relacionadas à área tributária no Brasil, incluindo tributos diretos e indiretos, preços de transferência (transfer pricing) e reportes fiscais exigidos pela equipe corporativa global. Garantir total conformidade com a legislação tributária federal, estadual e municipal. Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de planejamento tributário para otimizar a posição fiscal da empresa e mitigar riscos tributários. Atuar como principal ponto de contato com auditores externos, consultorias tributárias e autoridades governamentais. Fornecer orientação especializada em questões tributárias relacionadas a contratos, novas iniciativas de negócios, transações internacionais que suportem as operações locais e atividades da empresa, assegurando conformidade, eficiência fiscal e adequada gestão de riscos. Monitorar e avaliar os impactos de mudanças na legislação tributária e da Reforma Tributária brasileira sobre as operações da companhia. Supervisionar a preparação e entrega de obrigações fiscais e auditorias, garantindo precisão e cumprimento dos prazos. Liderar auditorias locais e promover melhorias contínuas em políticas e processos tributários. Principais Responsabilidades Implementar, gerenciar e aprimorar estratégias de compliance tributário, adaptando-se ao ambiente regulatório dinâmico do Brasil, garantindo alinhamento com padrões globais e antecipando mudanças regulatórias. Assegurar a precisão dos cálculos e reportes fiscais para atendimento às exigências de compliance internas e externas, incluindo provisões em US GAAP, FIN 48, FAS 5, relatórios de auditoria, projeções de caixa e taxa efetiva de imposto (ETR). Atuar de forma proativa na implementação de soluções de tecnologia e automação para a área tributária. Desenvolver, capacitar e orientar a equipe. Incentivar a tomada de decisões baseada em dados, utilizando análises para identificar tendências de conformidade, otimizar estratégias fiscais e gerenciar riscos tributários de forma eficaz. Liderar todas as frentes relacionadas à Reforma Tributária no Brasil, garantindo aderência aos novos requisitos legais e coordenando equipes multidisciplinares para executar a estratégia financeira, assegurando conformidade tributária, otimização dos impactos financeiros futuros e gestão eficiente do fluxo de caixa. Requisitos Graduação em Ciências Contábeis, Direito Tributário ou área correlata. Experiência liderando departamentos tributários em empresas multinacionais. Vivência anterior em uma das Big Four será considerada um diferencial. Experiência robusta em gestão tributária, compliance fiscal e planejamento tributário. Sólido conhecimento da legislação tributária, processos de auditoria e normas de reporte financeiro. Capacidade de atuar de forma colaborativa com equipes multidisciplinares de Finanças e áreas de negócio. Experiência na gestão de equipes de grande porte. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Clerkship Coordinator - Psychiatry
vagas.description: Benefits & Wellness Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture For more information visit Basic Function The Clerkship Coordinator is responsible for the day‑to‑day administrative and operational management of the medical student clerkship within the Department of Psychiatry. This position serves as a key member of the undergraduate medical education team and supports the Clerkship Director in ensuring an organized, compliant, student‑centered educational experience. The Clerkship Coordinator manages scheduling, evaluations, educational activities, accreditation‑related documentation, student communications, and clerkship operations across clinical training sites. The position requires a high degree of independence, professionalism, discretion, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced academic clinical environment. Supervisory Accountability Reports directly to the Clerkship Director. May provide operational guidance to student workers and administrative support staff involved in clerkship activities. Nature and Scope The Clerkship Coordinator works closely with faculty, residents, medical students, faculty practice, hospital and affiliate site personnel, curriculum administrators, and institutional leadership to support the successful operation of the clerkship program. Internal Contacts Clerkship Directors Faculty and residents Medical students Department administrators Curriculum and Dean’s Office personnel Information technology and educational support staff External Contacts Affiliate hospitals and clinical training sites Accreditation representatives and surveyors Vendors and educational software support personnel Clerkship Operations and Administration Coordinate and manage all administrative aspects of the clerkship program. Develop, maintain, adjust and distribute student rotation schedules, call schedules, orientation materials, and clerkship calendars. Coordinate student assignments to clinical teams, faculty, and affiliate sites. Ensure students receive timely onboarding information, institutional requirements, and site‑specific documentation. Maintain accurate student records, schedules, and educational documentation. Student Assessment and Evaluation Management Manage evaluation processes within educational management systems (e.g., E*Value or equivalent platforms). Assign and monitor student evaluations by faculty and residents. Track completion of evaluations and elevate delinquent evaluations as appropriate. Assist with collection and tracking of mid‑clerkship feedback to ensure compliance with institutional and LCME requirements. Coordinate examination administration, proctoring, grading support, and exam‑security procedures as assigned. Generate reports related to student performance, evaluations, grading, attendance, and clerkship metrics. Assist clerkship director with final grade compilation and submission deadlines. Accreditation and Compliance Support Assist the Clerkship Director with maintaining compliance with LCME accreditation standards and institutional educational policies. Maintain organized records and documentation related to accreditation, curriculum review, required clinical experiences, and student assessments. Assist with preparation of reports, surveys, annual reviews, and accreditation materials. Monitor student completion of required clerkship activities, logs, assignments, and educational requirements. Educational Activity Coordination Coordinate lectures, conferences, small groups, simulation activities, and other educational sessions. Reserve rooms/prepare virtual links, prepare educational materials, and provide logistical support for educational activities. Assist faculty with audiovisual and educational technology needs as appropriate. Maintain lecture archives and educational materials on Blackboard Learn or LMS. Communication and Student Support Serve as a primary administrative contact for medical students during the clerkship. Communicate policies, schedules, deadlines, and expectations to students and faculty. Address routine student concerns and elevate issues appropriately to clerkship leadership. Maintain professionalism and confidentiality in handling sensitive student and faculty matters. Administrative and Financial Support Assist with departmental administrative processes related to the clerkship program. Prepare reports, correspondence, spreadsheets, and presentations. Support tracking of program‑related expenditures and administrative documentation as assigned. Coordinate meetings and maintain meeting materials and records. Student Recommendation Letters & Residency Application Support Coordinate collection of materials for Department Chair letters, Clerkship Director letters, scholarship letters, and specialty‑specific evaluations. Maintain a tracking system for all requested letters. ERAS / Residency Application Support. Upload and manage letters through Electronic Residency Application Service ERAS. Ensure timely submission of: Chair letters Clerkship Director letters Letters of Recommendation Department forms Coordinate standardized letters such as SLOE when required. Confirm deadlines and specialty‑specific requirements. Confidentiality / Professionalism Maintain FERPA‑compliant handling of student records and confidential recommendation materials. Additional Responsibilities Participate in departmental, institutional, and clerkship coordinator meetings and professional development activities. Perform other related duties as assigned in support of undergraduate medical education programs. Core Competencies Knowledge of undergraduate medical education operations and accreditation standards preferred. Strong organizational and project management skills with attention to detail. Ability to prioritize and manage multiple deadlines simultaneously. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work collaboratively. Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment. Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and educational management systems (e.g., E*Value, LMS platforms, exam software). Ability to analyze data and prepare reports. Ability to manage multiple deadlines and maintain accuracy in a fast‑paced, highly regulated educational environment. Minimum Requirements High school diploma or GED required. Minimum of 5 years of progressively responsible administrative, program coordination, healthcare, higher education, or medical education experience required. Or Associate degree and 3 years of relevant experience. Or Bachelor’s degree and 1 year of relevant experience. Experience in academic medicine, healthcare, higher education, or medical education preferred. Strong organizational, communication, and technology skills required. Experience with educational management systems and scheduling software preferred. Salary Range $55,000 - $60,000 Note: This position description should not be construed to imply that these requirements are the exclusive standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties, as may be required. The university has the right to revise this position description at any time. This position description is not be construed as a contract for employment. Compliance Salary Range Disclosure #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Clerkhship Coordinator - Internal Medicine
vagas.description: Here Is What We Offer Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture Basic Function The Clerkship Coordinator is responsible for the day‑to‑day administrative and operational management of the medical student clerkships within the Department of Internal Medicine, including the required third‑year Internal Medicine Clerkship and fourth‑year Sub‑Internship / advanced clinical rotations. This position serves as a key member of the undergraduate medical education team and supports the Clerkship Director in ensuring an organized, compliant, student‑centered educational experience. The Clerkship Coordinator manages scheduling, evaluations, educational activities, accreditation‑related documentation, student communications, and clerkship operations across clinical training sites. The position requires a high degree of independence, professionalism, discretion, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced academic clinical environment. Supervisory Accountability Reports directly to the Clerkship Director. May provide operational guidance to student workers and administrative support staff involved in clerkship activities. Nature and Scope The Clerkship Coordinator works closely with faculty, residents, medical students, Faculty Practice, Hospital and affiliate site personnel, curriculum administrators, and institutional leadership to support the successful operation of the clerkship program. Internal Contacts Include Clerkship Directors Faculty and residents Medical students Department administrators Curriculum and Dean’s Office personnel Information technology and educational support staff External Contacts May Include Affiliate hospitals and clinical training sites Accreditation representatives and surveyors Vendors and educational software support personnel Principal Accountabilities Clerkship Operations and Administration Coordinate and manage all administrative aspects of the clerkship program. Develop, maintain, adjust and distribute student rotation schedules, call schedules, orientation materials, and clerkship calendars. Coordinate student assignments to clinical teams, faculty, and affiliate sites. Ensure students receive timely onboarding information, institutional requirements, and site‑specific documentation. Maintain accurate student records, schedules, and educational documentation. Student Assessment and Evaluation Management Manage evaluation processes within educational management systems (e.g., E*Value or equivalent platforms). Assign and monitor student evaluations by faculty and residents. Track completion of evaluations and elevate delinquent evaluations as appropriate. Assist with collection and tracking of mid‑clerkship feedback to ensure compliance with institutional and LCME requirements. Coordinate examination administration, proctoring, grading support, and exam security procedures as assigned. Generate reports related to student performance, evaluations, grading, attendance, and clerkship metrics. Assist clerkship director with final grade compilation and submission deadlines. Accreditation and Compliance Support Assist the Clerkship Director with maintaining compliance with LCME accreditation standards and institutional educational policies. Maintain organized records and documentation related to accreditation, curriculum review, required clinical experiences, and student assessments. Assist with preparation of reports, surveys, annual reviews, and accreditation materials. Monitor student completion of required clerkship activities, logs, assignments, and educational requirements. Educational Activity Coordination Coordinate lectures, conferences, small groups, simulation activities, and other educational sessions. Reserve rooms/prepare virtual links, prepare educational materials, and provide logistical support for educational activities. Assist faculty with audiovisual and educational technology needs as appropriate. Maintain lecture archives and educational materials on Blackboard Learn or LMS. Communication and Student Support Serve as a primary administrative contact for medical students during the clerkship. Communicate policies, schedules, deadlines, and expectations to students and faculty. Address routine student concerns and elevate issues appropriately to clerkship leadership. Maintain professionalism and confidentiality in handling sensitive student and faculty matters. Administrative and Financial Support Assist with departmental administrative processes related to the clerkship program. Prepare reports, correspondence, spreadsheets, and presentations. Support tracking of program‑related expenditures and administrative documentation as assigned. Coordinate meetings and maintain meeting materials and records. Student Recommendation Letters & Residency Application Support Coordinate collection of materials for Department Chair letters, Clerkship Director letters, scholarship letters, and specialty‑specific evaluations. Maintain tracking system for all requested letters. ERAS / Residency Application Support. Upload and manage letters through Electronic Residency Application Service ERAS. Ensure timely submission of: Chair letters Clerkship Director letters Letters of Recommendation Department forms Coordinate standardized letters such as SLOE (Standardized Letter of Evaluation) when required. Confirm deadlines and specialty‑specific requirements. Confidentiality / Professionalism Maintain FERPA‑compliant handling of student records and confidential recommendation materials. Additional Responsibilities Participate in departmental, institutional, and clerkship coordinator meetings and professional development activities. Perform other related duties as assigned in support of undergraduate medical education programs. Core Competencies Knowledge of undergraduate medical education operations and accreditation standards preferred. Strong organizational and project management skills with attention to detail. Ability to prioritize and manage multiple deadlines simultaneously. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work collaboratively. Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment. Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and educational management systems (e.g., E*Value, LMS platforms, exam software). Ability to analyze data and prepare reports. Ability to manage multiple deadlines and maintain accuracy in a fast‑paced, highly regulated educational environment. Minimum Requirements High school diploma or GED required. Minimum of 5 years of progressively responsible administrative, program coordination, healthcare, higher education, or medical education experience required. Associate degree and 3 years of relevant experience. Bachelor’s degree and 1 year of relevant experience. Experience in academic medicine, healthcare, higher education, or medical education preferred. Strong organizational, communication, and technology skills required. Experience with educational management systems and scheduling software preferred. Salary Range $55,000 - $60,000 Note: This position description should not be construed to imply that these requirements are the exclusive standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties, as may be required. The university has the right to revise this position description at any time. This position description is not to be construed as a contract for employment. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Clerkship Coordinator - OBGYN
vagas.description: Here Is What We Offer Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture Basic Function The Clerkship Coordinator is responsible for the day-to-day administrative and operational management of the medical student clerkship within the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology. This position serves as a key member of the undergraduate medical education team and supports the Clerkship Director in ensuring an organized, compliant, student-centered educational experience. The Clerkship Coordinator manages scheduling, evaluations, educational activities, accreditation-related documentation, student communications, and clerkship operations across clinical training sites. The position requires a high degree of independence, professionalism, discretion, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced academic clinical environment. Supervisory Accountability Reports directly to the Clerkship Director. May provide operational guidance to student workers and administrative support staff involved in clerkship activities. Nature And Scope The Clerkship Coordinator works closely with faculty, residents, medical students, Faculty Practice, Hospital and affiliate site personnel, curriculum administrators, and institutional leadership to support the successful operation of the clerkship program. Internal Contacts Include Clerkship Directors Faculty and residents Medical students Department administrators Curriculum and Dean’s Office personnel Information technology and educational support staff External Contacts May Include Affiliate hospitals and clinical training sites Accreditation representatives and surveyors Vendors and educational software support personnel Principal Accountabilities Clerkship Operations and Administration Coordinate and manage all administrative aspects of the clerkship program. Develop, maintain, adjust and distribute student rotation schedules, call schedules, orientation materials, and clerkship calendars. Coordinate student assignments to clinical teams, faculty, and affiliate sites. Ensure students receive timely onboarding information, institutional requirements, and site-specific documentation. Maintain accurate student records, schedules, and educational documentation. Student Assessment and Evaluation Management Manage evaluation processes within educational management systems (e.g., E*Value or equivalent platforms). Assign and monitor student evaluations by faculty and residents. Track completion of evaluations and escalate delinquent evaluations as appropriate. Assist with collection and tracking of mid-clerkship feedback to ensure compliance with institutional and LCME requirements. Coordinate examination administration, proctoring, grading support, and exam security procedures as assigned. Generate reports related to student performance, evaluations, grading, attendance, and clerkship metrics. Assist clerkship director with final grade compilation and submission deadlines. Accreditation and Compliance Support Assist the Clerkship Director with maintaining compliance with LCME accreditation standards and institutional educational policies. Maintain organized records and documentation related to accreditation, curriculum review, required clinical experiences, and student assessments. Assist with preparation of reports, surveys, annual reviews, and accreditation materials. Monitor student completion of required clerkship activities, logs, assignments, and educational requirements. Educational Activity Coordination Coordinate lectures, conferences, small groups, simulation activities, and other educational sessions. Reserve rooms/prepare virtual links, prepare educational materials, and provide logistical support for educational activities. Assist faculty with audiovisual and educational technology needs as appropriate. Maintain lecture archives and educational materials on Blackboard Learn or LMS. Communication and Student Support Serve as a primary administrative contact for medical students during the clerkship. Communicate policies, schedules, deadlines, and expectations to students and faculty. Address routine student concerns and elevate issues appropriately to clerkship leadership. Maintain professionalism and confidentiality in handling sensitive student and faculty matters. Administrative and Financial Support Assist with departmental administrative processes related to the clerkship program. Prepare reports, correspondence, spreadsheets, and presentations. Support tracking of program-related expenditures and administrative documentation as assigned. Coordinate meetings and maintain meeting materials and records. Student Recommendation Letters & Residency Application Support Coordinate collection of materials for Department Chair letters, Clerkship Director letters, scholarship letters, and specialty-specific evaluations. Maintain tracking system for all requested letters. ERAS / Residency Application Support. Upload and manage letters through Electronic Residency Application Service ERAS. Ensure timely submission of: Chair letters Clerkship Director letters Letters of Recommendation Department forms Standardized letters such as SLOE (Standardized Letter of Evaluation) when required. Confirm deadlines and specialty-specific requirements. Confidentiality / Professionalism Maintain FERPA-compliant handling of student records and confidential recommendation materials. Additional Responsibilities Participate in departmental, institutional, and clerkship coordinator meetings and professional development activities. Perform other related duties as assigned in support of undergraduate medical education programs. Core Competencies Knowledge of undergraduate medical education operations and accreditation standards preferred. Strong organizational and project management skills with attention to detail. Ability to prioritize and manage multiple deadlines simultaneously. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work collaboratively. Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment. Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and educational management systems (e.g., E*Value, LMS platforms, exam software). Ability to analyze data and prepare reports. Ability to manage multiple deadlines and maintain accuracy in a fast-paced, highly regulated educational environment. Minimum Requirements High school diploma or GED required. Minimum of 5 years of progressively responsible administrative, program coordination, healthcare, higher education, or medical education experience required. Associate degree and 3 years of relevant experience. Bachelor’s degree and 1 year of relevant experience. Experience in academic medicine, healthcare, higher education, or medical education preferred. Strong organizational, communication, and technology skills required. Experience with educational management systems and scheduling software preferred. Salary Range: $55,000 - $60,000 Note: This position description should not be construed to imply that these requirements are the exclusive standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties, as may be required. The university has the right to revise this position description at any time. This position description is not be construed as a contract for employment. Compliance Salary Range Disclosure #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Médico Cirurgião Plástico - RJ
vagas.description: O Médico Cirurgião Plástico é um profissional especializado em realizar procedimentos cirúrgicos estéticos e reparadores. Ele atua na correção de imperfeições físicas, realizando cirurgias para melhorar a aparência e autoestima dos pacientes. Além disso, o Médico Cirurgião Plástico também pode atuar em procedimentos reconstrutivos, como cirurgias pós-traumáticas ou pós-cirurgias oncológicas. Realizar consultas pré-operatórias para avaliar as condições de saúde do paciente e definir o melhor procedimento cirúrgico a ser realizado. Realizar cirurgias plásticas estéticas, como rinoplastia, abdominoplastia, mamoplastia, lipoaspiração, entre outras, de acordo com as necessidades e desejos dos pacientes. Acompanhar o pós-operatório dos pacientes, orientando sobre os cuidados necessários para uma boa recuperação e realizando eventuais revisões. Manter-se atualizado sobre as novas técnicas e procedimentos na área de cirurgia plástica, participando de congressos, cursos e workshops. Trabalhar em equipe multidisciplinar, interagindo com outros profissionais de saúde, como anestesistas, enfermeiros e fisioterapeutas, para garantir o melhor atendimento aos pacientes. Zelar pela ética profissional, respeitando os princípios da medicina e garantindo a segurança e bem-estar dos pacientes em todos os procedimentos realizados. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Responsabilidades e atribuições Traduzir problemas de negócio em hipóteses, métricas e experimentos analíticos; Realizar EDA avançada, engenharia de atributos (feature engineering) e preparação de datasets de treinamento; Treinar e avaliar modelos (classificação, regressão, séries temporais, clustering, recomendação conforme demanda); Implementar pipelines de treino/inferência (ex.: notebooks + pipelines em Vertex AI, quando aplicável); Trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados em BigQuery e otimizar extrações para modelagem; Apoiar deploy inicial e handoff para produção com engenharia/MLOps (endpoints, batch scoring, jobs agendados); Documentar experimentos (métricas, versão de dados/modelo, decisões) e apoiar monitoramento (drift/performance, quando aplicável); Contribuir para componentes de agentes de IA (ex.: features, scoring, regras inteligentes, avaliação de performance do agente). Requisitos e qualificações Ensino Superior Completo; Python intermediário/avançado (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn; notebooks); Estatística aplicada e fundamentos de ML (validação, overfitting, métricas); SQL avançado e experiência com BigQuery; Familiaridade com GCP e ML (desejável: Vertex AI, pipelines, endpoints); Versionamento com Git e boas práticas de reprodutibilidade; Diferenciais: MLflow/experiment tracking, model registry, LLM/GenAI (quando aplicável), fundamentos de MLOps; Competências Técnicas Necessárias Modelagem estatística e ML; validação e métricas; Feature engineering e preparação robusta de dados; Leitura crítica de resultados e interpretação para negócio; Boas práticas de reprodutibilidade (versionamento, documentação). Competências Comportamentais Necessárias Pensamento crítico e rigor analítico; Proatividade e curiosidade científica; Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos; Colaboração com engenharia/produto/negócio. E tem mais, confira o nosso pacote de benefícios Plano de Saúde e Odontológico – Bradesco – extensivo a dependentes PAE - Auxílio financeiro oferecido no caso de dependentes filhos(as) e/ou enteados(as) com deficiência intelectual Convênio Farmácia . vagas.title: Admissions and Student Engagement Specialist
vagas.description: Benefits Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture For more benefits details, visit Job Purpose The Admissions & Student Engagement Specialist supports the full continuum of student engagement at the College of Dentistry—from initial applicant inquiry through enrollment and ultimately graduation. This position plays a critical role in the administrative, operational, and customer‐service functions of both admissions and student programs. The Specialist ensures efficient processing of applicant materials, contributes to the evaluation and interview process, and supports initiatives that enhance student engagement, orientation, retention, and milestone events. The individual in this role represents the College professionally to prospective students, applicants, families, external partners, and internal University stakeholders, demonstrating the College’s commitment to academic excellence, professionalism, and service. Supervisory Authority This position does not directly supervise staff but provides functional oversight and guidance to student assistants, ambassadors, and volunteers supporting admissions, orientation, and commencement activities. Principal Accountabilities Admissions Operations and Applicant Management Coordinates the interview process for applicants, including file review preparation, interview scheduling, session facilitation, and processing of application fees. Oversees the processing, tracking, and maintenance of applicant files, ensuring timely data entry and accuracy of records. Evaluates applications and supporting documents to ensure completeness, accuracy, and integrity, and flags irregularities or potential misconduct. Advises prospective students and applicants on admissions policies, requirements, and timelines. Prepares admissions‑related reports for the Dean, the Director, College leadership, and external associations as required. Maintains compliance with institutional, accreditation, and ADEA guidelines related to admissions documentation, confidentiality, and applicant data. Manages the full onboarding and enrollment process for incoming predoctoral students, including verification of admissions requirements, collection and tracking of matriculation documents, immunization and compliance records, and University credentialing to ensure all students are fully cleared for enrollment. Student Engagement and Success Initiatives Supports programs and activities that foster a welcoming and supportive environment for incoming students. Assists with the planning and implementation of New Student Orientation in collaboration with the Director of Admissions and Student Ambassadors. Executes pre‑matriculation communication plans to ensure incoming students remain informed, prepared, and connected prior to enrollment. Supports student milestone events—including Opening Ceremony, White Coat Ceremony, Match Day, and Commencement—ensuring a positive and professional student experience throughout the lifecycle. Recruitment, Outreach, and Representation Represents the College at recruitment fairs, pipeline programs, high school and college visits, and national or regional pre‑dental events in absence of or at the request of the Director. Assists with preparation of recruitment materials, presentations, and digital content highlighting student success, College programs, and mission‑focused initiatives. Participates in staff meetings, retreats, and strategic planning activities related to recruiting, retention, and student engagement. University and Institutional Coordination Serves as the College’s liaison to the University Commencement Committee; attends meetings, provides updates, and ensures timely submission and proofing of Commencement Program content. Prepares graduation recommendations for the Office of the Provost and oversees diploma ordering and fulfillment. Coordinates institutional data requests and end‑of‑year reporting for internal and external stakeholders, ensuring accuracy and timeliness. Core Competencies Student‑Centered Service Demonstrates empathy, professionalism, and responsiveness when engaging with applicants and students. Maintains a positive, solutions‑oriented approach to student support. Organizational Excellence Ability to manage complex workflows, multitask, meet deadlines, and maintain accuracy in data and documentation. Strong attention to detail and confidentiality. Professional Communication Exceptional written and verbal communication skills. Ability to interact effectively with diverse audiences, including prospective and current students, families, faculty, staff, and external partners. Collaboration & Interpersonal Skills Demonstrated ability to work across academic and administrative units to achieve shared goals. Comfortable guiding student assistants, ambassadors, and volunteers. Integrity, Compliance, and Judgment Adheres to FERPA, accreditation standards, and institutional policies governing sensitive information. Exercises sound judgment, discretion, and ethical decision‑making. Technical Skills Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Ability to learn CRM systems, admissions software, Banner, WebAdMIT, Slate, Workday, or other student information platforms. Comfortable with data entry, digital communication tools, and document management. Minimum Requirements Bachelor’s degree required, preference for program in Education, Higher Education, Counseling, Business, Communications, or a related field. Experience: 1–2 years of experience in admissions, student services, customer service, recruitment, or administrative support. Experience in higher education or health‑professions settings preferred. Experience with event coordination (orientation, ceremonies, recruitment) strongly preferred. Salary Range Expected Pay Range: $72,539 - $79,793 #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Comp Data Solutions Global Industry Leader - Natural Resources & Energy
vagas.description: Descrição da postagem Compensation Data Solutions Global Industry Leader - Natural Resources & Energy Do you want to impact our clients with your vision and experience? Do you believe in the power of doing more for clients? This is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work both virtually and from one of our offices in Latin America (Brazil, Chile and Colombia). Please submit all application materials, including your résumé, in English. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What The Day Will Look Like The Global Industry Leader for the Natural Resources and Energy sector is responsible for developing and delivering a strategic growth plan for the industry vertical. They build strong client relationships and lead business development initiatives. This role will be responsible for driving the successful implementation of the industry strategy across all client segments and regions, partnering with colleagues across business lines to harness broader Aon relationships to drive growth. Develop and Implement Industry Growth Strategy: Define and implement a strategic plan to expand market share within the vertical, including identifying market opportunities and setting clear objectives. Build and Maintain Client Relationships: Cultivate strong, trusted relationships with key client partners, understanding their business challenges and proactively identifying ways the firm can add new value. Lead Business Development Efforts: Drive regional pipeline generation and conversion by identifying and prioritizing new opportunities and supporting regional sales teams on large enterprise deals. Deliver Thought Leadership: Represent the firm as an industry expert by publishing insights, speaking publicly at conferences, and participating in industry forums to raise Aon's profile and credibility. Lead Financial Performance: Oversee the vertical’s financial health, including revenue targets, budgeting, forecasting, and resource allocation. Develop and Grow Industry-Focused Teams: Mentor, and develop talent with relevant industry expertise, fostering a collaborative and impactful team culture. Collaborate Across the Organization: Work closely with other vertical leaders, service line leads, and regional leaders to harness broader firm capabilities and client relationships. Monitor Industry Trends and Regulatory Changes: Stay abreast of industry developments, regulatory shifts, and emerging risks to ensure the firm’s offerings remain relevant and compliant. Drive Innovation and Solution Development: Identify client needs and market gaps, leading the development of new services, solutions, and delivery models tailored to the vertical. Lead Collaborator Communication: Provide regular updates to executive leadership and other interested parties on vertical performance, critical initiatives, and key challenges. How This Opportunity Is Different As a thought leader and industry expert, you will represent the firm in the market, track industry trends, and drive the creation of innovative, industry relevant and client-focused solutions. This is a pivotal leadership position for a committed professional with deep industry and reward expertise and a passion for delivering value to clients. Skills And Experience That Will Lead To Success Ten plus years of experience in compensation, specifically compensation data and/or benchmarking. Proven track record in the Natural Resources and Energy segment leading and driving growth in a complex global environment. Exceptional influential leadership. Fluency in the English language. Deep understanding of Human Capital universe and needs of clients across all segments, with strengths across Rewards and Analytics. Hands‑on experience of shaping and executing against a client-focused vision. Proven track record of building go‑to‑market strategies and driving sustained results over both a short and long‑term horizon. Ability to lead strategic thinking around innovation and ideation with a strong client and commercial lens. Exceptional communication skills to convey compelling messages across all levels and geographies. Ability to work in matrixed environment and lead through influence. Education Bachelor’s degree in relevant discipline or equivalent years of industry experience. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Analista de Processos
vagas.description: Nós somos a EssilorLuxottica, líder global em produtos de cuidados visuais de classe mundial, incluindo óculos icônicos, tecnologia de lentes avançada e soluções digitais de ponta. Nosso trabalho vai além do nosso negócio. Estamos abrindo novas fronteiras, promovendo a inclusão e a colaboração, abraçando a agilidade, acendendo a paixão e causando um impacto positivo no mundo. Somos o grupo das marcas de cuidados visuais e óculos mais amadas e reconhecidas do mundo. Nosso portfólio incomparável de marcas exclusivas de óculos, como Ray-Ban, Oakley, Persol, Oliver Peoples, Vogue Eyewear e Costa, é complementado por mais de 20 marcas licenciadas de prestígio. Nossas tecnologias avançadas de lentes incluem a marca Essilor, com Varilux, Crizal, Eyezen, Stellest e Transitions. Nossa rede de venda direta ao consumidor conta com aproximadamente 18.000 lojas, que oferecem aos consumidores cuidados visuais de alta qualidade e experiências de compra de classe mundial, com uma abordagem verdadeiramente omnicanal, através de nossas bandeiras de varejo mundialmente renomadas, como Sunglass Hut, LensCrafters, Salmoiraghi & Viganò e a rede GrandVision. O negócio é complementado por plataformas líderes de comércio eletrônico, como Ray-Ban.com, EyeBuyDirect, Clearly e muito mais. Tenha a oportunidade de crescer conosco e projetar sua carreira profissional. Conheça a EssilorLuxottica e faça parte da nossa comunidade internacional. Você consegue enxergar o seu #FutureInSight? Se interessou? Veja a descrição das atividades e inscreva-se: O Analista de Processos será responsável por definir, padronizar e melhorar continuamente os processos produtivos e operacionais, por meio do mapeamento de fluxos, identificação de falhas e implementação de indicadores de desempenho. Como escopo do trabalho o Analista de Processos deverá realizar Mapear, desenvolver e padronizar fluxos de trabalho (workflows), garantindo eficiência, qualidade e atingimento das metas operacionais. Elaborar, revisar e controlar documentos de processos (POPs, instruções de trabalho e fluxogramas) junto as áreas de apoio, assegurando atualização e aderência aos padrões. Atuar na melhoria contínua dos processos utilizando metodologias e ferramentas da qualidade (Lean, análise de causa raiz). Realizar auditorias de processos e identificar oportunidades de melhoria, propondo ações corretivas e preventivas. Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho (BSC, produtividade, eficiência, qualidade), analisando desvios e propondo planos de ação. Apoiar a implementação e manutenção do Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade (ISO 9001 / ISO 13485). Trabalhar em conjunto com áreas de Produção, Qualidade, Engenharia e RH para garantir padronização e melhoria dos processos. Apoiar iniciativas como 5S, treinamentos operacionais e disseminação de boas práticas na Operação. Requisitos Ensino superior completo em Engenharia, Administração ou áreas correlatas. Experiência em ambiente industrial ou processos. Conhecimento em Lean e ferramentas da qualidade. Experiência com mapeamento de processos. Excel intermediário/avançado. Conhecimento em Engenharia de Produção. Experiência com sistemas de qualidade. Inglês intermediário. A EssilorLuxottica valoriza e apoia a diversidade, por esse motivo, todas as nossas vagas são abertas para candidaturas de profissionais PcDs. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Engineer
vagas.description: Intermoor, Acteon's Moorings and Anchors business line, provides project and operational management expertise to customers across the mooring lifecycle. By combining operational knowledge of mooring equipment, anchor handling and industry failure modes with subsea engineering expertise, we create a company unmatched within the mooring niche. This approach mitigates risks in delivery, installation and operations across the lifecycle, reducing mooring lifecycle costs and safeguarding major operations that protect start-up schedules when mooring and mooring intervention are on the project or production critical path. We are looking to add an Engineer to the team in Rio. The Engineer performs the design and analysis of shallow and deepwater mooring and anchoring systems components for various types of floating drilling, production, and offshore support vessels. The successful candidate will be based in the Rio de Janeiro area. Please submit Resumes/CVs in English. Duties Design and analysis of anchoring systems for steel catenary and synthetic taut leg shallow and deepwater mooring systems for AHTS vessels, barges, tender assist drilling units, drilling rigs and permanent production facilities. Anchoring systems include suction piles, driven piles, gravity base foundations, SEPLA anchors, torpedo piles, etc. Structural design of installation aids (such as A-frame's, launching systems, etc) for installation of mooring systems and subsea equipment using anchor handling tug supply vessels Design and analysis of catenary and taut leg deepwater mooring systems (steel and synthetic) for drilling rigs and permanent production facilities Procedure development for installation of mooring systems and subsea equipment using anchor handling / dive support vessels Offshore support for installation activities Report writing and communication skills Continually improve working knowledge of mooring and foundation engineering Design and analysis of mooring systems for drilling platforms and permanent production units Development of procedures for the installation of mooring systems and subsea equipment Issuance of executive project reports Material inventory: Control of records relating to the requisition, receipt, storage, distribution and dispatch of materials and equipment Participate in the company's HSE (Health, Safety and Environment) Programs (Ex: Safety Meetings, Participate in operations risk assessments, etc.); Ensure that all operations are carried out within InterMoor's Health, Safety and Environmental Management System Required Degree in Engineering: Mechanical, Production, Naval, Civil, Metallurgical Engineering or related field 2 years' experience in mooring design and mooring operations, and offshore experience highly preferred Fluent English - speaking, reading, and writing Autocad, Office package, Orcaflex or any mooring analysis software Oral Communication: Speaks clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations Written Communication: Write clearly and informatively Ability to work in a team (good interpersonal relationships) Ability to adapt to new situations Availability for national and international travel Performance in HSE (health, safety and environmental) management, including work permit, risk assessment, basic understanding of safety, health and environmental standards #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Head of Finance
vagas.description: Head of Finance Department: Administration Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team. THE POSITION Under the joint responsibility of the FIFA27 Executive Director Administration and the FIFA Finance Division, the Head of Finance will contribute to the development of the financial strategy, will oversee the financial operations of the local entity and will manage the dedicated finance team. The finance department of the entities will include the following functions: Accounting, Controlling, Treasury, Tax and Insurance. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Structuring phase: To consolidate the small Finance Team consisting of Accounting, Taxes and Controlling To finalize the implementation of FIFA Financial tools. To be responsible for reviewing the necessary policies and procedures implemented by the company, in consideration of FIFA’s requirements and local law. To be responsible of implementing those policies and procedures in daily activities, to ensure compliance and appropriate financial transparency and governance. Planning & Operating Phase: To lead all aspects of the finance function of the FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil: Accounting, Taxes, Controlling, Treasury and Insurance To act as business partner to all functions guiding well-informed decision making and managing the financial risks. To align and coordinate with all requirements relating to FIFA Finance in overall (e.g. consolidation, budgeting and reporting requirements). To establish and develop relations with senior management and external partners and stakeholders. To act in a coordinated way with other departments within the entities and within FIFA to ensure smooth business operations. To analyse and review company cash flow, expenditures and revenues. To participate in financial standards setting and in Forecast process. To support FIFA in the overall financial planning of the tournament. To prepare financial reporting as required by FIFA and the entity’s management. To produce error‑free accounting and tax reports and present their results. To oversee tax audits, tax returns and federal and state tax returns. To ensure compliance with IFRS and FIFA Accounting principles. To provide necessary support for internal customers and external auditors. To seek ways to improve upon accounting and tax processes and procedures. To ensure the efficient implementation of the insurance coverage according to FIFA requirements. To assist the FIFA27 Executive Director Administration and the FIFA Finance Division on special requests. To manage, supervise and motivate the Finance team and to provide effective guidance and leadership. When necessary to contribute to the daily financial tasks. YOUR PROFILE Higher business education, specialized in Finance or Accounting (university degree or equal education) Minimum of 10 years’ experience in Finance/tax at senior level including 5 years of proven experience in a managing financial function preferably in an event organisation (organising major sport events or other similar projects) In‑depth understanding of local GAAP Previous experience within a finance position in Brazil is mandatory. Good computer knowledge (user), especially MS Excel and SAP Excellent leadership and team‑management skills High ability of lateral thinking Taking initiative Identification with FIFA Very good analytical skills Persistence, quality mentality Forward‑looking mind‑set with strong results‑orientation Flexibility and open‑mindedness Ability to work under pressure and endurance Very high sense of responsibility Strong and transparent communication skills Ability to engage with staff at all levels of the organisation and exercise sound judgement. Reliability with a strong sense for cooperation/teamwork Right to work in Brazil. Fluent in English (spoken and written) Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written) Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: MÉDICO DO TRABALHO - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II
vagas.description: Descrição da vaga Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II . A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade. Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras. Auxilia os usuários do sistema criando guias de instruções, fornecendo suporte técnico e ministrando sessões de compartilhamento de conhecimento para colegas e clientes. Familiaridade com protocolos IAM: SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect e LDAP. Conhecimento básico de scripts (PowerShell é altamente desejável) para automação e operações em lote. Compreensão de Windows Server, DNS, conceitos básicos de redes e logs de sistema. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação para explicar conceitos técnicos a públicos não técnicos. Experiência em conduzir reuniões com clientes, coletar requisitos e apresentar atualizações. Capacidade de criar documentação clara, Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (POPs) e guias do usuário. Profissionalismo na gestão de fornecedores e stakeholders. Capacidade de gerenciar SLAs e priorizar chamados. Mentalidade proativa na resolução de problemas e senso de responsabilidade. Capacidade de colaborar com equipes de segurança, infraestrutura e aplicações.
