The Sales Manager, Industrial Instruments (South LAM) will be responsible for driving sales growth and expanding market share across Brazil and South Cone countries for Vaisala’s Industrial Instruments portfolio. This role focuses on key industries such as data centers, life sciences, food & beverage, automotive, and other measurement‑intensive industrial sectors. You will lead new business development, grow existing accounts, develop OEM business, and strengthen our distributor network. This position is ideal for a self‑driven sales professional with strong technical acumen and experience in industrial environments who is comfortable working in an international organization. What’s Your Role? Develop and execute strategic sales plans to achieve revenue and profitability targets, while expanding Vaisala’s presence and installed base across the territory. Proactively identify, target, and acquire new customers in key industries (data centers, life sciences, food & beverage, automotive, and other measurement‑intensive industries) within the South LAM region. Identify and develop OEM opportunities, building long‑term partnerships where Vaisala’s Industrial Instruments are integrated into customers’ equipment and solutions. Work closely with existing distributors to strengthen their sales and technical capabilities, and actively support the identification, recruitment, and onboarding of new partners, in collaboration with the Channel Partner Manager. Deliver impactful technical and commercial presentations, demos, and training to customers, partners, and associations, clearly articulating the value of Vaisala’s Industrial Instruments. Oversee the entire sales process from lead qualification to closing deals, ensuring a seamless customer experience. Utilize Salesforce to track sales activities and customer interactions. Work closely with internal stakeholders (local and international), including product management, marketing, customer service, and field service, to align sales efforts with company objectives and secure customer satisfaction. Monitor market trends, customer needs, and competitor activities in target industries, and provide structured feedback to support portfolio and strategy development. What Will You Bring? Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (electrical, electronic, automation, mechanical, or related field). 5–10 years of experience in technical sales within industrial markets, ideally selling instrumentation, sensors, automation, or related solutions to process or manufacturing industries. Proven track record of developing new business and consistently achieving or exceeding sales targets. Experience managing distributors or partners and building a structured partner network; OEM business development experience is a strong plus. Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills; comfortable presenting to both technical and management‑level stakeholders. High level of autonomy and self‑management, able to prioritize opportunities and manage a large territory. Availability to travel frequently across Brazil and South Cone countries, as required by the business. Fluent Portuguese and fluent English (written and spoken) are mandatory; Spanish language skills are a strong plus. Experience and discipline using CRM tools such as Salesforce. Residency in São Paulo – SP or surrounding areas, with availability for a hybrid work model (the office is in Vila Olimpia, São Paulo). What We Offer Competitive salary aligned with your experience and the market. Hybrid work model, combining office and home office. Flexible meal vouchers (Flash), compatible with regional standards. Full health and dental coverage (no coparticipation). Life insurance. An international, collaborative, and positive work environment, with opportunities to interact with global teams and develop your career in a high‑technology company. vagas.title: Change Manager, LATAM OU
vagas.description: Change Manager – Role Overview The Change Manager is crucial in shaping how people experience and contribute to change across Haleon. The role enables, coordinates and executes our strategic programmes, owning the local change strategy and roadmap within an assigned Operating Unit to ensure a coherent change experience. The role focuses on the people side of change – identifying, preparing, and equipping our colleagues to adopt changes in ways of working, roles, operating models, business processes, systems, technology, culture and more. It reports into the Change Management CoE Director and supports a collaborative effort to drive change excellence at scale. Key Responsibilities Drive the execution of strategic transformation initiatives landing in assigned Operating Unit by developing a change strategy and actionable roadmap. Conduct change diagnostics (e.g., impact assessments) to identify targeted change interventions and ensure alignment to Haleon’s culture strategy during planning and execution. Support the delivery and adoption of change through facilitating workshops, defining success metrics, assessing change effectiveness, measuring adoption, and coordinating local knowledge management plans. Partner with Programmes to develop local business readiness criteria ahead of going‑live with change initiatives. Hold programme and business leads accountable for leader‑led change execution. Anticipate stakeholder needs and potential resistance, proactively identifying targeted mitigations. Coordinate change activities across stakeholders and teams (HR, Communications, Programmes, Capability Leads, L&D, etc.) and act as a bridge between programmes and local teams. Develop and oversee the implementation of local communications and engagement plans, including mapping key stakeholders, agreeing the engagement approach with business leaders and HR, and tailoring programme change narratives for local needs. Build a holistic change capability strategy and plan for assigned Operating Unit, ensuring alignment to the enterprise skills framework. Develop and execute the change learning plan and curriculum with subject matter experts, partner with Programme leads, Capability Leads, and HR to identify training needs and ensure appropriate training plans are in place, including measuring effectiveness. Coach and upskill business leaders on change management, holding them to account for role‑modeling change and culture and driving uptake in their Operating Unit. Contribute to continuous improvement and knowledge sharing through the change management community of practice. Review and report on change outcomes and benefits, grounded in metrics, with clear ROI and linked to business outcomes. Identify, document and support the mitigation of key change management risks within the assigned Operating Unit and work across workstreams to implement interventions and resolve issues. Basic Qualifications Proven track record of executing change programs within complex, matrixed environments, demonstrating effectiveness across diverse global teams. Proficiency with portfolio‑level change management, including prioritisation, sequencing and operating across interdependent transformations. Ability to translate an enterprise‑level change strategy and roadmap into an executable and measurable local adoption plan. Strong understanding of change management best practices, tools and techniques, and practical implementation. Strong communication and relationship‑building skills, simplifying complex messages for business leaders. Strong problem‑solving and planning skills, working through ambiguity and adapting delivery approaches. Ability to influence and navigate across a broad ecosystem of stakeholders, including Leaders, Line Managers, HRBPs, L&D, etc. Preferred Qualifications PROSCI and/or APMG Change Practitioner certification (preferred). Strong business acumen and understanding of business operations and operating model components. Demonstrated ability to coach sponsors, cultivate change champions and drive business accountability for change. Solid understanding of how people experience change and drivers of change, embedding mindset and culture shifts across teams. Strong data fluency, leveraging analytics and insights to drive adoption; proficiency with change management, collaboration and digital adoption tools. Our decision to hire is based solely on qualifications, experience, and fit for the role. vagas.title: ANALISTA SUPORTE JUNIOR
vagas.description: Venha crescer com o Grupo Kontik. O Grupo Kontik é um hub de negócios com mais de 70 anos de história no mercado de viagens, atuando em diferentes segmentos, como corporativo, lazer, luxo e eventos. Conectamos tradição e inovação com uma cultura de performance clara e praticada no dia a dia. Nossa atuação é guiada por cinco pilares culturais, que orientam decisões, comportamentos e entregas: Performance e execução disciplinada, com foco em qualidade, prazos e resultados consistentes. Decisão inteligente e baseada em dados, priorizando análises, indicadores e escolhas bem fundamentadas. Colaboração e sinergia entre times, com comunicação clara e trabalho conjunto. Inovação, adaptabilidade e olhar para o futuro, evoluindo continuamente e ajustando rotas quando necessário. Viajante no centro, garantindo que nossas decisões gerem valor real para quem utiliza nossos serviços. Oportunidade Analista de Suporte de TI Jr. Área de atuação: Tecnologia da Informação – Suporte ao Usuário Objetivo principal da posição: Garantir o atendimento eficiente de primeiro nível (N1/N2) aos usuários internos, assegurando a resolução de incidentes e requisições dentro dos SLAs estabelecidos, com foco em qualidade e continuidade das operações. Perfil ideal: Profissional em início de carreira com conhecimento técnico em suporte, perfil analítico, capacidade de lidar com múltiplas demandas e forte orientação à resolução de problemas e ao atendimento ao cliente interno. Principais responsabilidades Atender chamados de suporte técnico N1/N2 por meio de sistema ITSM. Realizar triagem, categorização e priorização de incidentes conforme boas práticas ITIL. Diagnosticar e resolver problemas relacionados a hardware, software, redes e periféricos. Executar instalação, configuração e manutenção de estações de trabalho (Windows 10/11). Administrar contas de usuários no Active Directory e Microsoft 365 (criação, alteração, bloqueio). Prestar suporte às ferramentas corporativas como Microsoft 365, Teams, OneDrive e sistemas internos. Apoiar configuração e suporte a dispositivos móveis (MDM básico) e impressoras. Documentar soluções e procedimentos, alimentando a base de conhecimento (ITSM KB). Executar controle de inventário de ativos de TI (hardware e softwares). Escalonar incidentes mais complexos para níveis superiores (N3), garantindo documentação completa. Apoiar processos de onboarding tecnológico de novos colaboradores. Colaborar com áreas de infraestrutura e segurança em atividades operacionais. Como essa posição se conecta com nossa cultura Atuação com foco em qualidade de entrega e cumprimento de SLA, garantindo eficiência operacional. Uso de sistemas de chamados e indicadores para direcionar decisões e melhorias contínuas. Colaboração constante com times internos para resolução ágil de demandas. Adaptabilidade diante de ambientes dinâmicos e múltiplas prioridades. Forte orientação ao cliente interno, assegurando uma experiência positiva e produtiva. Requisitos Ensino superior em andamento ou concluído em TI, Sistemas de Informação, Redes ou áreas correlatas. Conhecimento em Windows 10/11 (instalação, configuração e troubleshooting). Familiaridade com Active Directory: gestão de contas, grupos e GPOs básicas. Experiência básica com Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive). Conhecimento em redes (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP e Wi‑Fi corporativo). Experiência com ferramentas de chamados (Jira, GLPI, Freshdesk ou similares). Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de documentação técnica. Organização, proatividade e foco em cumprimento de SLA. Diferenciais Certificações como CompTIA A+, ITIL Foundation v4 ou Microsoft 365 Fundamentals (MS-900). Experiência com ferramentas de MDM como Microsoft Intune ou Jamf. Conhecimento básico em PowerShell para automação. Familiaridade com ambientes de virtualização (VirtualBox, Hyper‑V). Noções de segurança da informação (antivírus corporativo, MFA, políticas de senha). Experiência prévia em empresas de médio/grande porte. Informações da vaga Horário: 09:00 às 11:40 / 12:40 às 18:00. Buscamos alguém com uma mentalidade proativa, que tenha facilidade em aprender e dominar diferentes ferramentas e soluções, sempre buscando inovação e eficiência. vagas.title: Banker PME RJ
vagas.description: A XP Inc. é uma das maiores instituições financeiras independente do Brasil, dona das marcas XP, Rico, Clear, XP Educação, InfoMoney, entre outras. Com mais de 4,6 milhões de clientes ativos e um valor superior a R$ 1,1 trilhão de ativos sob custódia, há 24 anos vem transformando o mercado financeiro para melhorar a vida das pessoas. Com uma cultura marcante guiada por quatro valores - Sonho Grande, Espírito Empreendedor, Foco no Cliente e Mente Aberta - a XP Inc. está sempre em busca dos melhores talentos que tem ambição de fazer o impossível. Sobre a Oportunidade Você já pensou em construir sua carreira em um Banco de Atacado inovador? A XP tem um convite para você. Estamos em busca de profissionais com perfil comercial, visão de negócios e vontade de fazer acontecer para atuar diretamente no relacionamento com clientes PME. Como Officer, você será responsável por desenvolver novas oportunidades, fortalecer relacionamentos e conectar empresas a soluções financeiras completas dentro do ecossistema da XP . Isso significa atuar de forma protagonista em um ambiente dinâmico, dentro de um Banco de Atacado em forte expansão, ajudando a construir novas conexões com o mercado e ampliando nossa presença no segmento de pequenas e médias empresas. Aqui, você terá autonomia, desafios reais e a oportunidade de crescer junto com um time que está transformando a forma como as empresas se relacionam com o mercado financeiro. Por que escolher a XP? Porque aqui valorizamos a inovação , a autonomia e o crescimento acelerado . Se você quer fazer parte de um time que está moldando o futuro dos investimentos e deseja crescer profissionalmente, a XP é o lugar certo para você! Qualificações Formação superior completa em Engenharia, Economia, Contabilidade, Administração ou áreas correlatas; Interesse e familiaridade com temas relacionados ao mercado financeiro e ao universo de pequenas e médias empresas (PME); Perfil comercial, com habilidade para desenvolver relacionamentos e gerar novos negócios; Excelente comunicação oral e escrita, com capacidade de interlocução com empresários e tomadores de decisão. Diferenciais Possuir certificação C-Pro I, C-Pro Rou superior; Experiência prévia ou envolvimento com iniciativas de empreendedorismo, liderança ou desenvolvimento de negócios; Vivência em ambientes comerciais, relacionamento com clientes ou mercado financeiro. Responsabilidades Montar carteira de clientes PME na região; Gestão de carteira de clientes PJ; Mapeamento de operações. Benefícios Plano de saúde; iFood Benefícios (VA e VR flexível); Licença parental: maternidade de 6 meses e paternidade de 20 dias; Auxílio Creche; Assessoria de Investimentos; Cartão XP Visa Infinite sem anuidade; Crédito (consignado, home equity, CCB Imobiliário, etc.). Modelo de Trabalho Presencial Flexível O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função, podendo ser totalmente presencial para frentes de negócio e mais flexível para outras equipes. Seguimos um modelo com mais frequência presencial, mas sempre guiado por flexibilidade e autonomia com a responsabilidade da nossa cultura empreendedora. Aqui na XP Inc., valorizamos as interações pessoais e acreditamos no uso do escritório como uma ferramenta para potencializar nossas relações no trabalho. Nosso compromisso com a diversidade: Buscamos construir um ambiente seguro e inclusivo para o desenvolvimento profissional de todas as pessoas e não toleramos qualquer tipo de discriminação de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo, reforçando nosso compromisso com a diversidade. Ao preencher os campos, você consente com o tratamento de dados pessoais sensíveis para entender melhor a composição do pessoal e a adesão aos processos seletivos, sem impacto na candidatura. Em caso de dúvidas, consulte a Política de Privacidade. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Patient Service Rep I
vagas.description: The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth. Basic Function The purpose of this position is to provide assistance to patients, staff, Faculty/Students of Howard University Hospital Faculty Practice Plan. Supervisory Accountability Involves no responsibility or authority for the direction of others. Nature And Scope External contacts include a variety of third‑party payers, dental organizations, patients, and other healthcare personnel. Internal contacts include the dental faculty and staff. Principal Accountabilities Greets and directs patients for appointments, referrals, and general information utilizing excellent and effective customer service skills. Answers telephones, screens calls as directed, takes messages, and schedules appointments utilizing the computerized scheduling system. Also, confirms appointments and provides patient instructions verbally or in writing in order for patients to prepare for appointments. Ensures that patients are handled consistently and scheduled for appointments in a manner that recognizes the urgency of their needs and complaints. Implements effective front office business processes that will result in improved financial performance and will preserve or improve current customer service levels. These processes will include, but are not limited to, point of service patient registration into the Axium system, insurance verification and pre‑authorizations prior to patient visits, history verification, and collection of time of service payments and co‑pays. Works with patients and the business office on unpaid balances from previous visits prior to scheduling subsequent appointments. Verifies insurance eligibility and assists in collecting payments. Performs other related duties as assigned. Core Competencies Knowledge of the activities of the Division in order to perform necessary clerical functions and requirements of the organization, including knowledge of hospital policies and third‑party payers. Ability to effectively present information in one‑on‑one and small group situations. Ability to perform basic math functions, compute rates, ratios, and percents, and to interpret bar graphs. Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form. Ability to deal with problems involving several concrete variables in situations with limited standardization. Ability to operate a computer, photocopier, and other standard office equipment. Ability to sort and file materials correctly by alphabetical or numeric systems. Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with patients, employees, and the public. Ability to communicate English orally and in writing with people from various educational levels and backgrounds, as well as the ability to speak clearly and concisely. Ability to plan, organize, coordinate, and prioritize work in situations where demands of a diverse nature are involved. Minimum Requirements High School diploma or GED and 1‑3 years of general work experience. AA/AS may be substituted for 4 years of required work experience. A BA/BS may be substituted for up to 4 years of work experience. Compliance Salary Range Disclosure Expected Pay Range: $19/hr - $20/hr #J-18808-Ljbffr

Ensino superior completo em Engenharia, Administração, Sistemas de Informação, Tecnologia ou áreas correlatas. Diferenciais Experiência prévia em solution design ou pré-vendas. vagas.description: MAIS QUE MERCADO O Grupo Carrefour Brasil é o maior varejista do país, presente em todos os estados e atendendo mais de 60 milhões de clientes por mês. Atuamos em diferentes formatos como Atacadão, Carrefour Varejo, Sam’s Club, Banco Carrefour e Carrefour Property oferecendo soluções diversificadas para um Brasil tão plural. Com 130 mil colaboradores, temos o propósito de oferecer alimentação acessível e de qualidade a todos, enquanto contribuímos para uma sociedade mais inclusiva e sustentável. No Carrefour, trabalhamos diariamente a cultura do respeito e da equidade. A valorização da diversidade é um compromisso para o Carrefour, por isso, encorajamos a candidatura e damos oportunidade a profissionais diversos, sejam Mulheres, Negros (as), Pessoas LGBTQIA+, Pessoas com deficiência ou Pessoas em situação de refúgio. Também reconhecemos a importância da diversidade geracional e temos orgulho em promover oportunidades para profissionais 50+, que fortalecem nosso time com suas experiências e trajetórias. Aqui, cada pessoa pode evoluir em sua jornada profissional. Valorizamos o desenvolvimento, com oportunidades de crescimento que vão de posições operacionais até cargos de liderança. Venha crescer com a gente e fazer parte dessa história! DO DISCURSO À PRÁTICA Gerenciar a operação da drogaria, assegurando o cumprimento da legislação vigente, das diretrizes corporativas e das Boas Práticas Farmacêuticas, garantindo qualidade, segurança, rentabilidade e excelência e cordialidade no atendimento ao cliente. Principais Responsabilidades Atuar como Responsável Técnico pela farmácia, garantindo o cumprimento das normas da ANVISA, CRF, Vigilância Sanitária e demais legislações aplicáveis. Assegurar a aplicação das Boas Práticas Farmacêuticas (BPF) e dos processos de garantia da qualidade. Monitorar e manter a loja preparada para auditorias, fiscalizações e inspeções sanitárias. Informar ao Gerente Regional e ao setor de Licenciamento sobre ausência ou alteração do quadro farmacêutico. Assegurar condições adequadas de armazenamento, conservação, dispensação e controle de validade dos medicamentos. Liderar, desenvolver e motivar a equipe, promovendo ambiente respeitoso, inclusivo e alinhado aos valores corporativos. Delegar tarefas e assegurar o cumprimento das atividades designadas. Conduzir reuniões periódicas e treinamentos técnicos e operacionais. Participar dos processos de admissão, promoção e desligamento em conjunto com o Gerente Regional e com aprovação da diretoria. Repassar ao time as diretrizes e comunicações oriundas da Matriz e Gerência Regional. Informar prontamente desvios de conduta ao Gerente Regional. Reportar-se ao Gerente Regional responsável pela drogaria. Atender às demandas enviadas pelos departamentos da Matriz. Responsabilizar-se pelo lançamento de atestados, afastamentos e controle de ponto no sistema. Realizar assinatura e arquivamento das folhas de ponto dos colaboradores. Acompanhar a concorrência e propor ações estratégicas para fortalecimento da unidade. Priorizar o atendimento ao cliente com cordialidade, eficiência e humanização, promovendo experiência ética e de qualidade. Realizar acompanhamento de vendas e indicadores, promovendo ações para alcance das metas. Desenvolver estratégias para aumento de ticket médio e rentabilidade da unidade. Atuar em parceria com demais áreas da loja para potencializar resultados. Requisitos Graduação em Farmácia. Registro ativo no CRF. Experiência prévia em gestão de drogarias ou varejo farmacêutico. Conhecimento em legislação sanitária e Boas Práticas Farmacêuticas. Conhecimento intermediário em Excel e PowerPoint. Se identificou? Inscreva-se e vamos juntos mudar o mundo através da alimentação! #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Senior Solutions Architect, Media, Entertainment, Games & Sports
vagas.description: Senior Solutions Architect – Media, Entertainment, Games & Sports (MEGS) Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Senior Solutions Architect to serve as a trusted technical advisor to broadcasters, content creators, and production companies. You will help reimagine their workflows using AWS cloud technologies, working with customers across broadcast operations, live production, content creation, and media supply chain to accelerate digital transformation. The role requires approximately 10% travel, including international. Key job responsibilities Customer Engagement: Work backward from the customer to drive adoption of AWS services for media and entertainment workloads, focusing on broadcast, streaming, and content production use cases. Technical Leadership: Understand and anticipate customer business needs, accelerating their ability to innovate by building working prototypes and industry‑specific solutions. Architecture & Design: Run technical workshops and advise customers on architectural decisions for cloud‑based media solutions. Best Practices: Educate customers to ensure their solutions follow AWS best practices for scalability, availability, security, and operational excellence in media environments. Thought Leadership: Author or contribute to AWS customer‑facing publications such as whitepapers, tutorials, and blog posts focused on media technology. External Communication: Participate in industry conferences and events, sharing knowledge with the broader AWS solutions architect community and media industry. Product Feedback: Drive customer requirements alignment with AWS service teams' roadmaps, acting as the voice of media and entertainment customers. A day in the life Your days blend technical depth with strategic advisory work across broadcasters and content creators. You’ll architect cloud solutions for live sports streaming and broadcast workflows, build proof‑of‑concepts with AWS media services, collaborate with account teams on customer workshops, and share field feedback with AWS product teams. Throughout the week, you balance hands‑on customer engagements with thought leadership—mentoring junior SAs, presenting at industry conferences, and documenting architectural patterns. Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent experience. 5+ years experience solving problems with technology in the Media & Entertainment Industry. Experience in technical solution design and customer engagement. Ability to communicate fluently in English and Portuguese in technical and business settings (verbal and written). Preferred Qualifications Experience working with and presenting to C‑level executives, IT, and lines of businesses across organizations or equivalent. Experience working with AWS Services. Experience working with or evaluating AI systems. Experience writing technical articles, speaking at technology conferences, and contributing to open source. Speak, write, and read fluently in Spanish. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit for more information. Job ID: A #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Brazil - Remote: Mid-Level Developer
vagas.description: About Landmark Landmark, a Halliburton company, builds the software and data platforms that help the global energy industry make better decisions. Our products span subsurface interpretation, well construction planning, reservoir simulation, production optimization, and digital operations. These are tools used daily by engineers and scientists at the world’s largest energy companies and run as cloud‑native SaaS platforms and as enterprise on‑premises solutions. About The Role You own the full development cycle for the features and systems your team assigns you. At Landmark, that means working on software that oil and gas operators depend on for high‑stakes decisions. You take a feature from specification through design, implementation, testing, and delivery with minimal supervision and enough judgment to make good technical decisions along the way. You contribute to code reviews, improve the codebase and processes around you without waiting to be asked, and help junior engineers grow. The quality of what you build shows up in production software used by operators worldwide. Strong software engineering fundamentals are the primary requirement. Domain knowledge is valuable but can develop on the job. Positions are available across a range of teams. Team assignment determines both the product domain you work in and the major technologies you use. Teams Build Software For Domains Such As Geoscience — geology, geophysics, or petrophysics Drilling engineering and well planning Reservoir engineering and modeling Production engineering and optimization E&P data management and integration Cloud and platform infrastructure, data services, and developer tooling AI-assisted analytics, search, and generative AI Technologies Used Vary By Team And Include Languages such as Java, C#, F#, C++, Python, and TypeScript Frameworks, platforms, and runtimes such as .NET, Eclipse RCP/SWT, JUnit, Angular, React, and Node.js Cloud platforms including Azure and AWS Containerization and orchestration tooling such as Docker and Kubernetes Infrastructure automation tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Helm, and Argo CD/Flux Relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, and MongoDB Job Duties Own features end to end: analyze requirements, design solutions, write the code, test it, and ship it Break complex specifications into concrete tasks with realistic schedules and flag risks early Proactively identify and fix weaknesses in the codebase, the test coverage, and the development process Investigate and resolve production defects, and trace root cause when symptom and source are not in the same place Apply secure coding practices, surface vulnerabilities in code reviews, and fix security issues as they arise Review code from other engineers with the same rigor you expect on your own work Evaluate and integrate open‑source tools and libraries where they improve the systems you work on Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, pairing, and direct technical guidance Communicate clearly across a distributed, cross‑timezone team Qualifications Required Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience 5–10 years of software development experience Strong proficiency in at least one of: Java, C#/F# (.NET), C++, Python, or TypeScript (React/Angular/Node.js) Experience owning the full development cycle: requirements analysis, design, implementation, testing, and delivery Experience debugging production software and tracing root causes that span multiple components or layers Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical decisions and trade‑offs to teammates and stakeholders Preferred Experience with cloud‑native development, full‑stack or web application development, or data platform technologies Experience with CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and infrastructure automation Background in enterprise software, SaaS platforms, or technically demanding application domains (scientific computing, real‑time systems, large‑scale data) Exposure to integrating machine learning, generative AI, or LLM‑based components into application features Experience mentoring less experienced engineers Energy industry experience is not required but is a strong plus. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and encourage you to apply even if your experience does not match every item in the preferred list. How You Work The engineer who succeeds in this role brings independent judgment to their work and applies it consistently. You own your assignments end to end, communicate clearly when something is off track, and treat code reviews as a genuine quality tool rather than a formality. You are comfortable working across time zones, adaptable when requirements shift, and focused on delivery outcomes rather than task completion. You pick up new tools and techniques on your own, evaluate them critically, and bring the ones that work to your team. You help the engineers around you improve because you understand that team quality compounds over time. Why Landmark We build small, high‑ownership teams and invest in the quality of every person on them. You will work in a business where software is the product, the work you do matters, and the standards are high. You will own real work that ships, learn from engineers who push you, and grow into the kind of engineer the team relies on. We offer competitive compensation, a strong career path, and a role where you own what you build, and your impact is visible. Halliburton is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference or orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation. Location Rua Paulo Emidio Barbosa 485 Q, Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, , Brazil Job Details Requisition Number: Experience Level: Experienced Hire Job Family: Engineering/Science/Technology Product Service Line: Landmark Software & Services Full Time / Part Time: Full Time Compensation Information: Compensation is competitive and commensurate with experience. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.description: AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards. WHY JOIN US If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you! ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer with a strong backend focus to design and build Java and Spring Boot services while maintaining supporting Angular frontend components. You will lead the transition toward domain-driven architecture, architect clean RESTful APIs, and work within cross-functional squads — with approximately 70–80% of your time dedicated to server-side logic, performance, and system design. WHAT YOU WILL DO Spend the majority of your time (approximately 70–80%) designing and implementing robust backend services using Java and Spring Boot . Build and maintain supporting Angular frontend components, ensuring seamless integration with backend services. Lead the transition from traditional database-centric designs toward a Domain-Driven Design (DDD) architecture. Architect and implement clean, scalable RESTful APIs that follow modern API standards and best practices. Work within cross-functional squads to deliver high-quality features and technical solutions. Contribute to backend performance, scalability, and system architecture improvements. Collaborate closely with engineering teams to maintain a cohesive and proactive development environment. MUST HAVES 3+ years of experience with Java (Spring Boot) and solid working knowledge of Angular . Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Design (OOD) and software design patterns. Deep experience building and consuming RESTful services with a strong understanding of API protocols and standards. Experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL and Oracle . Experience with JPA/Hibernate . Passion for backend development, performance optimization, and software architecture. Upper-intermediate English level. NICE TO HAVES Experience working with spec-driven development or related AI-driven software development lifecycle practices. Previous experience in the Loyalty or FinTech sectors. Experience with AWS or Azure and Docker . Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines such as Jenkins or GitLab CI . Experience refactoring legacy systems into modern domain-driven architectures. PERKS AND BENEFITS Professional growth : Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps. Competitive compensation : Competitive compensation that matches your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions. Exciting projects : Work on projects with modern solutions development and top-tier clients, including Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands. Flextime : Tailor your schedule for an optimal work-life balance, with options for remote work and flexible hours. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Alta maturidade analítica: Capacidade de extrair, limpar e modelar de forma autônoma grandes volumes de dados brutos (Excel avançado, SQL obrigatório, Tableau ou Power BI). Capacidade de Interlocução e Postura Consultiva: Habilidade e maturidade para comunicar conceitos financeiros complexos para stakeholders operacionais (Gerentes e Diretores), desafiando o status quo com firmeza e empatia. Domínio em processos de Budget, Forecast e acompanhamento de variações de P&L operacionais. Formação: Formação superior completa em Engenharias, Economia, Administração ou áreas correlatas com forte viés quantitativo. Experiência prévia em operações logísticas de e-commerce de grande escala ou marketplaces. vagas.title: Senior/Lead Platform Engineer ID69155
vagas.description: AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards. WHY JOIN US If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you! ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to provide hands‑on engineering support for an internal audit and code‑modification platform built on GitLab CI/CD pipelines and LLM‑powered agentic workflows. You will execute against an existing backlog, improve system reliability and observability, support telemetry and run management, and enhance the developer experience for reviewing AI‑generated merge requests using Python. This is a three‑month project engagement. WHAT YOU WILL DO Provide hands‑on engineering support for an internal audit and code‑modification platform; Execute against an existing backlog and deliver tactical platform improvements; Improve system reliability, observability, and operational visibility; Support telemetry, logging, debugging, and run management processes; Enhance the developer experience for reviewing AI‑generated merge requests using Python; Support system maintenance, operational improvements, and GitLab CI/CD pipeline execution; Work with LLM‑powered and agentic workflows, ensuring reliability and usability; Support internal engineering teams and platform users; Improve the reliability, visibility, and usability of the current platform; Contribute to code review workflows, automated remediation processes, and platform enhancements. MUST HAVES 5+ years of experience with GitLab CI/CD pipelines, merge request workflows, and pipeline debugging; Senior‑level backend or platform engineering experience, ideally with Python; Experience working with LLM, prompt‑driven, or agentic workflows, including input/output validation and deterministic execution patterns; Strong understanding of observability, including logging, telemetry, debugging, run tracking, and operational visibility; Experience supporting internal developer tools or platforms used by multiple engineering teams; Ability to execute tactical improvements independently without requiring extensive direction or re‑architecture; Comfortable reviewing and improving generated code changes, codemods, and automated merge requests; Strong communication skills for supporting internal engineering customers and translating use cases into implementation work; Upper‑intermediate English level. NICE TO HAVES Experience building or maintaining developer experience tooling for code review, audits, or automated remediation; Familiarity with GitHub or GitLab extensions, repository audits, or large‑scale source‑code analysis; Experience with codemod frameworks or automated code transformation across large codebases; Experience optimizing LLM token usage, cost tracking, and per‑job reporting; Knowledge of MCP, internal orchestration systems, or agent gateway patterns; Prior experience supporting centralized engineering platforms used across multiple product teams. PERKS AND BENEFITS Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps. Competitive compensation: We match your ever‑growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive compensation. Exciting projects: Join projects with modern solutions development and top‑tier clients, including Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands. Flextime: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work‑life balance, with options for remote work and flexible hours. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Profissional DevOps Engineer Sênior
vagas.description: A primeira coisa que você precisa saber é que aqui você não vai cair na rotina. A Radix desenvolve soluções para empresas de diferentes setores e indústrias. Cada projeto tem suas tecnologias, soluções e prazos e você terá oportunidade de atuar e experimentar diferentes desafios. Além da nossa atuação pelo Brasil, com escritório no Rio de janeiro, São Paulo e Belo Horizonte, temos também filiais nos Estados Unidos, fazendo com que a Radix se consolide cada vez mais como uma empresa global . Quer fazer parte dessa história e transformar ideias e sonhos em realidade? Sobre a posição Estamos buscando um(a) DevOps Engineer para atuar na evolução e sustentação de nossa plataforma de desenvolvimento e entrega contínua baseada em Azure DevOps. O profissional será responsável por garantir a qualidade, segurança, rastreabilidade e automação do ciclo de vida das aplicações corporativas, apoiando equipes de desenvolvimento frontend (.NET, C# e VB.NET) e backend (SQL Server). O ambiente possui processos maduros de CI/CD, controle de mudanças, validações automatizadas de código, integração com SonarQube, governança de branches, aprovação de pull requests e múltiplos ambientes de publicação. Principais responsabilidades Azure DevOps e CI/CD Desenvolver, manter e evoluir pipelines CI/CD em Azure DevOps. Gerenciar artefatos e estratégias de promoção entre ambientes. Automatizar processos de build, validação e deploy. Implementar estratégias de rollback e recuperação. Atuar na administração e sustentação de Azure DevOps Server. Governança de Código Definir e manter estratégias de branching Git. Implementar controles de aprovação e revisão de código. Garantir rastreabilidade entre código, work items e mudanças. Apoiar equipes no uso de Git e boas práticas de versionamento. Qualidade e Segurança Administrar integrações com SonarQube. Implementar controles de segurança e compliance nos pipelines. Garantir aderência às políticas de publicação e segregação de ambientes. Versionar scripts, procedures, views e demais artefatos de banco. Apoiar processos de deploy e controle de mudanças em bases de dados. Integrações e Automações Desenvolver automações para validações de processos e regras de negócio. Apoiar iniciativas de melhoria contínua do processo DevOps. Suporte e Evolução da Plataforma Atuar como referência técnica para temas de DevOps. Identificar oportunidades de otimização de processos. Apoiar desenvolvedores durante investigações de falhas em pipelines e deploys. Produzir documentação técnica e procedimentos operacionais. Requisitos obrigatórios INGLÊS FLUENTE PARA CONVERSAÇÃO Experiência com Azure DevOps (Services ou Server). Experiência na criação e manutenção de pipelines CI/CD. Conhecimento avançado em YAML Pipelines. Experiência com Git e estratégias de branching. Conhecimento de Pull Requests, Code Reviews e Branch Policies. Conhecimento em aplicações Microsoft: Capacidade de analisar erros de build e dependências de aplicações. Scripts de banco de dados. Qualidade Experiência com SonarQube. Conceitos de: Administração básica de servidores de aplicação. Conhecimentos de redes, autenticação e permissões. Gestão de agentes de build. Diferenciais Experiência com Azure DevOps Server On-Premises. Experiência em migração TFVC → Git. Conhecimento em Jira Integration. Conhecimento em PowerShell. Conhecimento em automações utilizando REST APIs do Azure DevOps. Experiência com Change Management / ITIL. Conhecimento em SonarQube Administration. Conhecimento em arquitetura de ambientes corporativos Microsoft. Experiência em ambientes regulados com processos formais de aprovação de deploy. Assistência Médica Nacional (para o titular e dependentes, com quarto privativo) Assistência odontológica nacional (para o titular e dependentes) Vale refeição / alimentação flexível Auxílio home office Day off (no mês do aniversário) Wellhub (antigo Gympass) Licença Maternidade (6 meses) e Paternidade (20 dias) estendidas Auxílio creche para filhos de até 3 anos (por filho) Apoio em saúde mental com a Wellz Clube de Vantagens com descontos em diversos parceiros Convênio com instituições de ensino e cursos de idioma Desenvolvimento Profissional (Universidade Corporativa) Parceria com empresa de coworkings no Brasil Programa de Qualidade de Vida e Bem-Estar Médico consultor para acompanhamento de radixers A Radix está sempre no topo das Melhores Empresas para se trabalhar porque: Temos profissionais comprometidos, dedicados, curiosos e inovadores. O espírito de equipe é a nossa maior força. Trabalhamos de forma cooperativa e sabemos que estamos juntos, remando na mesma direção. Temos um ambiente diverso, que valoriza equidade e inclusão. Nossa jornada de trabalho é flexível e em quase todos os projetos é possível trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil. Valorizamos o bem-estar e o cuidado com as nossas pessoas, com programas de apoio à saúde mental, psiquiatra e médico consultor disponíveis. Há 16 anos entre as melhores empresas para trabalhar no Rio, no Brasil e em Tecnologia... Prazer, Radix. Atuamos na transformação digital de clientes em diversos segmentos, implementamos soluções que tornam os processos mais eficientes, através de um time altamente especializado e multidisciplinar. Temos presença global, com projetos em mais de 30 países, para empresas de diferentes tamanhos e setores. Geramos impactos reais, nos negócios e na trajetória das pessoas que passam por aqui. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Power & Containment Cluster Manager
vagas.description: Power & Containment Cluster Manager Department: Technical & Infrastructure Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team. THE POSITION Reporting to the Senior Manager, Technical Services & Infrastructure (TCS), the Power & Containment Cluster Manager is responsible for the planning, integration and delivery of power infrastructure and containment systems across all FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 venues. The role ensures that all power, containment and key technical services (HVAC, water & waste, floodlighting, sound system, etc) are delivered in full compliance with FIFA standards, supporting operational readiness, safety and broadcast requirements, while managing dependencies with stadiums, host cities, suppliers and Functional Areas. The position acts as a critical integration point between design, procurement, delivery and operations, ensuring alignment across all stakeholders and protecting the tournament’s critical path. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Define and validate technical requirements for power, containment and related services (HVAC, water & waste, floodlighting) in coordination with all Functional Areas. Ensure compliance of power infrastructure, including grid, temporary systems and backup solutions. Ensure effective containment design and routing for power, broadcast and technical services. Coordinate with stadiums, host cities, utilities and suppliers to ensure alignment, integration and delivery. Monitor and report progress, quality and compliance, identifying risks, dependencies and mitigation actions. Support on technical inspections, readiness reviews and audits, ensuring timely closure of findings. Oversee testing and commissioning, including load and stress testing of power systems. Act as the cluster technical interface across stakeholders, ensuring clear communication and decision-making. Ensure compliance with FIFA standards, timelines, budget constraints and operational requirements. YOUR PROFILE Education Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical or engineering field Experience A minimum of 8 years work experience in a technical services related field within Major Events/Sports Organization. Experience with Energy / MEP required (e.g. Temporary Power, Ventilation and Cooling, Cabling) Skills & Competencies Strong technical knowledge in Energy / MEP required (e.g. Temporary Power, Ventilation and Cooling, Cabling, Entertainment). Proficient in MS Office and planning software and online collaboration tools. Excellent organizational, coordination, and communication skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions. Certifications & Requirements Right to work in Brazil. Fluency in English and Portuguese; additional language(s) is an asset. Availability to travel as needed. Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Especialista em Controles Internos (SOx)
vagas.description: A New Wave é uma empresa global de tecnologia focada no desenvolvimento de soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis para a indústria minero-metalúrgica, com forte atuação em projetos ligados à transição energética. Sobre a Posição Buscamos um(a) Especialista em Controles Internos (SOx) para estruturar e liderar essa área do zero, garantindo conformidade com a Lei Sarbanes-Oxley e preparando a organização para uma eventual abertura de capital (IPO). A posição terá forte interação com a alta liderança, auditores internos e externos, sendo referência técnica e estratégica na construção de uma governança robusta em um ambiente de crescimento acelerado. Responsabilidades Desenhar a estrutura de Controles Internos da companhia, definindo políticas, metodologias e modelo de governança. Definir o plano de trabalho inicial, com cronograma de ações de curto e médio prazos para implantação da área. Desenvolver frameworks e metodologias de controle baseados nas melhores práticas internacionais, incluindo o framework COSO. Realizar mapeamento de riscos e recomendar planos de mitigação para as principais áreas da companhia. Liderar a implantação da SOx, treinando e orientando as áreas na criação, documentação e execução de controles-chave. Acompanhar e supervisionar a implementação dos controles pelas áreas responsáveis, garantindo aderência ao modelo desenhado. Realizar testes e validações periódicas para assegurar que os controles estão funcionando conforme o planejado. Atuar em parceria com a área de Auditoria Interna, que será estruturada de forma concomitante com Controles Internos. Atender demandas da auditoria independente, sendo o ponto focal de Controles Internos junto aos auditores externos. Conduzir treinamentos e iniciativas para disseminar a cultura de compliance na organização. Apoiar a preparação para IPO, adequando processos e controles às exigências de reguladores e investidores. Requisitos Experiência mínima de 5 anos atuando em Controles Internos e/ou SOx. Experiência sólida em SOx, preferencialmente em empresas de capital aberto. Experiência na implantação e uso do framework COSO. Conhecimento em auditoria interna, gestão de riscos e compliance. Perfil hands‑on, com capacidade de estruturar processos em ambiente dinâmico e em crescimento. Graduação completa em Administração, Contabilidade, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Inglês fluente. Diferenciais Certificações CIA, CISA ou equivalentes. Experiência prévia em projetos de IPO. Conhecimento em ferramentas de automação de controles internos. Conhecimento ou treinamento em segurança cibernética. Vivência em empresas de tecnologia ou setores regulados. Por que trabalhar na New Wave? Oportunidade única de construir uma área estratégica do zero, com impacto direto na credibilidade da empresa frente ao mercado e investidores. Atuação em projetos inovadores com relevância global. Ambiente dinâmico, em rápida expansão internacional. Cultura colaborativa, com foco em tecnologia, inovação e sustentabilidade. Oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa em pleno desenvolvimento. vagas.title: Promotor de Vendas - PCD
vagas.description: Descrição da vaga Sobre a vaga NaM. Dias Branco, acreditamos que a qualidade de vida no trabalho e o desenvolvimento das pessoas são essenciais para o nosso sucesso. Por isso, investimos em treinamentos, bem-estar e um ambiente colaborativo, onde cada pessoaévalorizada. Quer crescer com a gente? Vem! Quem somos Somos uma das maiores indústrias de alimentos do Brasil, líderes em massas e biscoitos, com mais de 70 anos de história. Marcas como Piraquê, Fit Food, Adria, Jasmine, Frontera, Vitarella, Isabela, Fortaleza, Richester, Puro Sabor, Finna e muitas outras fazem parte da vida de milhões de brasileiros. Temos mais de 17 mil colaboradores, 21 unidades no Brasil, 1 no Uruguai e 28 centros de distribuição, que garantem nossa presença no Brasil e em mais de 40 países pelo mundo. Nossa atuação e cultura Atuamos em diversos segmentos de alimentos, com um portfólio que inclui biscoitos, massas, farinhas, margarinas, bolos, snacks, torradas, chocolates, temperos, molhos, granolas, cookies, pasta de amendoim, panificação sem glúten e beneficiamento de grãos. Valorizamos o respeito às pessoas e à diversidade, por acreditarmos que ela impulsiona resultados e transformações. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, onde todos são respeitados e reconhecidos por sua autenticidade e potencial, independentemente de idade, gênero, etnia ou orientação sexual. vagas.description: Descrição da vaga No Azzas 2154 Fashion & Lifestyle, somos movidos por pessoas. São elas que impulsionam ideias, constroem marcas e fazem a moda acontecer todos os dias. Aqui, cada pessoa tem voz, espaço e responsabilidade na construção do que fazemos. É assim, todos os dias, que nos tornamos o maior Grupo de Moda da América Latina. Sobre a posição Buscamos um(a) Especialista em Projetos Estratégicos para atuar diretamente com a liderança de Tecnologia, dentro da nossa iniciativa de IA corporativa. É uma posição para quem gosta de entrar em problemas complexos, conduzir análises profundas com autonomia e sair com recomendações que geram decisão e impacto. O trabalho é variado por natureza: a cada ciclo, uma oportunidade diferente do negócio — identificada pela alta liderança — pode virar o seu próximo projeto. O que você vai fazer Atuar como braço analítico ligado diretamente ao diretor de Tecnologia. À medida que a alta liderança identifica oportunidades relevantes no negócio, esta posição é alocada para entrar no problema, conduzir a análise de ponta a ponta e sair com recomendações concretas e acionáveis — atuando também na implementação quando o projeto pedir. O que buscamos 4 a 5 anos de experiência em funções analíticas exigentes — consultoria estratégica, estratégia/BizOps, M&A, banco de investimento, ou áreas equivalentes. Capacidade comprovada de estruturar problemas ambíguos e conduzi-los até uma recomendação concreta com pouca supervisão. Raciocínio quantitativo forte e conforto com dados (SQL e/ou Python são diferenciais relevantes). Comunicação executiva clara — escrita e verbal — com diretoria e C-level. Fluência ou disposição genuína em usar ferramentas de IA como parte central do trabalho analítico. Autonomia, senso de dono e maturidade para navegar diferentes áreas do grupo. Diferenciais (nice to have) Experiência em concepção ou desenvolvimento de produtos/projetos digitais. Vivência em ambientes de varejo, moda, e-commerce ou bens de consumo. Responsabilidades e atribuições Decompor problemas de negócio ambíguos em hipóteses claras, frentes de análise e um plano de ataque — partindo de um direcionamento inicial da liderança e conduzindo o resto com autonomia. Conduzir análises quantitativas e qualitativas robustas: estruturar dados, dimensionar oportunidades, modelar cenários e pressionar as próprias conclusões antes de apresentá-las. Entregar complete staff work: chegar até o final do raciocínio e apresentar recomendações prontas para decisão, com trade-offs explícitos e premissas declaradas — não análises em aberto que devolvem o problema para quem pediu. Usar ferramentas de IA como alavanca central de análise — acelerando pesquisa, processamento de dados, prototipagem de soluções e geração de insumos para decisão. Traduzir análise em comunicação executiva: documentos e apresentações diretos, bem estruturados e proporcionais à decisão em jogo, voltados a CEO e diretoria. Participar da implementação das recomendações quando aplicável — acompanhando execução, ajustando o curso com base em resultados e garantindo que a análise vire impacto real. Trabalhar lado a lado com as áreas donas de cada problema, navegando contextos distintos do grupo (marcas, varejo, operações, digital) sem gerar atrito de "área que audita área". vagas.description: Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee Usamos nossa energia para mudar a vida das pessoas! A gente está lá, todo dia, toda hora, onde e quando o brasileiro precisa. É nosso compromisso, aqui na Ultragaz, estimular um ambiente de muita liberdade e igualdade , de muitas cores e sotaques. Um espaço acolhedor às diferentes vozes que alcançam todos os lugares indistintamente. Define quem somos e a diversidade em que acreditamos. Todas as nossas vagas respeitam esse compromisso! Venha somar sua energia com a gente! #deumgasnasuacarreira Nossa energia é feita de pessoas. Venha somar com a gente! Entre em um time que tem história e constrói o futuro! De norte a sul do país, usamos nossa energia para mudar a vida das pessoas todos os dias. Há quase 90 anos, distribuímos GLP no Brasil, liderando com soluções acessíveis que levam energia a milhões de brasileiros. Com diferentes sotaques, idades, perfis, passamos nossa paixão de geração em geração. Com a energia de milhares de pessoas que vestem a nossa camisa, somamos a energia que nos faz Ultragaz. Acreditamos que quando nos unimos conseguimos resolver desafios, entregando resultados com excelência e segurança . Nossas descobertas nos fortalecem coletivamente, uma força com dedicação e paixão. Em qualquer tempo, energia é nosso ponto de partida e nossa energia nos movimenta . Para criar, para transformar, #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.description: Job Function: Employment Type: Permanent Yinson is a dynamic, equal opportunity employer with great organisational culture where people are valued and empowered to deliver powerful solutions. Sumary: Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda is seeking a dedicated Integrity Engineer. This important role supports the onshore operations with a key focus on maintaining and assuring the integrity and safe operation of FPSOunits and associated equipment. As an Integrity Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in safeguarding the company’s interests by ensuring all inspection, testing, and maintenance activities on critical equipment are carried out with high standards of safety, compliance, and efficiency. You will be integral to a team committed to operational excellence and proactive risk management within the offshore oil and gas sector. Key Responsibilities Organise and oversee the activities related to NR 13 / SPIE compliance in collaboration with equipment inspectors from FPSO units, including maintaining comprehensive and up-to-date documentation such as official books, calibration certificates, inspection reports, and audit records. Manage internal and external inspection schedules, ensuring adherence to regulatory and company standards, while maintaining close coordination with operation managers to integrate inspection activities within shutdown plans effectively. Lead the evaluation and implementation of training programs for Equipment Inspectors, Operators, and Technicians to uphold competency and safety standards across all levels of operations. Maintain and regularly update the equipment master list to reflect current status and compliance details. Define testing, measurement, replacements, repairs, and modification schedules based on written procedures, ensuring the physical condition of critical equipment meets operational safety requirements. Ensure rigorous verification and performance testing of safety valves and other safety-critical equipment, either by performing, witnessing, or overseeing such tests to guarantee reliable operation. Conduct audits of equipment manufacturers as required, supporting thorough supplier qualification and quality assurance. Collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders (Yinson teams) and external parties (clients, contractors) to foster transparent communication and alignment on objectives and compliance requirements. Perform additional duties as assigned by management in support of the company’s goals and regulatory compliance. Commercial Awareness: Understand the wider business context and how operational integrity relates to company performance and risk management. Safeguarding Company Interest: Demonstrate commitment to protecting company assets, reputation, and operational continuity. Cost Control Experience: Apply cost control principles within offshore oil and gas projects to optimise expenditure without compromising safety or quality. Teamwork: Work collaboratively across multi-disciplinary teams and with external partners, fostering a positive and productive working environment. Communication Skills: Communicate effectively at all organisational levels, both verbally and in writing, ensuring clarity and professionalism in all interactions. Analytical and Problem-Solving Abilities: Use strong analytical skills to assess equipment conditions, interpret inspection data, and develop practical solutions. Attention to Detail: Maintain accuracy in documentation, procedures, and reporting to support compliance and operational excellence. Responsibility and Proactivity: Take ownership of tasks, demonstrate initiative, and work in a hands‑on manner to achieve targets and resolve issues promptly. Qualifications and Experience Engineering degree is mandatory. CREA‑RJ accreditation is required. Post‑Graduation degree in a relevant field will be considered a strong advantage. Experience as an Operations Engineer within the Brazilian oil and gas sector, with experience specifically in integrity engineering preferred. Proven experience working with FPSO projects and offshore operations is highly desirable. Fluent English and Portuguese verbal and written communication skills to effectively liaise with diverse teams and stakeholders. Why Join Us? At Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda, you will become part of a forward‑thinking and inclusive team dedicated to safe and sustainable offshore operations. We value initiative and provide opportunities for professional growth within a dynamic sector. Our collaborative culture encourages knowledge sharing and continuous improvement, enabling you to make a tangible impact in a challenging and rewarding environment. If you are a focused, detail‑oriented professional with a strong commitment to equipment integrity and operational safety, and you thrive in a team‑oriented setting, this role offers an excellent platform to advance your career in offshore production. #J-18808-Ljbffr

You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as equal opportunities, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 21,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go. Job Purpose We are looking for a Senior Process Control Engineer! We are seeking a motivated Senior Engineer to join our global team specializing in Process Control for subsea oil and gas process systems. Process Control is a core competency in the Power & Processing (P&P) department. They are responsible for developing and designing the automation system controlling the subsea processing equipment, including control algorithms and operating procedures to ensure safe and efficient operation. The Senior Process Control Engineer works as part of the system engineering team to ensure that the subsea processing equipment operates within its design limitations and that the system operation is robust and efficient. The work requires a thorough understanding of multiphase processing with expertise in process control and the design and implementation of closed loop control. To achieve this, the process control engineer collaborates closely with process, rotating equipment, high voltage power, flow assurance, instrumentation and control system disciplines within TechnipFMC. Define the process control strategy, identify and analyse risks associated with operation and control of the system. Write functional specifications and test procedures for implementation and testing. Develop and review safety requirements for the system at HAZOP and LOPA meetings with Clients. Facilitate and lead internal and external meetings, reviews and project face‑to‑face meetings towards the client and sub suppliers as required. Follow up Dynamic process simulation studies to verify system and process control functions. Efficiently contribute to the project delivery phase through presentations, meetings and interfaces towards other key internal project packages. Lead or support function testing of the subsea process control implemented in delivery or R&D projects. Participate and support as TechnipFMC representative during offshore commissioning and start‑up. Provide operational support and consultation for problem solving and performance improvement as part of Life‑of‑Field service for Subsea Processing projects. Support the knowledge development within the discipline. Travel, both locally and internationally, should be expected. You are meant for this job if: You have a BSc, MSc or PhD within Cybernetics, Chemical Engineering or a similar education with a strong focus on Process Control engineering. At least 10 years relevant experience. Experience can compensate for lack of formal education. Experience with subsea process systems and products such as pumps and separators. Experience designing and implementing process control in oil and gas systems. Experience in interfacing other sub‑systems; especially Controls/Instruments, Flow Assurance, Process Engineering and Field Development. Experience with development and testing of process system components and full system solutions. Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills. Excellent communication and teamwork abilities. Willingness to learn, a growth mindset, and can adapt to a dynamic work environment. Fluent in English, (C1 or higher according to CEFR). Your Future at TechnipFMC Your journey starts with our onboarding program. As an international company, we provide you with great opportunities for internal growth. You will have the opportunity to attend development activities. We have benefits like company cabins, in‑house gym, and sports teams. You will be secured by good insurance and retirements plans. Collaborative and innovative atmosphere that promotes teamwork. Practicalities Deadline to apply: 29th of June 2026, we view CV's continously. TechnipFMC promotes equal opportunities and inclusion by ensuring equal opportunities to all ages, races, ethnicities, religions, gender expressions, disabilities, or all other pluralities. We celebrate who you are and what you bring. Every voice matters and we encourage you to add to our culture. vagas.description: The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Here Is What We Offer Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture Assistant Director of Greek Life and Leadership Job Purpose The Office of Student Life strives to create a student-centered environment that supports the achievement of students' academic, professional, and personal goals while promoting civility, respect, integrity, and equity among members of the University and greater community. The innovative programming designed by the talented staff of Student Life aims to foster professional experience through involvement with and/or in the following key areas: Student Publications; Student Government & Leadership; Student Activism & Service; Fraternity & Sorority Life; School Spirit; University Ambassadorship; Special Events and Activities. Reporting to the Associate Director of Fraternity and Sorority Life, the Assistant Director of Fraternity and Sorority Life is responsible for assisting in the enhancement of the overall development of selective organizations at Howard University. Supervisory Authority Has responsibility or authority which is limited to the direction of students and temporary workers. Nature And Scope Internal contacts may include senior administrators, faculty, students, and staff. External contacts may include vendors, consultants, and the general public. Principal Accountabilities Advising & Council Development: Develops, trains, programs, and advises selective organization student councils, including the Joint Greek Council, National Pan-Hellenic Council (NPHC), Local-based Councils (LBC), Professional and Honors Council (PHC), Council of Independent Organizations (CIO), and other selective membership organizations. Platform & Communication Management: Maintains and updates the program website and manages the Collegiate Link platform (ENGAGE). Creates and distributes the Fraternity & Sorority Life (FSL) newsletter and oversees departmental social media platforms to enhance visibility, transparency, and engagement. Risk Management & Compliance: Verifies organizational insurance compliance with University and national policies. Reviews and recommends risk management practices for student organizations. Designs and implements compliance and training programs, including a comprehensive anti-hazing curriculum, ensuring alignment with District of Columbia law and University policy. Training & Education: Facilitates mandatory annual anti-hazing training for 2,000+ students and 40 organizations. Maintains accurate records of training certifications for organizations and potential members. Investigations & Policy Enforcement: Investigates allegations of hazing and organizational misconduct. Prepares detailed investigative reports, renders findings, assesses policy violations, and collaborates with the Office of Student Conduct on disciplinary outcomes. Program Development & Outreach: Plans, develops, and executes departmental programs, student leadership initiatives, and community-based outreach. Partners with external entities—including community organizations, vendors, and national associations—to deliver large-scale programming and initiatives. Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement: Facilitates cross-functional collaboration with national headquarters, alumni advisors, and campus stakeholders to ensure accountability, compliance, and sustainable organizational growth. Project & Budget Oversight: Manages multiple concurrent projects, balancing compliance, budget oversight, assessment, and event execution. Supports budget tracking and financial accountability in collaboration with the Associate Director. Leadership Development & Capacity Building: Develops student-led organizations through capacity-building initiatives, leadership training, strategic planning, and advocacy efforts, with a focus on equity, inclusion, and long-term sustainability. Assessment & Reporting: Creates and administers assessment tools to evaluate student engagement, program effectiveness, and organizational compliance. Provides data-driven reports to inform departmental and institutional decision-making. Event Management: Reviews and approves Event Request submissions through CollegiateLink (ENGAGE). Advises and supports councils and student groups in event planning, execution, and compliance. Policy Enforcement: Enforces Howard University and Office of Campus Life policies, rules, expectations, and the Student Code of Conduct. Work Schedule & Supervision: Maintains a flexible schedule, including standard office hours (9:00 a.m.–5:30 p.m.) with occasional evening and weekend commitments to support events and student needs. Participates in weekly supervisory check-ins. Other Duties: Performs additional responsibilities as assigned by the supervisor and the Executive Director of Student Life. Core Competencies Ability to develop and maintain proficiency in the utilization of Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Workday, and related software applications to perform a variety of typing and/or project assignments. Knowledge of general office procedures and practices. Knowledge of basic record keeping procedures. Skill in basic arithmetic, grammar, and spelling. Ability to effectively communicate orally and in writing. Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, students, and the general public. Execute all duties with an exceptional customer service approach. Demonstrate cultural competence in race, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, ability, ideology, religion, national origin, and other areas of diversity. Minimum Requirements Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree in Higher Education Administration, Student Affairs, or a related field preferred. 3-5 years of progressively responsible experience in student affairs, student engagement, or related fields. Knowledge, Skills, Abilities Must be fun, positive, organized, helpful, student-centered, friendly, and responsible. Demonstrate a sense of job responsibility, initiative, energy, leadership, approach-ability, and maturity. Ability to adjudicate student conduct matters, handle crisis situations and sensitive topics. Ability to work independently and as a team. Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-volume, collaborative team environment. Commitment to ethical fiscal and professional service standards and a demonstrated ability to meaningfully contribute to team projects. Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, students, and the community. Definir estratégias de gerenciamento de reservatórios visando maximizar recuperação, produção e geração de valor dos ativos. Supervisionar a construção, atualização e validação de modelos estáticos e dinâmicos de reservatório. Liderar estudos integrados de desenvolvimento de campo, gerenciamento de incertezas e avaliações de risco. Promover inovação tecnológica e melhores práticas de gestão de reservatórios.
